questions.text: Which statement best captures why yield engineering and failure analysis are both important to semiconductor operations?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪项最准确地概括了良率工程与失效分析对半导体运营的重要性？

options.text: Yield determines sellable output from wafer starts, while failure analysis helps isolate defects and resolve problems quickly.
options.text_zh: 良率决定从投片中可获得的可销售产品数量，而失效分析有助于隔离缺陷并快速解决问题。

options.text: Yield mainly measures circuit-design quality, while failure analysis mainly determines market demand.
options.text_zh: 良率主要衡量电路设计质量，而失效分析主要用于判断市场需求。

options.text: Yield applies only to wafer fabrication, while failure analysis applies only after packaging.
options.text_zh: 良率只适用于晶圆制造，而失效分析只适用于封装之后。

options.text: Yield and failure analysis are two names for the same manufacturing metric.
options.text_zh: 良率与失效分析只是同一个制造指标的两种名称。

questions.explanation: The slides link yield to sellable output and failure analysis to defect isolation and rapid problem resolution. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.11.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将良率与可销售产出联系起来，并将失效分析用于缺陷隔离和快速解决问题。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 11 页。

questions.text: Which packaging level connects the silicon chip directly to its package?
questions.text_zh: 哪一级封装负责将硅芯片直接连接到封装体？

options.text: Second-level packaging, where packaged chips are attached to a PCB.
options.text_zh: 二级封装，即将已封装芯片安装到 PCB。

options.text: Third-level packaging, where PCB assemblies connect to a motherboard or backplane.
options.text_zh: 三级封装，即将 PCB 组件连接到主板或背板。

options.text: First-level packaging, which forms the chip-to-package interconnection.
options.text_zh: 一级封装，即形成芯片到封装体的互连。

options.text: Wafer fabrication, where active devices are patterned before packaging.
options.text_zh: 晶圆制造，即在封装前形成有源器件图形。

questions.explanation: First-level packaging is the chip-to-package interconnection; higher levels connect packages to boards and systems. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.18.
questions.explanation_zh: 一级封装是芯片到封装体的互连；更高层级则把封装连接到电路板和系统。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 18 页。

questions.text: A process engineer is forming metal interconnect layers that connect transistors already fabricated in silicon. Which part of the flow is this?
questions.text_zh: 工艺工程师正在形成金属互连层，以连接已经在硅中制备完成的晶体管。这属于哪一部分工艺流程？

options.text: Wafer growth and substrate preparation.
options.text_zh: 晶圆生长与衬底准备。

options.text: Back-End-of-Line (BEOL) interconnect formation.
options.text_zh: 后端工艺（BEOL）的互连形成。

options.text: Far-Back-End-of-Line (FBEOL) packaging and board assembly.
options.text_zh: 远后端工艺（FBEOL）的封装与板级组装。

options.text: Front-End-of-Line (FEOL) active-device formation.
options.text_zh: 前端工艺（FEOL）的有源器件形成。

questions.explanation: FEOL forms devices; BEOL forms the metal interconnect network connecting them. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.19.
questions.explanation_zh: FEOL 形成器件；BEOL 形成连接这些器件的金属互连网络。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 19 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about yield and reliability:
I. Yield is the proportion of functional devices produced from a batch of wafers.
II. Reliability is the ability of a device to perform its intended function over a specified period under normal operating conditions.
III. A high manufacturing yield by itself guarantees high operating reliability.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于良率与可靠性，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 良率是从一批晶圆中制造出的功能器件所占比例。
II. 可靠性是器件在正常工作条件下于规定时间内持续实现预期功能的能力。
III. 制造良率高本身就能够保证器件具有高工作可靠性。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines yield as a manufacturing success fraction and reliability as time-dependent functional performance; one metric does not by itself guarantee the other. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.23.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将良率定义为制造成功比例，将可靠性定义为随时间维持预期功能的能力；前者本身并不能保证后者。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 23 页。

questions.text: Which activity is most directly part of semiconductor yield engineering as described in the slides?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，以下哪项最直接属于半导体良率工程的工作？

options.text: Setting semiconductor market prices and forecasting end-product demand.
options.text_zh: 制定半导体市场价格并预测终端产品需求。

options.text: Designing only the PCB layout after package qualification.
options.text_zh: 只在封装认证后设计 PCB 布局。

options.text: Tracking only facility utility costs without linking them to process performance.
options.text_zh: 只跟踪厂务能源成本，而不与工艺性能关联。

options.text: Reducing defects, optimizing processes, performing root-cause analysis, and monitoring yield across manufacturing steps.
options.text_zh: 在制造步骤中进行缺陷降低、工艺优化、根因分析与良率监控。

questions.explanation: Yield engineering includes defect reduction, process optimization, RCA, monitoring/control, DFM, and yield enhancement. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.21-22.
questions.explanation_zh: 良率工程包括缺陷降低、工艺优化、RCA、监控与控制、DFM 和良率提升。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 21-22 页。

questions.text: What is the primary role of photolithography in IC fabrication?
questions.text_zh: 光刻在 IC 制造中的主要作用是什么？

options.text: To transfer circuit-layout patterns onto the wafer so later processes can define device features.
options.text_zh: 将电路版图图形转移到晶圆上，使后续工艺能够形成器件结构。

options.text: To remove blanket films chemically without using a patterning layer.
options.text_zh: 在不使用图形层的情况下化学去除整层薄膜。

options.text: To introduce n-type or p-type dopants throughout the entire wafer thickness.
options.text_zh: 在整个晶圆厚度内引入 n 型或 p 型掺杂剂。

options.text: To globally flatten topography by chemical and mechanical polishing.
options.text_zh: 通过化学与机械抛光实现全局平坦化。

questions.explanation: Photolithography transfers circuit patterns to the wafer to guide later steps such as etching or implantation. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.24.
questions.explanation_zh: 光刻将电路图形转移到晶圆上，以引导后续刻蚀或离子注入等工艺。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 24 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about etch classifications:
I. Pattern etch transfers a photoresist or hard-mask pattern into an underlying film by selective material removal.
II. Blanket etch removes all or part of a surface film without transferring a lithographic pattern.
III. Reactive Ion Etching (RIE) is described as intermediate between purely chemical and purely physical etching.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于刻蚀分类，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 图形刻蚀通过选择性去除材料，将光刻胶或硬掩膜图形转移到下层薄膜。
II. 整面刻蚀在不进行光刻图形转移的情况下去除表面薄膜的全部或一部分。
III. 反应离子刻蚀（RIE）被描述为介于纯化学刻蚀与纯物理刻蚀之间。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

questions.explanation: Week 1 distinguishes pattern and blanket etch by whether a mask pattern is transferred and places RIE between the pure chemical and pure physical mechanisms. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.26.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 以是否转移掩膜图形区分图形刻蚀与整面刻蚀，并将 RIE 归为介于纯化学与纯物理机制之间的刻蚀。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 26 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about ion implantation / doping:
I. Ion implantation intentionally introduces dopants into semiconductor material to change its electrical properties.
II. Its primary purpose is to planarize wafer topography before lithography.
III. It can create semiconductor regions with different conductivity types, such as n-type and p-type regions.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于离子注入 / 掺杂，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 离子注入有意将掺杂剂引入半导体材料，以改变其电学性质。
II. 其主要目的在于光刻前将晶圆表面形貌平坦化。
III. 它可形成不同导电类型的半导体区域，例如 n 型区和 p 型区。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statement III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 III。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: Ion implantation is a doping process used to change semiconductor electrical properties and form regions such as n-type and p-type; planarization is not its function. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.28.
questions.explanation_zh: 离子注入属于掺杂工艺，用于改变半导体电学性质并形成 n 型、p 型等区域；平坦化并不是其功能。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 28 页。

questions.text: Which description best matches Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD)?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪项最符合化学气相沉积（CVD）的定义？

options.text: Metal ions in a liquid electrolyte are reduced only inside patterned vias.
options.text_zh: 液体电解质中的金属离子只在图形化通孔内还原沉积。

options.text: A slurry chemically reacts with the surface while a pad mechanically removes material.
options.text_zh: 浆料与表面发生化学反应，同时抛光垫机械去除材料。

options.text: A solid target is physically sputtered and condensed without a surface chemical reaction.
options.text_zh: 固体靶材经物理溅射并凝结成膜，不依赖表面化学反应。

options.text: Gaseous precursors react near or on the substrate surface to form a solid thin film.
options.text_zh: 气相前驱体在衬底表面附近或表面发生化学反应，形成固态薄膜。

questions.explanation: CVD uses gaseous chemical precursors and chemical reactions to form a solid film on the substrate. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.30.
questions.explanation_zh: CVD 使用气相化学前驱体，并通过化学反应在衬底上形成固态薄膜。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 30 页。

questions.text: Which feature differentiates Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) from CVD in the Week 1 introduction?
questions.text_zh: 在第 1 周课件的介绍中，以下哪一特征可用于区分物理气相沉积（PVD）与 CVD？

options.text: PVD transfers material physically from a source through vaporization and condensation onto the substrate.
options.text_zh: PVD 通过蒸发并在衬底上凝结的物理过程把材料从源转移到衬底。

options.text: PVD relies on liquid chemical etchants to dissolve the film.
options.text_zh: PVD 依赖液相化学刻蚀剂溶解薄膜。

options.text: PVD is used only to grow silicon dioxide from the silicon substrate.
options.text_zh: PVD 只用于由硅衬底生长二氧化硅。

options.text: PVD combines chemical slurry and mechanical abrasion to flatten the wafer.
options.text_zh: PVD 结合化学浆料与机械磨削来平坦化晶圆。

questions.explanation: PVD transfers source material physically by vaporization and condensation rather than relying on precursor surface chemistry. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.33.
questions.explanation_zh: PVD 通过蒸发和凝结进行物理材料转移，而不是依赖前驱体表面化学反应。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 33 页。

questions.text: Why was Electrochemical Plating (ECP) attractive for copper interconnect deposition?
questions.text_zh: 为什么电化学镀（ECP）适合用于铜互连沉积？

options.text: It is a low-temperature process and is therefore compatible with temperature-sensitive low-k dielectric integration.
options.text_zh: 它是低温工艺，因此与对温度敏感的 low-k 介质集成具有较好兼容性。

options.text: Its main role is to remove metallic contamination before oxidation.
options.text_zh: 其主要作用是在氧化前去除金属污染。

options.text: It requires very high wafer temperature, which improves low-k polymer stability.
options.text_zh: 它需要很高的晶圆温度，可提高 low-k 聚合物稳定性。

options.text: It avoids copper entirely and deposits only aluminum interconnects.
options.text_zh: 它完全避免使用铜，只沉积铝互连。

questions.explanation: The slides highlight low process temperature as an ECP advantage for Cu/low-k interconnect integration. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.35.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件强调 ECP 的低工艺温度有利于铜/low-k 互连集成。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 35 页。

questions.text: Which manufacturing problem is CMP intended to solve most directly?
questions.text_zh: 化学机械抛光（CMP）最直接用于解决哪类制造问题？

options.text: Controlling implanted dopant dose and junction depth.
options.text_zh: 控制离子注入掺杂剂量与结深。

options.text: Repairing defects in a photomask by electron-beam writing.
options.text_zh: 利用电子束写入修复光掩模缺陷。

options.text: Reducing wafer-surface topography to obtain a planar surface for subsequent high-resolution processing.
options.text_zh: 降低晶圆表面起伏，为后续高分辨率工艺获得平坦表面。

options.text: Creating a metallurgical bond between a bonding wire and a pad.
options.text_zh: 在键合线与焊盘之间形成冶金键合。

questions.explanation: CMP combines chemical and mechanical removal to smooth and planarize the wafer surface. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.38.
questions.explanation_zh: CMP 通过化学和机械协同去除材料，使晶圆表面平滑并实现平坦化。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 38 页。

questions.text: A fab observes increasing variation as feature sizes shrink and also finds that defects are harder to identify in complex structures. Which pair of lecture-listed challenges does this situation illustrate?
questions.text_zh: 随着特征尺寸缩小，某晶圆厂发现工艺变异增大，同时复杂结构中的缺陷更难识别。该情形对应课件列出的哪一组挑战？

options.text: Package marking and final shipping logistics.
options.text_zh: 封装打标与最终出货物流。

options.text: Consumer branding and retail-channel management.
options.text_zh: 消费者品牌与零售渠道管理。

options.text: Academic scheduling and team presentation planning.
options.text_zh: 课程排期与团队展示计划。

options.text: Process variability and defect detection/classification.
options.text_zh: 工艺变异以及缺陷检测与分类。

questions.explanation: The Week 1 slides list process variability and defect detection/classification among key semiconductor-industry challenges. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.48.
questions.explanation_zh: 第 1 周课件将工艺变异和缺陷检测/分类列为半导体行业的重要挑战。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 48 页。

questions.text: Which sequence best reflects the role of semiconductor unit processes in turning a wafer into functional ICs?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪种描述最符合半导体单元工艺把晶圆转化为功能 IC 的作用？

options.text: A single deposition step directly produces a finished packaged IC.
options.text_zh: 一次沉积工艺即可直接得到完整封装 IC。

options.text: Electrical testing alone creates the device structures after wafer growth.
options.text_zh: 仅靠电学测试就在晶圆生长后形成器件结构。

options.text: Wafer dicing is the main process that forms transistors and interconnects.
options.text_zh: 晶圆切割是形成晶体管和互连的主要工艺。

options.text: A sequence of preparation, patterning, material addition/removal, doping, planarization, interconnection, and packaging steps builds the final device.
options.text_zh: 通过晶圆准备、图形化、材料添加/去除、掺杂、平坦化、互连与封装等一系列步骤构建最终器件。

questions.explanation: Semiconductor manufacturing is an integrated sequence of precise unit processes, each contributing a specific function. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.20.
questions.explanation_zh: 半导体制造由多个精密单元工艺集成组成，每个步骤承担特定功能。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 20 页。

questions.text: In the semiconductor ecosystem, what is the role of Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools?
questions.text_zh: 在半导体生态系统中，电子设计自动化（EDA）工具的主要作用是什么？

options.text: They perform wire bonding and molding during assembly.
options.text_zh: 它们在组装阶段执行引线键合和塑封。

options.text: They provide software tools that engineers use to design and verify complex chips.
options.text_zh: 它们提供工程师用于设计和验证复杂芯片的软件工具。

options.text: They are used only for final electrical testing of packaged products.
options.text_zh: 它们只用于封装产品的最终电测。

options.text: They physically grow single-crystal wafers in a crystal puller.
options.text_zh: 它们在晶体生长炉中实际生长单晶晶圆。

questions.explanation: EDA tools support chip design and verification rather than physical fabrication, assembly, or final test. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.15-16.
questions.explanation_zh: EDA 工具用于芯片设计与验证，而不是执行实际制造、组装或最终测试。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 15-16 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about the FEOL device slide:
I. BJT, MOSFET, and BiCMOS are listed as FEOL device families.
II. SRAM and DRAM are listed under MOS memory.
III. TSV and flip-chip are listed as foundational FEOL device structures on this slide.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于FEOL 器件课件页，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. BJT、MOSFET 和 BiCMOS 被列为 FEOL 器件类型。
II. SRAM 和 DRAM 被列在 MOS 存储器之下。
III. TSV 和倒装芯片在该页被列为基础 FEOL 器件结构。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

questions.explanation: The FEOL device slide lists BJT, MOSFET, BiCMOS and MOS memories such as SRAM/DRAM; TSV and flip-chip belong to interconnection/packaging rather than the listed FEOL device structures. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.49.
questions.explanation_zh: 该 FEOL 器件页列出了 BJT、MOSFET、BiCMOS 以及 SRAM/DRAM 等 MOS 存储器；TSV 与倒装芯片属于互连/封装范畴，并非该页列出的 FEOL 器件结构。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 49 页。

questions.text: A company develops its own chip designs but does not own a wafer fab; it sends the designs to a foundry for manufacturing. Which role in the semiconductor ecosystem best matches this company?
questions.text_zh: 某公司自行开发芯片设计，但不拥有晶圆厂，而是将设计交给晶圆代工厂制造。该公司最符合半导体生态系统中的哪类角色？

options.text: A chip foundry that manufactures customers' designs using its own fabrication processes and equipment.
options.text_zh: 晶圆代工厂（Foundry），利用自身工艺与设备制造客户的芯片设计。

options.text: An integrated device manufacturer (IDM) that designs, manufactures, and sells chips within one company.
options.text_zh: 集成器件制造商（IDM），在同一公司内完成芯片设计、制造与销售。

options.text: An outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) provider that packages and tests manufactured chips.
options.text_zh: 半导体封装测试代工（OSAT）服务商，对制造完成的芯片进行封装与测试。

options.text: A fabless chip company that focuses on chip design and outsources wafer manufacturing.
options.text_zh: 无晶圆厂（Fabless）芯片公司，专注芯片设计并将晶圆制造外包。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines fabless companies as firms that create chip designs without owning manufacturing facilities and send those designs to foundries for fabrication. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.16.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将无晶圆厂（Fabless）公司定义为负责芯片设计但不拥有制造设施，并将设计交由晶圆代工厂进行制造的公司。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 16 页。

questions.section: The Global Outlook of Semiconductor Supply Chain
questions.text: Which statement matches the lecture's characterization of the global semiconductor supply chain?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪项符合课件对全球半导体供应链分工的描述？

options.text: The United States leads wafer fabrication, while East Asia mainly leads assembly, packaging, and testing.
options.text_zh: 美国主要领先晶圆制造，而东亚主要领先组装、封装与测试。

options.text: The United States leads R&D-intensive areas, East Asia is prominent in wafer fabrication, and China is strong in assembly, packaging, and testing.
options.text_zh: 美国领先研发密集型环节，东亚在晶圆制造方面居前，中国在组装、封装与测试方面具有优势。

options.text: China leads EDA, core IP, and chip design, while the United States mainly leads assembly, packaging, and testing.
options.text_zh: 中国领先 EDA、核心 IP 与芯片设计，而美国主要领先组装、封装与测试。

options.text: East Asia mainly leads EDA and core IP, while China is identified primarily with leading-edge wafer fabrication.
options.text_zh: 东亚主要领先 EDA 与核心 IP，而中国主要被描述为领先先进晶圆制造。

questions.explanation: The slide places the United States in R&D-intensive activities such as EDA, core IP, chip design, and advanced equipment; East Asia at the forefront of wafer fabrication; and China as a leader in assembly, packaging, and testing. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.12.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，美国在 EDA、核心 IP、芯片设计和先进设备等研发密集型环节领先；东亚处于晶圆制造前沿；中国在组装、封装与测试方面领先。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 12 页。

questions.text: Which sequence correctly orders the three packaging levels from the chip outward toward the system?
questions.text_zh: 从芯片向外到系统，以下哪一项正确描述了三级封装的层级顺序？

options.text: Packaged-chip-to-PCB attachment, then chip-to-package interconnection, then PCB-assembly-to-motherboard or backplane connection.
options.text_zh: 先将已封装芯片安装到 PCB，再进行芯片到封装体互连，最后将 PCB 组件连接到主板或背板。

options.text: PCB-assembly-to-motherboard or backplane connection, then chip-to-package interconnection, then packaged-chip-to-PCB attachment.
options.text_zh: 先将 PCB 组件连接到主板或背板，再进行芯片到封装体互连，最后将已封装芯片安装到 PCB。

options.text: Chip-to-package interconnection, then PCB-assembly-to-motherboard or backplane connection, then packaged-chip-to-PCB attachment.
options.text_zh: 先进行芯片到封装体互连，再将 PCB 组件连接到主板或背板，最后将已封装芯片安装到 PCB。

options.text: Chip-to-package interconnection, then packaged-chip-to-PCB attachment, then PCB-assembly-to-motherboard or backplane connection.
options.text_zh: 芯片到封装体互连，然后将已封装芯片安装到 PCB，最后将 PCB 组件连接到主板或背板。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines first-level packaging as chip-to-package, second-level as packaged chip-to-PCB, and third-level as connecting PCB assemblies to a motherboard or backplane. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.18.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件定义一级封装为芯片到封装体，二级封装为已封装芯片到 PCB，三级封装为将 PCB 组件连接到主板或背板。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 18 页。

questions.text: Which set of structures is identified in the lecture as part of the foundational FEOL device structure?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪组结构被课件列为构成基础 FEOL 器件结构的组成部分？

options.text: Underfill, molding compound, bond wires, and package-level solder joints.
options.text_zh: 底部填充材料、塑封料、键合线和封装级焊点。

options.text: Package substrate, solder balls, printed-circuit-board traces, and motherboard connectors.
options.text_zh: 封装基板、焊球、印刷电路板走线和主板连接器。

options.text: Well, gate oxide, gate electrode, source/drain regions, and isolation structures.
options.text_zh: 阱区、栅氧化层、栅电极、源/漏区和隔离结构。

options.text: Global metal buses, package leads, heat spreaders, and external connector pins.
options.text_zh: 全局金属总线、封装引脚、散热盖和外部连接端子。

questions.explanation: The FEOL device slide lists structures such as the well, gate oxide, gate electrode, source and drain regions, isolation structures, substrate, epitaxial layer, and salicidation layers. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.49.
questions.explanation_zh: FEOL 器件课件列出了阱区、栅氧化层、栅电极、源/漏区、隔离结构，以及衬底、外延层和自对准硅化物层等组成。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 49 页。

questions.text: Which manufacturing outcome most directly reflects the objective of semiconductor yield engineering stated in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪种制造结果最直接体现了课件所述半导体良率工程的目标？

options.text: Increasing wafer-start volume without regard to the fraction of devices that remain functional.
options.text_zh: 提高晶圆投片量，而不考虑最终功能正常器件所占比例。

options.text: Increasing the number of functional, defect-free semiconductor devices produced per unit wafer area.
options.text_zh: 提高单位晶圆面积上产出的功能正常、无缺陷半导体器件数量。

options.text: Increasing the number of mask levels used for each product while keeping defectivity unchanged.
options.text_zh: 在缺陷水平不变的情况下，提高每种产品所使用的掩模层数。

options.text: Increasing total process cycle time so that each wafer receives more manufacturing steps.
options.text_zh: 延长总工艺周期，使每片晶圆经历更多制造步骤。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that yield engineering aims to increase the number of functional and defect-free semiconductor devices produced per unit area of a wafer. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.21.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，良率工程的目标是提高单位晶圆面积上产出的功能正常且无缺陷半导体器件数量。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 21 页。

questions.text: Among the yield-engineering activities listed in the lecture, which one is most directly applied before a design is released into manufacturing?
questions.text_zh: 在课件列出的良率工程活动中，哪一项最直接在设计投入制造之前应用？

options.text: Defect reduction by correcting process sources that have already generated manufacturing defects.
options.text_zh: 针对已经产生制造缺陷的工艺来源实施缺陷降低。

options.text: Root cause analysis of a yield excursion after abnormal wafers have been observed.
options.text_zh: 在发现异常晶圆后，对良率异常进行根因分析。

options.text: Design for manufacturability to make the design more compatible with manufacturing capability.
options.text_zh: 面向可制造性设计（Design for Manufacturability, DFM），使设计更适配制造能力。

options.text: Yield monitoring and control using production results from wafers already being processed.
options.text_zh: 利用已进入生产的晶圆结果进行良率监控与控制。

questions.explanation: The lecture lists design for manufacturability as one of the ways yield engineering is performed; unlike monitoring, defect reduction, or RCA on production data, it can be applied at the design stage. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.22.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将面向可制造性设计列为良率工程的方法之一；与基于生产数据的监控、缺陷降低或根因分析相比，它可在设计阶段实施。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 22 页。

questions.text: Which etch approach is described in the lecture as lying between purely chemical etching and purely physical etching?
questions.text_zh: 课件将哪一种刻蚀方法描述为介于纯化学刻蚀与纯物理刻蚀之间？

options.text: Blanket etching, which removes all or part of a film across the wafer surface.
options.text_zh: 全面刻蚀（Blanket Etch），去除晶圆表面全部或部分薄膜。

options.text: Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), which uses reactive species together with energetic ion bombardment.
options.text_zh: 反应离子刻蚀（Reactive Ion Etching, RIE），同时利用反应性物种和高能离子轰击。

options.text: Pure physical etching, which removes material primarily through physical interaction.
options.text_zh: 纯物理刻蚀，主要通过物理作用去除材料。

options.text: Pure chemical etching, which removes material primarily through chemical reaction.
options.text_zh: 纯化学刻蚀，主要通过化学反应去除材料。

questions.explanation: The Week 1 etch slide identifies pure chemical etch, pure physical etch, and RIE, describing RIE as the intermediate case between the two extremes. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.26.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 的刻蚀课件列出纯化学刻蚀、纯物理刻蚀和 RIE，并将 RIE 描述为介于两种极端机制之间的方法。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 26 页。

questions.text: A non-planar wafer surface causes poor PVD step coverage and metal sidewall thinning, increasing line resistance and electromigration risk. Which process most directly addresses this problem?
questions.text_zh: 晶圆表面不平坦导致 PVD 台阶覆盖不良和金属侧壁变薄，从而增加互连电阻与电迁移风险。哪种工艺最直接用于解决这一问题？

options.text: Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP) to smooth and planarize the wafer surface before subsequent patterning and metallization.
options.text_zh: 化学机械抛光（CMP），在后续图形化与金属化前对晶圆表面进行平坦化。

options.text: Ion implantation to introduce dopants into selected semiconductor regions.
options.text_zh: 离子注入，将掺杂剂引入选定的半导体区域。

options.text: Photolithography to define the lateral pattern that will be transferred on the wafer.
options.text_zh: 光刻，用于定义将转移到晶圆上的横向图形。

options.text: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) to form a new thin film by surface chemical reaction.
options.text_zh: 化学气相沉积（CVD），通过表面化学反应形成新的薄膜。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that CMP planarizes the surface, improving lithography and avoiding metal sidewall thinning caused by poor step coverage, thereby reducing associated high-resistance and electromigration problems. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.38.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，CMP 可实现表面平坦化，改善光刻，并避免因台阶覆盖不良造成的金属侧壁变薄，从而降低相关的高电阻和电迁移问题。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 38 页。

questions.text: A fab can collect large volumes of process, inspection, and yield data, but struggles to convert them into timely engineering decisions. Which industry challenge listed in the lecture does this most directly illustrate?
questions.text_zh: 某晶圆厂能够收集大量工艺、检测与良率数据，但难以及时将其转化为工程决策。该情形最直接对应课件列出的哪项行业挑战？

options.text: Materials and equipment challenges, because the main issue is selecting or operating fabrication materials and tools.
options.text_zh: 材料与设备挑战，因为主要问题是制造材料与设备的选择或运行。

options.text: Process variability, because the main issue is uncontrolled physical variation in process output.
options.text_zh: 工艺变异，因为主要问题是工艺输出存在失控的物理波动。

options.text: Complex device structures, because the main issue is the physical geometry of advanced device architectures.
options.text_zh: 复杂器件结构，因为主要问题是先进器件架构的物理几何复杂性。

options.text: Data management and analysis, because useful decisions depend on organizing and interpreting large manufacturing datasets.
options.text_zh: 数据管理与分析，因为有效决策依赖于对大规模制造数据的组织与解析。

questions.explanation: Data Management & Analysis is explicitly listed among the semiconductor-industry challenges; the scenario is about extracting actionable information from large manufacturing datasets rather than about physical process variation or device structure. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.48.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将“数据管理与分析”明确列为半导体行业挑战；题干描述的是如何从大量制造数据中提取可执行信息，而不是物理工艺波动或器件结构本身。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 48 页。

questions.text: Across the advanced-packaging roadmap shown in the lecture, what general trend accompanies progression toward finer-grained 3D integration and FEOL-level stacking?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件中的先进封装路线图，随着 3D 集成粒度进一步细化并走向 FEOL 级堆叠，总体上会出现哪种趋势？

options.text: Contact pitch decreases while relative interconnect density increases.
options.text_zh: 接触间距减小，同时相对互连密度提高。

options.text: Contact pitch increases while relative interconnect density decreases.
options.text_zh: 接触间距增大，同时相对互连密度降低。

options.text: Contact pitch increases while relative interconnect density also increases.
options.text_zh: 接触间距增大，同时相对互连密度也提高。

options.text: Contact pitch decreases while relative interconnect density also decreases.
options.text_zh: 接触间距减小，同时相对互连密度也降低。

questions.explanation: The roadmap shows progressively smaller contact pitch and much higher relative density as integration moves from package-level 3D approaches toward wafer-to-wafer and FEOL-level stacking. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.45.
questions.explanation_zh: 路线图显示，随着集成从封装级 3D 方案走向晶圆到晶圆以及 FEOL 级堆叠，接触间距持续缩小，而相对互连密度显著提高。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 45 页。

questions.text: A semiconductor R&D program targets devices that consume less power and improve electric-vehicle energy efficiency. Which technology focus named in the lecture is the closest match?
questions.text_zh: 某半导体研发项目旨在开发更低功耗、可提升电动汽车能源效率的器件。该项目最符合课件列出的哪一技术重点？

options.text: Power electronics using SiC and GaN, aimed at lower power consumption and improved energy efficiency.
options.text_zh: 采用 SiC 和 GaN、以降低功耗并提高能源效率为目标的功率电子技术。

options.text: RF and wireless broadband technologies for 5G-and-beyond communication links and filters.
options.text_zh: 面向 5G 及后续通信链路与滤波器的 RF 与无线宽带技术。

options.text: MEMS and photonics technologies for sensing, optical functions, and related microsystems.
options.text_zh: 面向传感、光学功能及相关微系统的 MEMS 与光子技术。

options.text: Advanced heterogeneous integration focused on combining multiple dies and functions within packages.
options.text_zh: 先进异质集成，重点是在封装中组合多个芯片与功能。

questions.explanation: The lecture identifies next-generation silicon-carbide devices as a route to lower power consumption and improved electric-vehicle energy efficiency, within the Power Electronics (SiC, GaN) focus area. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.14.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将下一代碳化硅器件列为降低功耗、提升电动汽车能源效率的技术方向，对应“功率电子（SiC、GaN）”重点领域。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 14 页。

questions.text: A manufacturer has completed wafer fabrication but wants an external company to separate the wafers into individual chips, test them, and package them. Which ecosystem partner best fits this need?
questions.text_zh: 某制造商已完成晶圆制造，希望由外部公司将晶圆分割为独立芯片，并完成测试与封装。最符合这一需求的生态系统合作方是哪一类？

options.text: An Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) provider that performs chip separation, testing, and packaging.
options.text_zh: 半导体封装测试代工（OSAT）服务商，负责芯片分割、测试与封装。

options.text: An Electronic Design Automation (EDA) vendor supplying software used to create and verify chip designs.
options.text_zh: 电子设计自动化（EDA）厂商，提供芯片设计与验证所需的软件工具。

options.text: A wafer-fab-equipment supplier providing tools used to process semiconductor wafers in a fabrication plant.
options.text_zh: 晶圆厂设备（WFE）供应商，提供晶圆制造厂用于加工半导体晶圆的设备。

options.text: A chip foundry that fabricates customer designs on wafers using its own manufacturing processes.
options.text_zh: 晶圆代工厂，利用自身制造工艺在晶圆上生产客户设计的芯片。

questions.explanation: The lecture describes OSAT as the final-phase ecosystem service in which manufactured wafers are turned into individual chips, tested, and packaged. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.16.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将 OSAT 描述为供应链后段服务：把制造完成的晶圆转为独立芯片，并进行测试和封装。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 16 页。

questions.text: A product team has a technically sound process but cannot complete development and production ramp quickly enough to meet a rapidly approaching market window. Which challenge listed in the lecture is most directly involved?
questions.text_zh: 某产品团队的工艺在技术上可行，但无法在迅速临近的市场窗口前及时完成开发与量产爬坡。该情形最直接对应课件列出的哪项挑战？

options.text: Defect detection and classification, because the limiting issue is identifying and categorizing physical defects on wafers.
options.text_zh: 缺陷检测与分类，因为限制因素是识别并归类晶圆上的物理缺陷。

options.text: Process variability, because the limiting issue is uncontrolled variation of process outputs around their targets.
options.text_zh: 工艺变异，因为限制因素是工艺输出围绕目标值出现不可控波动。

options.text: Time-to-market pressure, because the limiting issue is how quickly the technology can be developed and brought into production.
options.text_zh: 上市时间压力（Time-to-Market Pressure），因为限制因素是技术能否及时完成开发并导入生产。

options.text: Materials and equipment challenges, because the limiting issue is availability or capability of fabrication materials and tools.
options.text_zh: 材料与设备挑战，因为限制因素是制造材料与设备的可获得性或能力。

questions.explanation: Time-to-Market Pressure is explicitly listed among the semiconductor-industry challenges, and the scenario is specifically about development and production ramp being too slow for the market window. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.48.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件明确将“上市时间压力”列为半导体行业挑战；题干的核心问题是开发与量产爬坡速度不足以赶上市场窗口。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 48 页。

questions.section: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) / Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD)
questions.text: Which comparison between CVD and PVD is consistent with the Week 1 process descriptions?
questions.text_zh: 以下关于 CVD 与 PVD 的比较，哪项符合 Week 1 的工艺描述？

options.text: CVD physically transfers material from a solid source, while PVD relies on gaseous precursors reacting at the substrate surface.
options.text_zh: CVD 从固体源物理转移材料，而 PVD 依赖气态前驱体在衬底表面发生反应。

options.text: CVD uses gaseous-precursor chemical reactions to form films, while PVD physically vaporizes source material and condenses it on the substrate.
options.text_zh: CVD 通过气态前驱体的化学反应形成薄膜，而 PVD 将源材料物理汽化并在衬底上凝结。

options.text: Both CVD and PVD deposit films by electrochemical reduction of metal ions in a liquid electrolyte.
options.text_zh: CVD 与 PVD 都通过液体电解质中的金属离子电化学还原来沉积薄膜。

options.text: Both CVD and PVD form films primarily through mechanical abrasion of a source against the wafer surface.
options.text_zh: CVD 与 PVD 都主要通过源材料与晶圆表面的机械磨蚀来形成薄膜。

questions.explanation: Week 1 describes CVD as a chemical reaction of gaseous precursors that forms a solid film, whereas PVD uses physical vaporization and condensation to transfer source material to the substrate. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.30, 33.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 将 CVD 描述为气态前驱体通过化学反应形成固体薄膜，而 PVD 则通过物理汽化与凝结把源材料转移到衬底。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 30、33 页。

questions.text: What is the basic control principle shared by the transistor examples in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 课件中晶体管示例所共有的基本控制原理是什么？

options.text: Current between two terminals is fixed and cannot be controlled electrically.
options.text_zh: 两个端子之间的电流固定，无法通过电信号控制。

options.text: The device operates only by converting light into current.
options.text_zh: 器件只通过将光转换成电流来工作。

options.text: The device requires mechanical contacts to open and close the current path.
options.text_zh: 器件需要机械触点来接通和断开电流通路。

options.text: A signal at a third terminal controls current flow between two other terminals, enabling switching or amplification.
options.text_zh: 第三端子上的控制信号调节另外两个端子之间的电流，从而实现开关或放大。

questions.explanation: A transistor controls current between two terminals with a signal applied to a third terminal. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.3.
questions.explanation_zh: 晶体管利用第三端子上的信号控制另外两个端子之间的电流。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 3 页。

questions.text: Why is a Bipolar Junction Transistor (BJT) called “bipolar”?
questions.text_zh: 双极结型晶体管（BJT）为什么称为“双极”？

options.text: It has two insulated gates controlling one channel.
options.text_zh: 它具有两个绝缘栅极控制同一沟道。

options.text: It contains two different gate-oxide materials.
options.text_zh: 它包含两种不同的栅氧化层材料。

options.text: It requires both aluminum and copper interconnects.
options.text_zh: 它必须同时使用铝和铜互连。

options.text: Its operation involves both electrons and holes as charge carriers.
options.text_zh: 其工作涉及电子和空穴两种载流子。

questions.explanation: BJT operation involves both electrons and holes, hence the term bipolar. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.4.
questions.explanation_zh: BJT 工作涉及电子和空穴两种载流子，因此称为双极型。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 4 页。

questions.text: In a MOSFET, what directly controls the conductivity of the source-to-drain channel?
questions.text_zh: 在 MOSFET 中，什么因素直接控制源极到漏极沟道的导电性？

options.text: The solder-reflow profile used during assembly.
options.text_zh: 组装过程中采用的焊料回流曲线。

options.text: Collector current flowing through a bipolar base region.
options.text_zh: 流经双极型基区的集电极电流。

options.text: Mechanical stress from the package mold compound.
options.text_zh: 封装塑封料产生的机械应力。

options.text: The electric field produced by voltage applied to the insulated gate.
options.text_zh: 施加在绝缘栅极上的电压所产生的电场。

questions.explanation: Gate voltage creates an electric field across the oxide that controls channel conductivity. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.6.
questions.explanation_zh: 栅极电压通过氧化层产生电场，从而控制沟道导电性。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 6 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about CMOS operation:
I. CMOS circuits use both n-type and p-type MOSFETs.
II. The complementary devices work in pairs so that one turns on when the other turns off, reducing power consumption.
III. CMOS technology is restricted to analog circuits and is not used for digital logic or memory.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于CMOS 工作原理，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. CMOS 电路同时使用 n 型和 p 型 MOSFET。
II. 互补器件成对工作，一个导通时另一个关断，从而降低功耗。
III. CMOS 技术仅用于模拟电路，不用于数字逻辑或存储器。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

questions.explanation: The lecture describes CMOS as complementary NMOS/PMOS operation that reduces power and notes its wide use in both digital and analog circuits, including memory. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.8.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将 CMOS 描述为 NMOS/PMOS 的互补工作方式，可降低功耗，并指出其广泛用于数字、模拟电路以及存储器。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 8 页。

questions.text: Which combination of advantages motivates BiCMOS integration?
questions.text_zh: BiCMOS 集成主要希望结合哪两类优势？

options.text: Wire-bond perimeter I/O with flip-chip bump elimination.
options.text_zh: 引线键合的周边 I/O 与倒装芯片取消凸点。

options.text: DRAM density with SRAM refresh requirements.
options.text_zh: DRAM 的高密度与 SRAM 的刷新要求。

options.text: Aluminum low resistance with copper low cost.
options.text_zh: 铝的低电阻与铜的低成本。

options.text: BJT high speed/current drive with CMOS low power consumption and high input impedance.
options.text_zh: BJT 的高速/大电流驱动能力与 CMOS 的低功耗和高输入阻抗。

questions.explanation: BiCMOS combines BJT speed/current drive with CMOS low power and high input impedance. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.9.
questions.explanation_zh: BiCMOS 将 BJT 的高速/大电流驱动与 CMOS 的低功耗和高输入阻抗结合起来。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 9 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about DRAM and SRAM:
I. A DRAM cell uses one transistor and one storage capacitor and requires periodic refresh.
II. SRAM stores its bit state in cross-coupled inverters and does not require periodic refresh while powered.
III. Both DRAM and SRAM are nonvolatile and retain data after power is removed.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于DRAM 与 SRAM，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. DRAM 单元采用一个晶体管和一个存储电容，并需要周期性刷新。
II. SRAM 通过交叉耦合反相器保存位状态，在供电期间不需要周期性刷新。
III. DRAM 与 SRAM 都是非易失性存储器，断电后仍能保留数据。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

questions.explanation: DRAM stores charge on a capacitor and needs refresh; SRAM stores state in a flip-flop formed by cross-coupled inverters and does not need periodic refresh. Both are volatile memories. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.15, 17, 19.
questions.explanation_zh: DRAM 依靠电容存储电荷并需要刷新；SRAM 由交叉耦合反相器形成的触发/锁存结构保存状态，不需要周期刷新。二者均属于易失性存储器。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 15、17、19 页。

questions.text: What structural feature enables a flash memory cell to store charge nonvolatily?
questions.text_zh: Flash 存储单元依靠什么结构特征实现非易失性电荷存储？

options.text: A large DRAM-style storage capacitor directly connected to the bit line.
options.text_zh: 一个直接连接位线的大型 DRAM 式存储电容。

options.text: An electrically insulated floating gate between the control gate and channel stores charge.
options.text_zh: 位于控制栅与沟道之间、被介质绝缘包围的浮栅用于存储电荷。

options.text: A pair of cross-coupled CMOS inverters powered continuously.
options.text_zh: 一对持续供电的交叉耦合 CMOS 反相器。

options.text: A through-silicon via stores charge in the vertical interconnect.
options.text_zh: 通过硅通孔在垂直互连中存储电荷。

questions.explanation: The electrically isolated floating gate stores charge that can persist without continuous power. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.20.
questions.explanation_zh: 被电介质隔离的浮栅储存电荷，可在无需持续供电的情况下保持。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 20 页。

questions.text: Which application pairing is consistent with the lecture comparison of NOR and NAND flash?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪种应用匹配符合课件对 NOR 与 NAND Flash 的比较？

options.text: NOR for high-density SSD storage; NAND for random-access embedded code execution.
options.text_zh: NOR 用于高密度 SSD 存储；NAND 用于随机访问的嵌入式代码执行。

options.text: NOR and NAND are presented as having the same access style, density, and cost.
options.text_zh: 课件认为 NOR 与 NAND 的访问方式、密度和成本相同。

options.text: NOR is volatile working memory, while NAND is SRAM-like cache.
options.text_zh: NOR 是易失性工作存储器，而 NAND 类似 SRAM 缓存。

options.text: NOR emphasizes random access and reliability for embedded use, while NAND provides higher-density, lower-cost serial-access storage such as SSDs.
options.text_zh: NOR 强调随机访问与可靠性，适合嵌入式应用；NAND 以更高密度、更低成本提供串行访问存储，例如 SSD。

questions.explanation: NOR emphasizes random access for embedded use; NAND emphasizes dense, lower-cost serial-access storage. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.21.
questions.explanation_zh: NOR 强调嵌入式随机访问；NAND 强调高密度、低成本的串行访问存储。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 21 页。

questions.text: Which statement best distinguishes local from global interconnects on an IC?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪项最准确地区分 IC 上的局部互连与全局互连？

options.text: Local interconnects are always vertical, while global interconnects are always horizontal.
options.text_zh: 局部互连始终垂直，而全局互连始终水平。

options.text: Local interconnects are package leads, while global interconnects exist only inside the silicon substrate.
options.text_zh: 局部互连是封装引脚，而全局互连只存在于硅衬底内部。

options.text: Local interconnects connect nearby devices within small blocks, while global interconnects span longer distances across larger chip regions.
options.text_zh: 局部互连连接小模块内相邻器件，而全局互连跨越更长距离连接芯片较大区域。

options.text: Local interconnects must be copper, while global interconnects must be aluminum.
options.text_zh: 局部互连必须使用铜，而全局互连必须使用铝。

questions.explanation: Local interconnects serve short-range connections; global interconnects span larger chip distances. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.25.
questions.explanation_zh: 局部互连用于短距离连接；全局互连跨越更大的芯片距离。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 25 页。

questions.text: What is the principal function of a Through-Silicon Via (TSV) in 3D integration?
questions.text_zh: 通过硅通孔（TSV）在 3D 集成中的主要功能是什么？

options.text: To provide vertical electrical connections through silicon so stacked circuit layers can be interconnected.
options.text_zh: 通过硅形成垂直电连接，使堆叠的电路层能够互连。

options.text: To act as the gate dielectric of a MOSFET.
options.text_zh: 充当 MOSFET 的栅介质。

options.text: To provide a channel for DI-water cleaning through the die.
options.text_zh: 提供去离子水穿过芯片的清洗通道。

options.text: To form only lateral wiring on the top metal layer.
options.text_zh: 只在顶层金属形成横向布线。

questions.explanation: TSVs create vertical electrical paths through silicon for stacked-die or stacked-layer interconnection. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.26.
questions.explanation_zh: TSV 在硅中形成垂直电通路，实现堆叠芯片或堆叠层之间的互连。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 26 页。

questions.text: Why did copper become attractive relative to aluminum for scaled interconnects?
questions.text_zh: 在互连尺寸缩小时，铜相对于铝为什么更具吸引力？

options.text: Copper has higher resistivity, which intentionally slows signal propagation.
options.text_zh: 铜具有更高电阻率，可有意降低信号传播速度。

options.text: Copper does not diffuse into surrounding dielectrics, so no barrier is needed.
options.text_zh: 铜不会向周围介质扩散，因此不需要阻挡层。

options.text: Copper offers lower electrical resistance and better electromigration resistance than aluminum, supporting higher-performance interconnects.
options.text_zh: 铜比铝具有更低的电阻和更好的抗电迁移能力，有利于高性能互连。

options.text: Copper always reduces manufacturing complexity and cost compared with aluminum.
options.text_zh: 铜在制造复杂度和成本方面始终低于铝。

questions.explanation: The lecture highlights copper's lower resistance and better electromigration resistance, while noting added integration complexity. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.27-31.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件强调铜具有更低电阻和更好的抗电迁移能力，同时也指出其集成工艺更复杂。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 27-31 页。

questions.text: Why is a diffusion barrier used with Cu interconnects?
questions.text_zh: 铜互连中为什么需要扩散阻挡层？

options.text: To store charge between interconnect levels like a memory capacitor.
options.text_zh: 像存储电容一样在互连层间存储电荷。

options.text: To accelerate copper diffusion into the dielectric for better adhesion.
options.text_zh: 促进铜向介质层扩散以提高附着力。

options.text: To eliminate the need for any planarization after copper deposition.
options.text_zh: 完全取消铜沉积后的平坦化工艺。

options.text: To prevent Cu from diffusing into surrounding materials and creating reliability problems.
options.text_zh: 阻止铜向周围材料扩散并引发可靠性问题。

questions.explanation: Cu can diffuse into surrounding materials; barrier layers suppress this diffusion and protect reliability. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.30.
questions.explanation_zh: 铜会向周围材料扩散；阻挡层用于抑制这种扩散并保护可靠性。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 30 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about wire bonding:
I. Wire bonding creates electrical interconnections using fine bonding wires such as Au or Al.
II. The lecture example describes a metallurgical bond between an Au wire and an Al bond pad.
III. Wire bonding forms an area array of solder bumps between the entire die surface and the substrate.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于引线键合，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 引线键合使用 Au、Al 等细金属键合线形成电气互连。
II. 课件示例描述了 Au 键合线与 Al 焊盘之间形成冶金键合。
III. 引线键合在整个芯片表面与基板之间形成面阵列焊料凸点。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: Wire bonding uses fine wires and forms a metallurgical wire-to-pad bond; an area-array solder-bump interconnect describes flip-chip rather than wire bonding. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.40.
questions.explanation_zh: 引线键合通过细金属线形成线到焊盘的冶金连接；面阵列焊料凸点互连属于倒装芯片，而不是引线键合。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 40 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about flip-chip packaging:
I. Flip-chip makes direct electrical connections from the inverted die to a substrate or PCB using bumps or other conductive connections.
II. The lecture lists higher pin density, improved thermal management, and reduced electrical signal delay as motivations for flip-chip.
III. The lecture notes that flip-chip can have reliability issues, but those issues can be improved.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于倒装芯片封装，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 倒装芯片将芯片翻转后，通过凸点或其他导电连接直接连接到基板或 PCB。
II. 课件将更高引脚密度、更好的热管理和更低电信号延迟列为采用倒装芯片的动机。
III. 课件指出倒装芯片可能存在可靠性问题，但这些问题可以通过工程设计加以改善。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: All three statements reflect the lecture description of flip-chip structure, motivations, and the possibility of addressing its reliability issues. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.44.
questions.explanation_zh: 三项陈述分别对应课件对倒装芯片结构、采用动机以及可靠性问题可改善性的描述。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 44 页。

questions.section: Effects of Cu/Low-k on FC Package
questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about thermomechanical reliability of a Cu/low-k flip-chip package:
I. A bump crack near the chip side or substrate can be driven by thermal stress from coefficient-of-thermal-expansion (CTE) mismatch.
II. Underfill properties such as Tg and elastic modulus can influence bump cracking and delamination.
III. Selecting an appropriate underfill can reduce energy release rate and improve package robustness.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于Cu/low-k 倒装芯片封装的热机械可靠性，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 芯片侧或基板侧附近的凸点裂纹可能由热膨胀系数（CTE）失配产生的热应力驱动。
II. 底部填充材料（underfill）的 Tg、弹性模量等性质会影响凸点开裂和分层。
III. 选择合适的 underfill 可降低能量释放率并提高封装稳健性。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

questions.explanation: The lecture links bump cracks to CTE-driven thermal stress, identifies underfill properties as important, and states that appropriate underfill selection can improve robustness. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.45-46.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将凸点裂纹与 CTE 失配产生的热应力联系起来，指出 underfill 性质很关键，并说明合适的 underfill 可提高封装稳健性。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 45-46 页。

questions.section: System in Package (SiP) and Multichip Module (MCM)
questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about SiP and MCM:
I. A System in Package (SiP) can combine multiple ICs and passive components so the package behaves like a mini-system.
II. The lecture states that SiP has lower component density and lower cost than MCM, while MCM offers better performance.
III. A Multichip Module (MCM) contains two or more ICs on an advanced high-wiring-density substrate.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于SiP 与 MCM，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 系统级封装（SiP）可把多个 IC 与无源器件集成在同一基板上，使封装表现为“微型系统”。
II. 课件指出 SiP 的元件密度与成本低于 MCM，而 MCM 的性能更高。
III. 多芯片模块（MCM）在先进高布线密度基板上包含两个或更多 IC。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: The SiP and MCM slides support all three statements: SiP emphasizes mini-system integration, while MCM uses a high-density substrate and is described as denser and higher-performing. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.55, 57.
questions.explanation_zh: SiP 与 MCM 课件页支持三项陈述：SiP 强调微型系统集成，而 MCM 使用高布线密度基板，并被描述为具有更高密度和性能。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 55、57 页。

questions.text: Which test methodology in the lecture is specifically used to characterize time-dependent gate-dielectric breakdown behavior?
questions.text_zh: 课件中哪种测试方法专门用于表征随时间发生的栅介质击穿行为？

options.text: Automated Optical Inspection (AOI).
options.text_zh: 自动光学检测（AOI）。

options.text: Time Dependent Dielectric Breakdown (TDDB).
options.text_zh: 时间相关介质击穿（TDDB）。

options.text: Particles per Wafer per Pass (PWP).
options.text_zh: 每次过机晶圆颗粒数（PWP）。

options.text: Wire-bond pull test.
options.text_zh: 引线键合拉力测试。

questions.explanation: TDDB is the reliability methodology used to assess time-dependent dielectric breakdown and operating lifetime. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.11.
questions.explanation_zh: TDDB 用于评估时间相关介质击穿及其工作寿命。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 11 页。

questions.text: Which ESD model simulates a charged device discharging when it contacts a grounded conductor?
questions.text_zh: 哪种 ESD 模型用于模拟带电器件接触接地导体时发生放电？

options.text: Human Body Model (HBM).
options.text_zh: 人体模型（HBM）。

options.text: Machine Model (MM).
options.text_zh: 机器模型（MM）。

options.text: Charged Device Model (CDM).
options.text_zh: 带电器件模型（CDM）。

options.text: High Temperature Operating Life (HTOL).
options.text_zh: 高温工作寿命（HTOL）。

questions.explanation: CDM models a device that becomes charged and then discharges when it contacts a grounded conductor. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.66.
questions.explanation_zh: CDM 模拟器件自身带电后与接地导体接触而发生放电。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 66 页。

questions.section: Failure Modes: EM, Solder joint & ESD
questions.text: At which structural level does the lecture mainly associate electromigration (EM)?
questions.text_zh: 课件主要将电迁移（EM）与哪个结构层级联系起来？

options.text: The package molding compound only.
options.text_zh: 仅封装塑封料。

options.text: The gate-oxide dielectric only.
options.text_zh: 仅栅氧化介质。

options.text: Metal interconnects carrying high current density.
options.text_zh: 承载高电流密度的金属互连。

options.text: The DRAM storage capacitor only.
options.text_zh: 仅 DRAM 存储电容。

questions.explanation: Electromigration is current-driven atomic movement in metal interconnects and is mainly an interconnect-level failure mechanism. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.69.
questions.explanation_zh: 电迁移是金属互连中由电流驱动的原子迁移，主要属于互连层级失效机制。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 69 页。

questions.section: Bathtub Curve and Product Reliability Tests
questions.text: In a typical bathtub failure-rate curve, what is the interpretation of the early-life region emphasized by the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 在典型“浴盆曲线”的早期寿命区，课件强调的主要含义是什么？

options.text: It is dominated only by long-term wear-out mechanisms after useful life.
options.text_zh: 该阶段只由使用寿命结束后的长期磨损机制主导。

options.text: It is a region in which failures are absent because screening guarantees perfect units.
options.text_zh: 该阶段没有失效，因为筛选可保证器件完全无缺陷。

options.text: It is the constant random-failure region after all weak units have been removed.
options.text_zh: 该阶段是在所有弱单元被去除后形成的恒定随机失效率区。

options.text: It is associated with infant-mortality failures, often involving weak units related to process or device variation that escaped earlier tests.
options.text_zh: 该阶段与早期失效（infant mortality）相关，常涉及由工艺或器件变异造成、并逃逸前序测试的弱单元。

questions.explanation: The early-life portion of the bathtub curve corresponds to infant-mortality failures from weak units that escaped earlier screening. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.64-65.
questions.explanation_zh: 浴盆曲线早期寿命区对应早期失效，常来自逃逸前序筛选的弱单元。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 64-65 页。

questions.text: Why must a DRAM cell be rewritten after a normal read operation according to the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，为什么 DRAM 单元在正常读取后需要重新写回数据？

options.text: The word line remains inactive after read, preventing the access transistor from reconnecting to the cell.
options.text_zh: 读取后字线保持非激活状态，使访问晶体管无法再次连接到存储单元。

options.text: The sense amplifier erases a cross-coupled latch that normally stores the DRAM bit state.
options.text_zh: 感应放大器会擦除原本用于存储 DRAM 位状态的交叉耦合锁存器。

options.text: Storage-capacitor charge redistributes onto the bit line, disturbing the stored state and requiring a rewrite.
options.text_zh: 存储电容电荷重新分配到位线上，扰动原有存储状态，因此需要重新写回。

options.text: Electrons tunnel out of a floating gate during every read, so the nonvolatile state must be restored.
options.text_zh: 每次读取时电子都会从浮栅隧穿逸出，因此需要恢复非易失状态。

questions.explanation: The DRAM read operation redistributes the storage-capacitor charge onto the bit-line capacitance. Because this disturbs the stored data, a simultaneous rewrite is required. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.16.
questions.explanation_zh: DRAM 读取时，存储电容的电荷会重新分配到位线电容。由于该过程会破坏原有存储状态，因此需要同时重新写回数据。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 16 页。

questions.text: Which group is classified in the lecture as resistance-change memory rather than charge-storage memory?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪一组在课件中被归类为电阻变化型存储器，而不是电荷存储型存储器？

options.text: SRAM, DRAM, and flash memory.
options.text_zh: SRAM、DRAM 和 Flash 存储器。

options.text: PRAM, FRAM, MRAM, and RRAM.
options.text_zh: PRAM、FRAM、MRAM 和 RRAM。

options.text: DRAM, flash memory, and EEPROM.
options.text_zh: DRAM、Flash 存储器和 EEPROM。

options.text: SRAM, DRAM, and EEPROM.
options.text_zh: SRAM、DRAM 和 EEPROM。

questions.explanation: The lecture places SRAM, DRAM, and flash in the charge-storage category, while PRAM, FRAM, MRAM, and RRAM are identified as resistance-change memory technologies. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.12.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将 SRAM、DRAM 和 Flash 归入电荷存储型，而将 PRAM、FRAM、MRAM 和 RRAM 列为电阻变化型存储技术。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 12 页。

questions.text: An interconnect redesign aims specifically to reduce the capacitance term of RC delay without changing the conductor material. Which change is most consistent with the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 某互连重新设计的目标是在不改变导体材料的前提下，专门降低 RC 延迟中的电容项。根据课件，哪种改变最符合这一目标？

options.text: Use a lower-k surrounding dielectric so the interconnect capacitance is reduced.
options.text_zh: 采用更低 k 值的周围介电材料，以降低互连电容。

options.text: Increase the thickness of the copper diffusion barrier while keeping the dielectric unchanged.
options.text_zh: 在介电材料不变的情况下增加铜扩散阻挡层厚度。

options.text: Replace copper with aluminum while keeping the same geometry and dielectric material.
options.text_zh: 在几何尺寸和介电材料不变的情况下将铜替换为铝。

options.text: Increase interconnect current density while keeping geometry and dielectric material unchanged.
options.text_zh: 在几何尺寸和介电材料不变的情况下提高互连电流密度。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that interconnect capacitance is governed mainly by geometry and the surrounding dielectric; changing Al to Cu affects resistance rather than directly changing capacitance. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.32.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，互连电容主要由几何结构和周围介电材料决定；Al 与 Cu 的选择主要影响电阻，而不会直接改变电容。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 32 页。

questions.text: A multilevel Cu interconnect process needs electrical insulation between metal levels and an etch-stop function for dual-damascene patterning. Which material class in the lecture provides these roles?
questions.text_zh: 某多层 Cu 互连工艺既需要金属层之间的电绝缘，又需要双镶嵌图形化中的刻蚀停止功能。课件中哪类材料承担这些作用？

options.text: A dielectric thin film that provides electrical insulation and an etch-stop function.
options.text_zh: 介电薄膜，用于提供电绝缘并承担刻蚀停止功能。

options.text: A copper seed film used to support subsequent copper deposition.
options.text_zh: 用于支持后续铜沉积的铜种子层。

options.text: An aluminum interconnect film used primarily as the conductive signal path.
options.text_zh: 铝互连薄膜，主要用作导电信号通路。

options.text: A solder-bump metal used to make package-level chip-to-substrate connections.
options.text_zh: 焊凸点金属，用于实现封装级芯片到基板的连接。

questions.explanation: The dielectric-thin-film slide lists electrical insulation in multilevel interconnects as the main role and also identifies etch-stop and cap-barrier functions in Cu/low-k integration. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.24.
questions.explanation_zh: 介电薄膜课件将多层互连中的电绝缘列为其主要作用，同时还列出了 Cu/low-k 集成中的刻蚀停止层和盖层阻挡层功能。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 24 页。

questions.text: Why can an advanced package with a higher component-level cost still be economically attractive according to the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，为什么单个器件层面成本更高的先进封装仍可能具有经济吸引力？

options.text: The package itself is generally cheaper, so total system cost falls even if PCB assembly remains unchanged.
options.text_zh: 封装本身通常更便宜，因此即使 PCB 装配不变，系统总成本也会下降。

options.text: Improved integration can simplify PCB-level assembly enough that lower system-level manufacturing cost offsets the higher package cost.
options.text_zh: 更高的集成度可简化 PCB 级装配，使系统级制造成本的下降抵消更高的封装成本。

options.text: The higher package cost is offset mainly by reducing the need for device-level reliability qualification and testing.
options.text_zh: 更高的封装成本主要通过减少器件级可靠性认证与测试需求来抵消。

options.text: The package is selected mainly to minimize package-material cost, while thermal and electrical performance are secondary considerations.
options.text_zh: 封装选择主要以降低封装材料成本为目标，而热性能和电性能属于次要考虑。

questions.explanation: The lecture emphasizes that advanced-package selection is application driven and that higher package cost can be offset by lower overall system manufacturing cost through simpler PCB assembly. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.50.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件强调先进封装的选择由应用驱动；虽然封装本身可能更贵，但通过简化 PCB 装配，整体系统制造成本可能更低，从而抵消额外封装成本。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 50 页。

questions.text: A new die becomes larger while its package pin count rises and bond-pad pitch becomes smaller. Which assembly implication is consistent with the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 某新芯片尺寸增大，同时封装引脚数增加且键合焊盘间距减小。根据课件，这会带来哪种装配影响？

options.text: Package shear stress decreases and assembly becomes easier because more pins distribute the load.
options.text_zh: 封装剪切应力降低，且更多引脚分担载荷使装配更容易。

options.text: Package shear stress and assembly difficulty remain essentially unchanged by die size and pad pitch.
options.text_zh: 封装剪切应力和装配难度基本不受芯片尺寸与焊盘间距影响。

options.text: Package shear stress decreases, while the tighter pad pitch mainly adds difficulty to electrical probing rather than assembly.
options.text_zh: 封装剪切应力降低，而更小焊盘间距主要增加电探针测试难度，而非装配难度。

options.text: Package shear stress increases, and the higher pin count with tighter pad pitch makes assembly more challenging.
options.text_zh: 封装剪切应力增加，同时更高引脚数和更小焊盘间距使装配更具挑战。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that a larger chip has higher shear stress in the package, while higher pin count and smaller bond-pad pitch add assembly challenges. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.38.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，大尺寸芯片会带来更高的封装剪切应力，而更高的引脚数和更小的键合焊盘间距会增加装配难度。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 38 页。

questions.text: A reliability engineer wants to accelerate failures caused by thermal-expansion mismatch among die and package layers. Which test is the most directly targeted choice in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 可靠性工程师希望加速由芯片与封装各层之间热膨胀失配引起的失效。课件中最直接针对该机制的测试是哪一种？

options.text: High Temperature Bake (HTB), which evaluates thermally activated degradation under storage conditions.
options.text_zh: 高温烘烤（High Temperature Bake, HTB），用于评估存储条件下的热激活退化。

options.text: Temperature Humidity Bias (THB), which accelerates moisture penetration under temperature, humidity, and electrical bias.
options.text_zh: 温湿偏压（Temperature Humidity Bias, THB），利用温度、湿度和电偏压加速水汽侵入。

options.text: Temperature Cycling (TC), which repeatedly changes temperature to stress the die/package structure.
options.text_zh: 温度循环（Temperature Cycling, TC），通过反复改变温度对芯片/封装结构施加应力。

options.text: ESD Human Body Model (HBM), which simulates a person discharging through a device lead.
options.text_zh: ESD 人体模型（HBM），模拟人体通过器件引脚发生静电放电。

questions.explanation: The lecture describes Temperature Cycling as an accelerated environmental life test intended to study the effects of thermal-expansion mismatch among layers and components in the die/package system. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.65.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将温度循环描述为加速环境寿命测试，用于研究芯片与封装系统中不同层和组件之间热膨胀失配的影响。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 65 页。

questions.text: Which reliability test is intended to study time-and-temperature effects under storage conditions, including thermally activated nonvolatile-memory data-retention failure mechanisms?
questions.text_zh: 哪种可靠性测试用于研究存储条件下时间与温度的影响，包括非易失性存储器的热激活数据保持失效机制？

options.text: High Temperature Bake (HTB), focused on thermally activated mechanisms during storage.
options.text_zh: 高温烘烤（HTB），重点考察存储期间的热激活失效机制。

options.text: Temperature Cycling (TC), focused on repeated thermal-expansion mismatch across package structures.
options.text_zh: 温度循环（TC），重点考察封装结构反复热膨胀失配。

options.text: Temperature Humidity Bias (THB), focused on moisture penetration under humidity and electrical bias.
options.text_zh: 温湿偏压（THB），重点考察湿度与电偏压条件下的水汽侵入。

options.text: Ball Shear (BS), focused on mechanical strength of metallurgical bonds at package bonding surfaces.
options.text_zh: 球剪切（Ball Shear, BS），重点考察封装键合表面冶金接合的机械强度。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines HTB as a storage-condition test for the effect of time and temperature on thermally activated failure mechanisms, including nonvolatile-memory data retention. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.65.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将 HTB 定义为存储条件测试，用于评估时间和温度对热激活失效机制的影响，其中包括非易失性存储器的数据保持失效。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 65 页。

questions.text: A gate-insulating material is subjected to a voltage above its breakdown voltage and loses its insulating function. Which failure mode and structural level best match the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 某栅极绝缘材料承受超过其击穿电压的电压后失去绝缘能力。根据课件，这最符合哪种失效模式及主要结构层级？

options.text: Electromigration at the interconnection level caused by current-driven metal-atom movement.
options.text_zh: 互连层级的电迁移，由电流驱动的金属原子迁移引起。

options.text: Solder-joint failure at the package level caused by weak or degraded solder connections.
options.text_zh: 封装层级的焊点失效，由焊接连接弱化或退化引起。

options.text: Thermal stress, which can occur at device, interconnect, or package levels due to overheating.
options.text_zh: 热应力，可因过热发生在器件、互连或封装等不同层级。

options.text: Dielectric breakdown, occurring mainly at the device level when an insulator exceeds its breakdown voltage.
options.text_zh: 介质击穿，主要发生在器件层级，原因是绝缘材料承受电压超过其击穿电压。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines dielectric breakdown as failure of an insulating material when the applied voltage exceeds its breakdown voltage and notes that it occurs mostly at the device level. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.68.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将介质击穿定义为绝缘材料在外加电压超过击穿电压时发生的失效，并指出其主要发生在器件层级。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 68 页。

questions.section: Failure Modes: EM, Solder joint & ESD
questions.text: An assembled device develops intermittent electrical connection because a package solder joint has weakened after service. Which failure mode is the most direct match?
questions.text_zh: 某已装配器件在使用后因封装焊点弱化而出现间歇性电连接。最直接对应哪种失效模式？

options.text: Solder-joint failure at the package level, which can produce open or intermittent connections.
options.text_zh: 封装层级的焊点失效，可导致开路或间歇性连接。

options.text: Dielectric breakdown in a device insulator after exceeding its breakdown voltage.
options.text_zh: 器件绝缘层在超过击穿电压后发生的介质击穿。

options.text: Electromigration in a metal interconnect caused by current-driven atomic movement.
options.text_zh: 金属互连中由电流驱动原子迁移引起的电迁移。

options.text: Electrostatic discharge damage caused by a sudden high-voltage static-electricity event.
options.text_zh: 由瞬时高电压静电事件引起的静电放电损伤。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that weak or degraded solder joints can cause open circuits or intermittent connections and identifies this as a package-level failure mode. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.69.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，弱化或退化的焊点可导致开路或间歇性连接，并将其归为封装层级的失效模式。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 69 页。

questions.text: Which mapping of FEOL, BEOL, and FBEOL is consistent with the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪种 FEOL、BEOL 与 FBEOL 的对应关系符合课件？

options.text: All three terms refer to the same set of wafer-cleaning steps.
options.text_zh: 三者都指同一组晶圆清洗步骤。

options.text: BEOL forms active transistors, while FEOL is limited to final electrical test.
options.text_zh: BEOL 形成有源晶体管，而 FEOL 仅进行最终电测。

options.text: FEOL forms active devices, BEOL forms interconnect layers, and FBEOL covers packaging and testing/advanced packaging.
options.text_zh: FEOL 形成有源器件，BEOL 形成互连层，FBEOL 涵盖封装与测试/先进封装。

options.text: FEOL performs packaging, BEOL grows the crystal, and FBEOL forms transistors.
options.text_zh: FEOL 进行封装，BEOL 生长晶体，FBEOL 形成晶体管。

questions.explanation: FEOL forms active components, BEOL forms interconnects, and FBEOL covers packaging and testing. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.4.
questions.explanation_zh: FEOL 形成有源器件，BEOL 形成互连，FBEOL 涵盖封装与测试。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 4 页。

questions.text: In the Czochralski (CZ) method, how is a single-crystal silicon ingot formed?
questions.text_zh: 在 Czochralski（CZ）法中，单晶硅锭如何形成？

options.text: Silicon vapor is deposited onto a stationary wafer until a bulk ingot forms.
options.text_zh: 将硅蒸气沉积到静止晶圆上，直至形成块状硅锭。

options.text: A seed crystal is dipped into molten silicon and slowly pulled while a cylindrical single crystal grows.
options.text_zh: 将籽晶浸入熔融硅并缓慢提拉，从而生长出圆柱形单晶。

options.text: Polycrystalline silicon is anisotropically etched into a single crystal.
options.text_zh: 通过各向异性刻蚀把多晶硅转变为单晶。

options.text: CMP mechanically aligns grains until a single crystal is produced.
options.text_zh: 通过 CMP 机械对齐晶粒以形成单晶。

questions.explanation: CZ growth uses a seed crystal dipped into molten silicon and slowly pulled to form a cylindrical single-crystal ingot. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.6.
questions.explanation_zh: CZ 法将籽晶浸入熔融硅并缓慢提拉，形成圆柱形单晶硅锭。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 6 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about pre-oxidation wafer cleaning:
I. Particles and contaminants can act as nucleation sites for undesirable crystallization during oxide growth.
II. Crystalline boundaries in nonuniform oxide can provide paths for impurities and moisture.
III. Pre-oxidation cleaning is intended to leave native oxide, particles, and organic contamination in place to stabilize oxidation.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于预氧化晶圆清洗，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 颗粒和污染物可能在氧化层生长过程中成为不良结晶的成核点。
II. 不均匀结晶氧化物中的晶界可能为杂质和水分提供迁移通道。
III. 预氧化清洗的目的在于保留自然氧化层、颗粒和有机污染，以稳定后续氧化。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

questions.explanation: The lecture emphasizes removing particles, contaminants, native oxide and surface defects before oxidation because contamination can nucleate nonuniform crystalline oxide and impurity/moisture paths. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.8.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件强调氧化前应去除颗粒、污染物、自然氧化层和表面缺陷，因为污染会诱发不均匀结晶氧化物，并形成杂质/水分通道。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 8 页。

questions.text: Which contaminant-removal assignment is correct for RCA cleaning?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪项关于 RCA 清洗去除污染物的对应关系是正确的？

options.text: SC-1 targets organic contamination/particles, while SC-2 targets metal ions and inorganic contaminants.
options.text_zh: SC-1 针对有机污染/颗粒，而 SC-2 针对金属离子和无机污染。

options.text: SC-1 primarily removes metal ions, while SC-2 primarily removes organic contamination and particles.
options.text_zh: SC-1 主要去除金属离子，而 SC-2 主要去除有机污染和颗粒。

options.text: Both SC-1 and SC-2 are used only to grow thermal oxide.
options.text_zh: SC-1 和 SC-2 都只用于生长热氧化层。

options.text: SC-1 is an ion-implantation chemistry, while SC-2 is a CMP slurry.
options.text_zh: SC-1 是离子注入化学体系，而 SC-2 是 CMP 浆料。

questions.explanation: SC-1 removes organic contaminants and particles; SC-2 removes metal ions and other inorganic contaminants. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.9-10.
questions.explanation_zh: SC-1 去除有机污染和颗粒；SC-2 去除金属离子及其他无机污染物。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 9-10 页。

questions.text: Which dry-cleaning method removes hydrocarbons by using UV excitation and ozone/atomic oxygen chemistry?
questions.text_zh: 哪种干法清洗利用 UV 激发以及臭氧/原子氧化学反应去除烃类污染？

options.text: Ultraviolet Ozone Cleaning (UVOC).
options.text_zh: 紫外臭氧清洗（UVOC）。

options.text: Ar/H₂ plasma cleaning.
options.text_zh: Ar/H₂ 等离子体清洗。

options.text: Thermal cleaning in UHV.
options.text_zh: 超高真空下的热清洗。

options.text: RCA-2 wet cleaning.
options.text_zh: RCA-2 湿法清洗。

questions.explanation: UVOC uses UV excitation to generate reactive oxygen species that oxidize hydrocarbons into volatile products. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.12-15.
questions.explanation_zh: UVOC 利用 UV 激发生成活性氧物种，将烃类污染氧化为挥发性产物。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 12-15 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about dry and wet thermal oxidation:
I. Dry oxidation has a lower oxide growth rate than wet oxidation.
II. Dry oxidation provides better oxide quality and is used for thin screen, pad, and gate oxides.
III. Wet oxidation is identified as the preferred process for the highest-quality thin gate oxide because it grows more slowly than dry oxidation.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于干氧化与湿氧化，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 干氧化的氧化层生长速率低于湿氧化。
II. 干氧化具有更好的氧化层质量，适用于较薄的 screen oxide、pad oxide 和 gate oxide。
III. 湿氧化因生长速率低于干氧化而被课件列为最高质量薄栅氧的首选工艺。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that dry oxidation is slower but produces better-quality oxide and is used for thin oxides; the third statement reverses that relationship. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.17-18.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出干氧化生长较慢但氧化层质量更好，并用于薄氧化层；第三项将这一关系颠倒了。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 17-18 页。

questions.text: A lithography process needs shorter exposure time without sacrificing resist stability. Which photoresist parameter is being optimized?
questions.text_zh: 某光刻工艺希望缩短曝光时间，同时不能牺牲光刻胶稳定性。此时主要在优化哪项光刻胶参数？

options.text: Etch selectivity.
options.text_zh: 刻蚀选择比。

options.text: Electromigration resistance.
options.text_zh: 抗电迁移能力。

options.text: Photoresist sensitivity.
options.text_zh: 光刻胶灵敏度。

options.text: Coefficient of thermal expansion.
options.text_zh: 热膨胀系数。

questions.explanation: Higher photoresist sensitivity reduces required exposure dose/time, although excessive sensitivity can reduce stability. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.24-25.
questions.explanation_zh: 更高的光刻胶灵敏度可降低所需曝光剂量和时间，但过高会降低稳定性。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 24-25 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about optical wafer exposure systems:
I. Contact exposure can provide high resolution, but hard mask-to-resist contact can cause damage.
II. Proximity exposure introduces a 5–25 μm gap, and diffraction across the gap degrades resolution.
III. Projection exposure keeps the mask separated from the wafer and uses an optical system to image the mask, providing high resolution that is still diffraction-limited.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于光学晶圆曝光系统，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 接触式曝光可获得高分辨率，但掩膜与光刻胶硬接触可能造成损伤。
II. 接近式曝光在掩膜与晶圆之间保留 5–25 μm 间隙，间隙引起的衍射会降低分辨率。
III. 投影式曝光使掩膜与晶圆分离，并利用光学系统成像，可获得高分辨率但仍受光衍射限制。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

questions.explanation: All three statements reproduce the lecture comparison of contact, proximity, and projection exposure. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.28.
questions.explanation_zh: 三项陈述均与课件对接触式、接近式和投影式曝光的比较一致。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 28 页。

questions.text: Why is electron-beam lithography (EBL) mainly used for applications such as mask writing rather than high-volume wafer production?
questions.text_zh: 为什么电子束光刻（EBL）主要用于掩模写入等应用，而不适合大批量晶圆生产？

options.text: It provides very high resolution but has low throughput because it is a direct-writing technique.
options.text_zh: 它具有很高分辨率，但由于是直接写入技术，吞吐量较低。

options.text: It has low resolution but extremely high full-wafer throughput.
options.text_zh: 它分辨率低，但整片晶圆吞吐量极高。

options.text: It requires hard contact between a photomask and resist.
options.text_zh: 它要求光掩模与光刻胶硬接触。

options.text: It can pattern only millimeter-scale thick films.
options.text_zh: 它只能图形化毫米尺度厚膜。

questions.explanation: EBL offers very high resolution but low throughput because it writes patterns directly. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.31.
questions.explanation_zh: EBL 具有很高分辨率，但由于直接写入，吞吐量较低。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 31 页。

questions.text: Why is simply maximizing etch rate not always desirable?
questions.text_zh: 为什么不能单纯追求最高刻蚀速率？

options.text: A higher etch rate simultaneously improves throughput, selectivity, profile control, and damage performance.
options.text_zh: 更高刻蚀速率会同时改善吞吐量、选择比、轮廓控制和损伤表现。

options.text: A lower etch rate always produces worse selectivity and more wafer damage than a higher etch rate.
options.text_zh: 较低刻蚀速率总会导致更差选择比和更多晶圆损伤。

options.text: Etch rate affects only throughput and has no relationship to selectivity, profile, or damage.
options.text_zh: 刻蚀速率只影响吞吐量，与选择比、轮廓或损伤无关。

options.text: A higher etch rate may improve throughput but can trade off against selectivity and process-induced damage.
options.text_zh: 更高刻蚀速率可能提高吞吐量，但会与选择比和工艺损伤之间产生权衡。

questions.explanation: The lecture emphasizes a tradeoff: higher etch rate can improve throughput but may reduce selectivity and increase damage. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.40.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件强调权衡：更高刻蚀速率可提高吞吐量，但可能降低选择比并增加损伤。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 40 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about etch selectivity:
I. Etch selectivity is defined from the ratio of etch rates of different materials.
II. High selectivity of the target film relative to the substrate and mask supports critical-dimension and profile control.
III. Selectivity influences how much mask thickness is required for a pattern-transfer etch.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于刻蚀选择比，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 刻蚀选择比由不同材料的刻蚀速率之比定义。
II. 目标薄膜相对于衬底和掩膜具有高选择比，有助于关键尺寸（CD）和轮廓控制。
III. 选择比会影响图形转移刻蚀所需的掩膜厚度。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

questions.explanation: The etch-selectivity slide defines selectivity by relative etch rates and links good selectivity to substrate/mask protection, CD/profile control, and mask-thickness requirements. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.41.
questions.explanation_zh: 刻蚀选择比课件页以相对刻蚀速率定义选择比，并将良好选择比与衬底/掩膜保护、CD/轮廓控制以及掩膜厚度要求联系起来。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 41 页。

questions.text: A process requires vertical sidewalls for a critical small feature. Which method is generally more suitable according to the lecture comparison?
questions.text_zh: 某工艺需要在关键小尺寸结构上获得接近垂直的侧壁。根据课件比较，通常哪种方法更合适？

options.text: Wet etching because its isotropic nature inherently gives vertical sidewalls.
options.text_zh: 湿法刻蚀，因为其各向同性天然可形成垂直侧壁。

options.text: Dry plasma etching because directional ion-assisted removal can provide stronger anisotropy and better profile control.
options.text_zh: 干法等离子体刻蚀，因为定向离子辅助去除可提供更强各向异性与更好的轮廓控制。

options.text: CMP because it transfers resist patterns into vertical trenches.
options.text_zh: CMP，因为它可把光刻胶图形转移成垂直沟槽。

options.text: RCA cleaning because it is an anisotropic pattern-transfer process.
options.text_zh: RCA 清洗，因为它属于各向异性图形转移工艺。

questions.explanation: Dry plasma etching provides stronger anisotropy and profile control than generally isotropic wet etching. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.45, 47, 48, 50.
questions.explanation_zh: 干法等离子体刻蚀通常比各向同性湿法刻蚀具有更强各向异性和轮廓控制能力。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 45、47、48、50 页。

questions.text: What control advantage does ion implantation have over diffusion for doping?
questions.text_zh: 与扩散掺杂相比，离子注入的主要控制优势是什么？

options.text: Set both concentration and junction depth mainly through the same furnace time-temperature diffusion budget.
options.text_zh: 主要通过同一炉管时间—温度扩散热预算同时决定浓度和结深。

options.text: Lose spatial selectivity because ion implantation cannot be patterned with masking layers.
options.text_zh: 由于离子注入不能使用掩膜形成选择性区域，因此失去空间选择性。

options.text: Use ion energy mainly to set total dose and use dose mainly to set penetration depth.
options.text_zh: 主要用离子能量决定总剂量、用注入剂量决定穿透深度。
