options.text: Use implant dose mainly to set dopant concentration and ion energy mainly to set penetration depth, giving relatively independent control.
options.text_zh: 主要用注入剂量控制掺杂浓度、用离子能量控制穿透深度，从而实现相对独立的控制。

questions.explanation: Ion implantation provides better independent control of dopant dose and penetration depth than diffusion. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.51-52.
questions.explanation_zh: 离子注入比扩散更能独立控制掺杂剂量和注入深度。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 51-52 页。

questions.text: Why is Rapid Thermal Annealing (RTA) used after ion implantation?
questions.text_zh: 为什么离子注入后要使用快速热退火（RTA）？

options.text: Deposit a dielectric cap over implanted regions instead of thermally repairing the crystal.
options.text_zh: 在注入区上沉积介质盖层，以取代对晶格的热修复。

options.text: Use a long furnace diffusion to drive the implanted dopants much deeper into silicon.
options.text_zh: 使用长时间炉管扩散，使已注入掺杂剂进一步深扩散。

options.text: Repair implantation damage with a short high-temperature anneal while limiting unwanted dopant diffusion.
options.text_zh: 通过短时高温退火修复注入损伤，同时限制不希望的掺杂剂扩散。

options.text: Strip photoresist while deliberately leaving implantation-induced lattice damage unchanged.
options.text_zh: 去除光刻胶，同时有意保留离子注入造成的晶格损伤。

questions.explanation: RTA repairs implantation damage while minimizing dopant redistribution by using a short high-temperature thermal cycle. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.53.
questions.explanation_zh: RTA 通过短时高温热处理修复注入损伤，同时尽量减少掺杂再分布。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 53 页。

questions.text: Which comparison between CVD and PVD is consistent with the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪项 CVD 与 PVD 的比较符合课件？

options.text: CVD generally provides better step coverage, while PVD can provide high-quality, low-impurity, low-resistivity metal films.
options.text_zh: CVD 通常具有更好的台阶覆盖，而 PVD 可获得高质量、低杂质、低电阻率的金属薄膜。

options.text: PVD uses gaseous precursors and relies on a surface chemical reaction, while CVD uses solid targets.
options.text_zh: PVD 使用气相前驱体并依赖表面化学反应，而 CVD 使用固体靶材。

options.text: CVD and PVD use the same source phase and the same deposition mechanism.
options.text_zh: CVD 与 PVD 使用相同源相态和相同沉积机理。

options.text: PVD is limited to silicon-dioxide growth and is not used in metallization.
options.text_zh: PVD 仅限于二氧化硅生长，不用于金属化。

questions.explanation: CVD generally offers better step coverage, while PVD is well suited to high-quality low-impurity metal films. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.54, 57, 58.
questions.explanation_zh: CVD 通常具有更好的台阶覆盖，而 PVD 适合获得高质量、低杂质的金属薄膜。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 54、57、58 页。

questions.text: In copper damascene integration, what is the role of ECP?
questions.text_zh: 在铜镶嵌（damascene）集成中，ECP 的作用是什么？

options.text: CMP removes Cu overburden from the wafer surface after the recessed features have been filled.
options.text_zh: CMP 在凹槽结构填充后去除晶圆表面的 Cu 过覆盖层。

options.text: Dry etch forms the dielectric trenches and vias before the metallization steps begin.
options.text_zh: 干法刻蚀在金属化开始之前形成介质沟槽和通孔。

options.text: ECP fills the patterned trenches and vias with Cu after the barrier/seed structure has been prepared.
options.text_zh: ECP 在阻挡层/种子层准备完成后，用 Cu 填充已图形化的沟槽和通孔。

options.text: PVD forms the barrier/seed structure that prepares the features for subsequent Cu filling.
options.text_zh: PVD 形成阻挡层/种子层，为后续 Cu 填充做准备。

questions.explanation: ECP fills patterned dielectric trenches and vias with Cu before excess copper is removed by CMP. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.59-60.
questions.explanation_zh: ECP 在 CMP 去除多余铜之前，将铜填充到已图形化的介质沟槽和通孔中。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 59-60 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about CMP in advanced interconnect integration:
I. For feature sizes below about 0.35 μm, the lecture states that global planarization requires CMP.
II. CMP removes film through a combination of chemical reaction and mechanical polishing.
III. For Cu interconnects, CMP is central to damascene integration because excess Cu/barrier material is removed after filling patterned dielectric features.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于先进互连集成中的 CMP，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 对于约 0.35 μm 以下的特征尺寸，课件指出全局平坦化需要采用 CMP。
II. CMP 通过化学反应与机械抛光相结合的方式去除薄膜。
III. 对于 Cu 互连，CMP 是镶嵌集成的关键步骤，因为在填充介质图形后需要去除表面的多余 Cu/阻挡层材料。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: The planarization and CMP slides support all three statements, including CMP-based global planarization and Cu damascene metal removal. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.61-63.
questions.explanation_zh: 平坦化与 CMP 课件页支持三项陈述，包括基于 CMP 的全局平坦化以及 Cu 镶嵌工艺中的多余金属去除。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 61-63 页。

questions.text: Why is intermetallic-compound (IMC) formation important in Au-Al wire bonding?
questions.text_zh: 为什么 Au-Al 引线键合中的金属间化合物（IMC）形成很重要？

options.text: A continuous IMC layer supports bond reliability, but excessive IMC growth can become detrimental.
options.text_zh: 连续 IMC 层有助于键合可靠性，但过度 IMC 生长可能产生不利影响。

options.text: Bond reliability improves monotonically as the IMC layer becomes thicker, so maximum IMC growth is preferred.
options.text_zh: IMC 层越厚键合可靠性越高，因此应尽可能促进 IMC 生长。

options.text: IMC affects only electrical resistance and has no relationship to metallurgical bond integrity or reliability.
options.text_zh: IMC 只影响电阻，与冶金键合完整性或可靠性无关。

options.text: Reliable Au-Al bonding requires eliminating IMC formation so only an unmixed Au/Al interface remains.
options.text_zh: 可靠 Au-Al 键合要求完全消除 IMC，只保留未混合的 Au/Al 界面。

questions.explanation: A continuous Al-Au IMC supports good bonding, but excessive IMC growth during aging can become harmful. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.70-71.
questions.explanation_zh: 连续 Al-Au IMC 有助于良好键合，但老化过程中过度生长会产生不利影响。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 70-71 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about Under Bump Metallisation (UBM):
I. UBM is a primary electrical and mechanical interface and must adhere well to both the substrate and solder.
II. UBM commonly uses multiple thin-film metal layers to provide adhesion, barrier, wetting, and anti-oxidation functions.
III. The lecture describes UBM as a single dielectric layer whose only function is to prevent current flow into the solder bump.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于凸点下金属化（UBM），考虑陈述 I–III：
I. UBM 是主要的电气与机械接口，需要同时对衬底和焊料具有良好附着力。
II. UBM 通常采用多层金属薄膜，分别提供附着、阻挡、润湿和抗氧化等功能。
III. 课件将 UBM 描述为单层介质膜，其唯一作用是阻止电流进入焊料凸点。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

questions.explanation: The UBM slide describes a multilayer metal interface providing electrical/mechanical connection plus adhesion, barrier, wetting and oxidation-protection functions. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.74.
questions.explanation_zh: UBM 课件页将其描述为多层金属接口，用于电气/机械连接，并承担附着、阻挡、润湿和抗氧化保护等功能。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 74 页。

questions.text: What is the purpose of lightly doped drain/source-drain extension (LDD/SDE) regions in the MOS transistor flow shown in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 在课件所示 MOS 晶体管工艺流程中，轻掺杂漏区/源漏延伸区（LDD/SDE）的主要目的是什么？

options.text: To form a vertical through-silicon interconnect.
options.text_zh: 形成垂直 TSV 互连。

options.text: To increase particle capture near the gate edge.
options.text_zh: 增加栅边缘附近的颗粒捕获。

options.text: To reduce the electric-field severity near the drain and suppress hot-carrier injection.
options.text_zh: 降低漏端附近的电场强度，从而抑制热载流子注入。

options.text: To eliminate the need for sidewall spacers in all devices.
options.text_zh: 在所有器件中取消侧墙间隔层。

questions.explanation: LDD/SDE reduces drain-edge electric-field severity and helps suppress hot-carrier injection. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.79-80.
questions.explanation_zh: LDD/SDE 降低漏端边缘电场强度，从而帮助抑制热载流子注入。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 79-80 页。

questions.text: In Ar/H2 plasma cleaning, which division of contaminant-removal mechanisms is described in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 在 Ar/H2 等离子体清洗中，课件描述的污染物去除机制分工是什么？

options.text: Ar+ and H+ act mainly by heating the wafer until oxide and metal-oxide contaminants vaporize.
options.text_zh: Ar+ 和 H+ 主要通过加热晶圆，使氧化物与金属氧化物污染物汽化。

options.text: Ar+ and H+ rely mainly on ultraviolet excitation to generate ozone for hydrocarbon oxidation.
options.text_zh: Ar+ 和 H+ 主要依赖紫外激发产生臭氧，用于氧化烃类污染物。

options.text: Ar+ removes impurities mainly by physical action, while H+ removes impurities mainly through chemical reaction.
options.text_zh: Ar+ 主要通过物理作用去除污染物，而 H+ 主要通过化学反应去除污染物。

options.text: Ar+ removes impurities mainly through chemical reaction, while H+ removes impurities mainly by physical sputtering.
options.text_zh: Ar+ 主要通过化学反应去除污染物，而 H+ 主要通过物理溅射去除污染物。

questions.explanation: The slide states that RF-excited Ar+ is attracted to the wafer and removes impurities physically, whereas H+ removes impurities through chemical reaction. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.14.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，RF 激发形成的 Ar+ 被吸引到晶圆表面并以物理方式去除污染物，而 H+ 则通过化学反应去除污染物。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 14 页。

questions.text: Which condition-and-mechanism pair matches the thermal-cleaning method described in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪一组条件与机制符合课件所述的热清洗方法？

options.text: Room-temperature ozone exposure that oxidizes hydrocarbons under atmospheric pressure.
options.text_zh: 在大气压下使用室温臭氧氧化烃类污染物。

options.text: Heating the wafer above about 800°C in ultra-high vacuum to vaporize oxide or metal-oxide particles.
options.text_zh: 在超高真空中将晶圆加热至约 800°C 以上，使氧化物或金属氧化物颗粒汽化。

options.text: RF excitation of argon plasma to remove contaminants by ion bombardment at low temperature.
options.text_zh: 利用 RF 激发氩等离子体，在较低温度下通过离子轰击去除污染物。

options.text: HF/H2O vapor exposure used primarily to form a new oxide film on the wafer surface.
options.text_zh: 利用 HF/H2O 蒸气在晶圆表面主要形成新的氧化层。

questions.explanation: The thermal-cleaning slide specifies heating the wafer at temperatures above 800°C under ultra-high-vacuum conditions to vaporize oxide or metal-oxide particles. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.15.
questions.explanation_zh: 热清洗课件明确指出，在超高真空条件下将晶圆加热至 800°C 以上，以使氧化物或金属氧化物颗粒汽化。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 15 页。

questions.text: For the positive photoresist described in the lecture, what happens during development after UV exposure through a mask?
questions.text_zh: 对于课件所述的正性光刻胶，在通过掩模进行 UV 曝光后，显影时会发生什么？

options.text: The exposed resist dissolves in developer while the unexposed resist remains on the wafer.
options.text_zh: 曝光区域的光刻胶在显影液中溶解，而未曝光区域保留在晶圆上。

options.text: The unexposed resist dissolves while the exposed resist remains on the wafer.
options.text_zh: 未曝光区域的光刻胶溶解，而曝光区域保留在晶圆上。

options.text: The exposed and unexposed resist have similar developer solubility, so pattern contrast is created during the later etch step.
options.text_zh: 曝光与未曝光光刻胶在显影液中的溶解性相近，因此图形对比主要在后续刻蚀步骤形成。

options.text: The chromium mask layer dissolves first while the photoresist remains unchanged.
options.text_zh: 铬掩模层先溶解，而光刻胶保持不变。

questions.explanation: For positive photoresist, UV exposure changes the chemistry of the exposed regions so they dissolve in developer, leaving the unexposed resist behind. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.21.
questions.explanation_zh: 对于正性光刻胶，UV 曝光使曝光区域的化学性质发生变化，从而在显影液中溶解，未曝光区域则保留下来。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 21 页。

questions.text: A lithography engineer wants to improve optical resolution by changing only the exposure wavelength. Which change is consistent with the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 光刻工程师希望仅通过改变曝光波长来提高光学分辨率。根据课件，哪种改变符合这一目标？

options.text: Change from 193 nm ArF exposure to 248 nm KrF exposure.
options.text_zh: 由 193 nm ArF 曝光改为 248 nm KrF 曝光。

options.text: Change from 365 nm i-line exposure to 436 nm g-line exposure.
options.text_zh: 由 365 nm i-line 曝光改为 436 nm g-line 曝光。

options.text: Change from 248 nm KrF exposure to 193 nm ArF exposure.
options.text_zh: 由 248 nm KrF 曝光改为 193 nm ArF 曝光。

options.text: Increase the mask-to-wafer gap while keeping the same exposure wavelength.
options.text_zh: 在曝光波长不变的情况下增大掩模到晶圆的间距。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that higher-resolution lithography requires shorter-wavelength photons; moving from 248 nm KrF to 193 nm ArF therefore follows the required direction. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.26.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，更高分辨率的光刻需要更短波长的光子，因此从 248 nm KrF 转向 193 nm ArF 符合这一方向。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 26 页。

questions.section: Isotropic versus Anisotropic Etching / Etching Profile
questions.text: A patterned feature must retain nearly vertical sidewalls with minimal lateral undercut beneath the resist mask. Which etch characteristic is most suitable?
questions.text_zh: 某图形化结构要求侧壁尽可能垂直，并尽量减少光刻胶掩模下方的横向欠刻。最适合的刻蚀特性是哪一种？

options.text: Purely isotropic etching, because equal vertical and lateral removal preserves the mask-defined linewidth.
options.text_zh: 纯各向同性刻蚀，因为垂直与横向等速去除能够保持掩模定义的线宽。

options.text: An etch condition with high mask erosion, because shrinking the mask suppresses lateral film removal.
options.text_zh: 高掩模侵蚀条件，因为缩小掩模能够抑制薄膜的横向去除。

options.text: Strongly anisotropic etching, because material removal is predominantly directional rather than lateral.
options.text_zh: 强各向异性刻蚀，因为材料去除主要具有方向性而非横向性。

options.text: An etch condition designed for deliberate undercut, because lateral removal sharpens vertical sidewalls.
options.text_zh: 专门设计为产生欠刻的刻蚀条件，因为横向去除能够使侧壁更垂直。

questions.explanation: The etch-profile slides show that lateral etching produces undercut and nonvertical sidewalls; anisotropic, directional etching minimizes this lateral component. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.42-43.
questions.explanation_zh: 刻蚀轮廓课件表明，横向刻蚀会产生欠刻和非垂直侧壁；各向异性的方向性刻蚀能够减小这种横向分量。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 42-43 页。

questions.text: How are dopant concentration and junction depth independently controlled in ion implantation according to the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，在离子注入中如何相对独立地控制掺杂浓度与结深？

options.text: Ion energy controls dopant concentration, while implantation time alone controls junction depth.
options.text_zh: 离子能量控制掺杂浓度，而仅由注入时间控制结深。

options.text: Wafer temperature controls dopant concentration, while chamber pressure controls junction depth.
options.text_zh: 晶圆温度控制掺杂浓度，而腔体压力控制结深。

options.text: Beam current together with implantation time controls dopant concentration, while ion energy controls junction depth.
options.text_zh: 离子束电流与注入时间共同控制掺杂浓度，而离子能量控制结深。

options.text: Mask thickness controls dopant concentration, while post-implant bake time controls junction depth.
options.text_zh: 掩模厚度控制掺杂浓度，而注入后烘烤时间控制结深。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that dopant concentration is controlled by the combination of ion-beam current and implantation time, while junction depth is controlled by ion energy. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.52.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，掺杂浓度由离子束电流与注入时间的组合控制，而结深由离子能量控制。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 52 页。

questions.section: Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP) / Cu versus Al
questions.text: Why is a damascene flow used for Cu interconnect fabrication instead of relying on a conventional subtractive Cu metal etch?
questions.text_zh: 为什么 Cu 互连制造采用镶嵌（Damascene）流程，而不是依赖传统的减法式 Cu 金属刻蚀？

options.text: Copper is difficult to dry etch, so trenches and vias are etched in dielectric, filled with Cu, and excess metal is removed by CMP.
options.text_zh: 铜难以进行干法刻蚀，因此先在介电层中刻蚀沟槽和通孔，再填充 Cu，并通过 CMP 去除表面多余金属。

options.text: Copper is easy to dry etch, so damascene is used mainly to increase the number of lithography masks.
options.text_zh: 铜很容易进行干法刻蚀，因此镶嵌工艺主要用于增加光刻掩模数量。

options.text: Damascene avoids etching the dielectric; copper lines are patterned directly on a completely flat dielectric surface.
options.text_zh: 镶嵌工艺避免刻蚀介电层；铜线直接在完全平坦的介电表面进行图形化。

options.text: Damascene replaces copper with aluminum after trench formation so that a conventional metal etch can be used.
options.text_zh: 镶嵌工艺在形成沟槽后用铝替代铜，从而可以采用传统金属刻蚀。

questions.explanation: The lecture notes that copper is very difficult to dry etch. Dual damascene therefore patterns vias and trenches in the dielectric, fills them with barrier/Cu layers, and uses metal CMP to leave embedded Cu lines and plugs. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.62-64.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出铜很难进行干法刻蚀，因此双镶嵌工艺先在介电层中形成通孔和沟槽，再沉积阻挡层/Cu，并通过金属 CMP 留下嵌入介电层中的铜线和铜塞。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 62-64 页。

questions.text: Why is sputtering identified as the dominant PVD method for semiconductor metallization in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 为什么课件将溅射（Sputtering）列为半导体金属化中占主导地位的 PVD 方法？

options.text: It is chosen because sputtered films provide better conformal step coverage than CVD in high-aspect-ratio features.
options.text_zh: 选择溅射是因为其薄膜在高深宽比结构中的保形台阶覆盖优于 CVD。

options.text: It deliberately forms higher-resistivity metal films so that current density is reduced in interconnects.
options.text_zh: 它有意形成更高电阻率的金属薄膜，以降低互连中的电流密度。

options.text: It can deposit high-purity, low-resistivity metal films with good uniformity and reliability.
options.text_zh: 它能够沉积高纯度、低电阻率且具有良好均匀性与可靠性的金属薄膜。

options.text: It relies on gaseous precursors reacting chemically at the wafer surface to form the metal film.
options.text_zh: 它依赖气态前驱体在晶圆表面发生化学反应形成金属薄膜。

questions.explanation: The PVD slide states that sputtering is dominant because it can deposit high-purity, low-resistivity metal films with excellent uniformity and reliability. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.57.
questions.explanation_zh: PVD 课件指出，溅射之所以占主导地位，是因为它能够沉积高纯度、低电阻率并具有优良均匀性和可靠性的金属薄膜。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 57 页。

questions.text: For an application that prioritizes moisture/ion barrier performance and thermal stability over package cost, which sealing choice is favored by the lecture comparison?
questions.text_zh: 对于更重视水汽/离子阻隔性能和热稳定性、而对封装成本不那么敏感的应用，根据课件比较应优先选择哪种封装密封方案？

options.text: Plastic sealing, because it provides the stronger moisture/ion barrier and higher thermal stability while remaining less expensive.
options.text_zh: 塑料密封，因为它在成本较低的同时具有更强的水汽/离子阻隔能力和更高的热稳定性。

options.text: Ceramic sealing, because it provides a better impurity barrier, higher thermal stability and conductivity, and lower thermal expansion, although at higher cost.
options.text_zh: 陶瓷密封，因为其杂质阻隔性能更好、热稳定性与导热性更高、热膨胀系数更低，但成本更高。

options.text: Ceramic sealing, because its main advantage is lower package cost even though its barrier and thermal properties are weaker.
options.text_zh: 陶瓷密封，因为其主要优势是封装成本更低，尽管阻隔性能和热性能较弱。

options.text: Plastic sealing, because its lower cost is accompanied by higher thermal conductivity and a lower thermal-expansion coefficient than ceramic.
options.text_zh: 塑料密封，因为其成本更低，同时导热性更高且热膨胀系数低于陶瓷。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that ceramic is a much better barrier to mobile ions and moisture, has higher thermal stability and conductivity and a lower coefficient of thermal expansion, but is much more expensive than plastic. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.73.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，陶瓷对移动离子和水汽具有更好的阻隔能力，热稳定性和导热性更高、热膨胀系数更低，但成本显著高于塑料封装。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 73 页。

questions.text: What integration problem motivated the development of STI relative to LOCOS in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，相比 LOCOS，STI 的开发主要是为了改善哪项集成问题？

options.text: Increase lateral oxide encroachment so that the isolation region extends farther beneath the active area.
options.text_zh: 增大横向氧化侵入，使隔离区域进一步延伸到有源区下方。

options.text: Reduce oxide encroachment by etching a trench and filling it with CVD oxide rather than relying on field-oxide growth alone.
options.text_zh: 通过刻蚀沟槽并以 CVD 氧化物填充，而不是仅依靠场氧化层生长，从而减少氧化侵入。

options.text: Eliminate the need for any isolation structure by replacing field isolation with a metal interconnect layer.
options.text_zh: 通过用金属互连层替代场隔离，从而取消任何隔离结构的需要。

options.text: Increase the amount of thermal oxidation so that the entire active device region becomes field oxide.
options.text_zh: 增加热氧化量，使整个有源器件区域转变为场氧化层。

questions.explanation: The isolation slide notes that STI was developed to reduce oxide encroachment, using silicon trench etching with a nitride mask and CVD oxide trench fill. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.79.
questions.explanation_zh: 隔离课件指出，STI 的开发目的是减少氧化侵入，其做法包括使用氮化物掩模进行硅沟槽刻蚀，并采用 CVD 氧化物进行沟槽填充。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 79 页。

questions.text: How is wafer yield defined in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 课件如何定义晶圆良率（wafer yield）？

options.text: The number of good wafers after process completion divided by the total number of wafers used for IC fabrication.
options.text_zh: 工艺完成后的良好晶圆数除以 IC 制造使用的晶圆总数。

options.text: The number of good dies on a good wafer divided by the total dies on that wafer.
options.text_zh: 良好晶圆上的良好芯片数除以该晶圆上的芯片总数。

options.text: The number of good packaged chips divided by the total number of chips packaged.
options.text_zh: 良好封装芯片数除以封装芯片总数。

options.text: The number of killer defects divided by chip area.
options.text_zh: 致命缺陷数量除以芯片面积。

questions.explanation: Wafer yield is the number of good wafers after processing divided by the total wafers used for fabrication. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.4.
questions.explanation_zh: 晶圆良率是工艺完成后的良好晶圆数与制造所用晶圆总数之比。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 4 页。

questions.text: A fab has good wafers, but many individual dies on those wafers fail due to particle contamination and process-window limitations. Which yield metric is most directly affected?
questions.text_zh: 某晶圆厂的晶圆本身合格，但由于颗粒污染和工艺窗口限制，晶圆上的许多单颗芯片失效。最直接受到影响的是哪项良率指标？

options.text: Overall fab yield.
options.text_zh: 晶圆厂总体良率。

options.text: Die yield.
options.text_zh: 芯片良率。

options.text: Wafer yield.
options.text_zh: 晶圆良率。

options.text: Packaging yield.
options.text_zh: 封装良率。

questions.explanation: Die yield is directly affected by particle contamination, process maintenance, process count, and design-related processing windows. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.5.
questions.explanation_zh: 芯片良率直接受到颗粒污染、工艺维护、工艺步骤数和设计相关工艺窗口的影响。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 5 页。

questions.text: Which issue is most directly associated with packaging yield rather than wafer or die yield?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪项问题最直接与封装良率相关，而不是晶圆良率或芯片良率？

options.text: Robot miscalibration breaking brittle wafers.
options.text_zh: 机器人校准错误导致脆性晶圆破裂。

options.text: Incorrect implant dopant concentration during FEOL.
options.text_zh: FEOL 中离子注入掺杂浓度错误。

options.text: Wire-bond quality and specification differences between die test and final chip test.
options.text_zh: 引线键合质量，以及裸片测试与最终成品测试之间的规格差异。

options.text: Airborne particles reducing die yield during lithography.
options.text_zh: 光刻过程中空气颗粒降低芯片良率。

questions.explanation: Packaging yield is associated with wire-bond quality and differences between die-test and final-chip-test specifications. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.5.
questions.explanation_zh: 封装良率与引线键合质量以及裸片测试和最终芯片测试之间的规格差异相关。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 5 页。

questions.text: If wafer yield, die yield, and packaging yield are YW, YD, and YC, respectively, how is overall fab yield YT represented in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 若晶圆良率、芯片良率与封装良率分别为 YW、YD 与 YC，课件如何表示晶圆厂总良率 YT？

options.text: YT = (YW + YD + YC) / 3.
options.text_zh: YT = (YW + YD + YC) / 3。

options.text: YT = max(YW, YD, YC).
options.text_zh: YT = max(YW, YD, YC)。

options.text: YT = YW + YD + YC.
options.text_zh: YT = YW + YD + YC。

options.text: YT = YW × YD × YC.
options.text_zh: YT = YW × YD × YC。

questions.explanation: Overall fab yield is the product of wafer yield, die yield, and packaging yield. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.6.
questions.explanation_zh: 晶圆厂总良率是晶圆良率、芯片良率与封装良率三者的乘积。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 6 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about the Week 4 yield–defect relationship:
I. With chip area and process-step count fixed, increasing killer-defect density lowers overall yield.
II. With killer-defect density and chip area fixed, increasing the number of processing steps lowers yield.
III. With killer-defect density and process-step count fixed, increasing chip area lowers yield.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于Week 4 的良率—缺陷关系，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 在芯片面积和工艺步骤数固定时，致命缺陷密度增加会降低总体良率。
II. 在致命缺陷密度和芯片面积固定时，工艺步骤数增加会降低良率。
III. 在致命缺陷密度和工艺步骤数固定时，芯片面积增大会降低良率。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

questions.explanation: The lecture explicitly links lower yield to higher killer-defect density, more processing steps, and larger chip area when the other factors are held constant. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.8.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件明确指出，在其他因素固定时，致命缺陷密度更高、工艺步骤更多以及芯片面积更大都会降低良率。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 8 页。

questions.text: At the same killer-defect density, why does a larger die generally have lower yield?
questions.text_zh: 在致命缺陷密度相同的情况下，为什么较大的芯片通常良率更低？

options.text: A larger die inherently requires fewer fabrication steps, which offsets the defect-density effect and increases yield.
options.text_zh: 更大的芯片天然需要更少制造步骤，从而抵消缺陷密度效应并提高良率。

options.text: A larger die reduces the defect-sensitive area per die, so fewer defects can intersect critical circuit regions.
options.text_zh: 更大的芯片会减少单颗芯片的缺陷敏感面积，因此更少缺陷会落入关键电路区域。

options.text: A larger die dilutes the same defect density over more area, making each defect less likely to affect functionality.
options.text_zh: 更大的芯片会把相同缺陷密度“稀释”到更大面积，使每个缺陷更不容易影响功能。

options.text: A larger die exposes more functional area to the same defect density, increasing the chance that a killer defect lands in a critical region.
options.text_zh: 在相同缺陷密度下，更大的芯片暴露更多功能面积，因此致命缺陷落入关键区域的概率更高。

questions.explanation: At the same defect density, a larger die has more area in which a killer defect can occur. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.8.
questions.explanation_zh: 在相同缺陷密度下，较大芯片具有更大的面积，因此更可能包含致命缺陷。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 8 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about chemical contamination as a semiconductor defect source:
I. Metals such as Au, Cu, and Pt can reduce minority-carrier lifetime and cause device failure.
II. Mobile metals such as Na and K can shift the threshold voltage of MOSFETs.
III. Chemical contamination is considered a defect only when it creates a visibly large particle on the wafer.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于作为半导体缺陷来源的化学污染，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. Au、Cu、Pt 等金属会降低少数载流子寿命并可能导致器件失效。
II. Na、K 等可移动金属会引起 MOSFET 阈值电压漂移。
III. 只有化学污染在晶圆上形成肉眼可见的大颗粒时，才会被视为缺陷。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

questions.explanation: Week 4 treats chemical contamination as an electrical defect source even at very low concentrations; Au/Cu/Pt affect carrier lifetime and Na/K can shift MOSFET threshold voltage. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.10.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 将极低浓度的化学污染也视为电学缺陷来源；Au/Cu/Pt 会影响载流子寿命，而 Na/K 可导致 MOSFET 阈值电压漂移。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 10 页。

questions.section: Effects of Particle Contamination on Process
questions.text: A particle blocks ion implantation over a local region. What failure consequence does the lecture associate with this event?
questions.text_zh: 颗粒在局部区域阻挡了离子注入。课件将其与哪种失效后果联系起来？

options.text: A locally thicker thermal oxide caused by accelerated oxidation.
options.text_zh: 因加速氧化形成局部更厚的热氧化层。

options.text: A more uniform and complete junction.
options.text_zh: 形成更均匀、更完整的结。

options.text: An incomplete junction that can degrade device performance.
options.text_zh: 形成不完整结，从而可能降低器件性能。

options.text: Improved electromigration resistance in metal lines.
options.text_zh: 提高金属线抗电迁移能力。

questions.explanation: A particle that blocks implanted ions can produce an incomplete junction and degrade device performance. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.14-15.
questions.explanation_zh: 颗粒阻挡注入离子会形成不完整结，并可能降低器件性能。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 14-15 页。

questions.text: Which pair is classified as film contamination rather than particulate contamination in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，以下哪一对属于膜状污染（film contamination），而非颗粒污染？

options.text: Metal/ionic films together with organic residues such as resist or oil.
options.text_zh: 金属/离子膜以及光刻胶、油类等有机残留。

options.text: Sand particles together with hair fibers.
options.text_zh: 砂粒以及毛发纤维。

options.text: Airborne dust together with shed skin flakes.
options.text_zh: 空气尘埃以及人体脱落皮屑。

options.text: Abrasive particles together with bacteria.
options.text_zh: 磨料颗粒以及细菌。

questions.explanation: Film contamination includes inorganic metal/ion films and organic residues such as resist or oil. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.19.
questions.explanation_zh: 膜状污染包括无机金属/离子膜以及光刻胶、油污等有机残留。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 19 页。

questions.text: Which source-category assignment is consistent with the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪种污染源分类与课件一致？

options.text: Water is not considered a contamination source if it is used for rinsing.
options.text_zh: 只要用于漂洗，水就不被视为污染源。

options.text: Humans are excluded from contamination control because cleanroom garments remove all particles.
options.text_zh: 由于洁净服能去除全部颗粒，因此人员不属于污染控制对象。

options.text: Air is the only contamination source considered in semiconductor fabs.
options.text_zh: 半导体晶圆厂只考虑空气这一种污染源。

options.text: Process chemicals, gases, and production equipment are recognized contamination sources in addition to air, people, and water.
options.text_zh: 除空气、人员和水之外，工艺化学品、气体及生产设备也属于污染源。

questions.explanation: The lecture identifies air, humans, water, process chemicals/gases, and production equipment as contamination sources. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.20, 23, 24, 25, 26.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将空气、人员、水、工艺化学品/气体以及生产设备都列为污染源。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 20、23、24、25、26 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about Particle per Wafer per Pass (PWP):
I. PWP compares particle count before a wafer enters a process tool with the count after it passes through the tool.
II. PWP is intended to quantify particles added to a wafer by a process/equipment pass.
III. PWP is the ratio of good dies to total dies on a wafer.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于Particle per Wafer per Pass（PWP），考虑陈述 I–III：
I. PWP 比较晶圆进入工艺设备前后的颗粒计数。
II. PWP 用于量化晶圆经过一次工艺/设备后由该过程新增的颗粒。
III. PWP 是晶圆上良品芯片数与总芯片数之比。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

questions.explanation: The PWP diagram defines the metric from the particle-count increase across a process-tool pass; it is a contamination metric, not a die-yield ratio. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.22.
questions.explanation_zh: PWP 图示通过晶圆经过工艺设备前后的颗粒计数增量定义该指标；它是污染指标，而不是芯片良率比值。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 22 页。

questions.text: Which strategy best reflects the lecture's particle-control approach for yield engineering?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪种策略最符合课件中的良率工程颗粒控制思路？

options.text: Clean the fab only after a yield excursion is confirmed.
options.text_zh: 只有在确认良率异常后才清洁晶圆厂。

options.text: Increase the number of people inside the cleanroom to improve manual inspection coverage.
options.text_zh: 增加洁净室内人员数量以提高人工检查覆盖率。

options.text: Use controlled cleanroom/mini-environments, minimize particle introduction, continuously monitor particles, and manage water by deionization and filtration.
options.text_zh: 采用受控洁净室/微环境，尽量减少颗粒引入，持续监测颗粒，并通过去离子与过滤管理用水。

options.text: Reduce particle monitoring so process interruptions are minimized.
options.text_zh: 减少颗粒监测以降低工艺中断。

questions.explanation: Particle control combines controlled environments, prevention, continuous monitoring, and DI-water/filtration management. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.28.
questions.explanation_zh: 颗粒控制结合受控环境、污染预防、持续监测以及去离子水/过滤管理。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 28 页。

questions.text: What does “Class 1” mean in the cleanroom definition used in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 课件采用的洁净室定义中，“Class 1”表示什么？

options.text: At most one person may enter the cleanroom.
options.text_zh: 洁净室最多允许 1 人进入。

options.text: Fewer than 1 particle larger than 5 μm per cubic meter of air.
options.text_zh: 每立方米空气中直径大于 5 μm 的颗粒少于 1 个。

options.text: Fewer than 1 particle larger than 0.5 μm per cubic foot of air.
options.text_zh: 每立方英尺空气中直径大于 0.5 μm 的颗粒少于 1 个。

options.text: Exactly one killer defect per wafer.
options.text_zh: 每片晶圆恰好 1 个致命缺陷。

questions.explanation: The slide defines Class 1 as fewer than one particle larger than 0.5 μm per cubic foot of air. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.29.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将 Class 1 定义为每立方英尺空气中直径大于 0.5 μm 的颗粒少于 1 个。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 29 页。

questions.text: What is the role of a HEPA filter in the cleanroom air-handling loop described in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 在课件所示洁净室空气处理循环中，HEPA 过滤器的作用是什么？

options.text: HEPA filtration — remove particles from recirculating cleanroom air before it returns to the room.
options.text_zh: HEPA 过滤——在循环空气返回洁净室前去除其中的颗粒。

options.text: Wet wafer cleaning — remove contamination already present on the wafer surface.
options.text_zh: 湿法晶圆清洗——去除已经存在于晶圆表面的污染。

options.text: Membrane filtration — remove particles from a process liquid or gas stream through a membrane.
options.text_zh: 膜过滤——通过膜从工艺液体或气体流中分离颗粒。

options.text: Static-charge control — neutralize charge so particles are less strongly attracted to surfaces.
options.text_zh: 静电控制——中和电荷，降低颗粒被表面吸附的趋势。

questions.explanation: HEPA filtration removes most particles from recirculated cleanroom air before it returns to the process area. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.36.
questions.explanation_zh: HEPA 过滤器在循环空气返回工艺区域前去除其中大部分颗粒。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 36 页。

questions.text: Which action helps reduce mobile-metal contamination according to the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，以下哪项措施有助于减少可移动金属污染？

options.text: Use higher furnace temperatures so Cu and Fe diffuse away faster.
options.text_zh: 提高炉温，使 Cu 和 Fe 更快扩散。

options.text: Eliminate metal tweezers where possible and replace stainless-steel parts with materials such as silicon, carbon, or aluminum.
options.text_zh: 尽量取消金属镊子，并用硅、碳或铝等材料替代不锈钢部件。

options.text: Add Au contamination to trap Cu and Fe.
options.text_zh: 加入 Au 污染以捕获 Cu 和 Fe。

options.text: Increase the use of metal tweezers for wafer handling.
options.text_zh: 增加金属镊子用于晶圆搬运。

questions.explanation: The lecture recommends avoiding metal tweezers and replacing stainless-steel parts with less problematic materials where possible. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.42.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件建议尽量避免金属镊子，并用更合适的材料替代不锈钢部件。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 42 页。

questions.text: Why are test structures placed in scribe lines on modern production wafers?
questions.text_zh: 为什么现代生产晶圆常把测试结构放在芯片之间的划片道（scribe line）中？

options.text: They are needed only to guide the saw blade during dicing.
options.text_zh: 它们只用于在切割时引导锯片。

options.text: They allow electrical process monitoring while preserving more wafer area for product dies.
options.text_zh: 它们既可用于电学工艺监控，又能尽量保留更多晶圆面积给产品芯片。

options.text: They provide space for package marking after assembly.
options.text_zh: 它们为封装后的打标提供空间。

options.text: They replace all functional product dies on the wafer.
options.text_zh: 它们取代晶圆上的所有功能产品芯片。

questions.explanation: Scribe-line test structures support in-process electrical monitoring while saving more silicon area for product dies. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.43-44.
questions.explanation_zh: 划片道测试结构可支持过程电学监控，同时为产品芯片保留更多硅面积。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 43-44 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about Automated Optical Inspection (AOI):
I. AOI is described as an optical microscope coupled with charge-coupled-device (CCD) imaging and automation capability.
II. The AOI system described in the lecture supports both bright-field and dark-field modes.
III. AOI is presented primarily as an electrical parametric test that measures transistor I–V curves without imaging.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于自动光学检测（AOI），考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 课件将 AOI 描述为光学显微镜与电荷耦合器件（CCD）成像及自动化能力的结合。
II. 课件中的 AOI 系统支持明场（bright-field）和暗场（dark-field）两种模式。
III. AOI 在课件中主要被描述为不使用成像、直接测量晶体管 I–V 曲线的电学参数测试。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: Week 4 describes AOI as automated optical microscopy with CCD imaging and both bright-field and dark-field modes, not as a purely electrical parametric test. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.45-46.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 将 AOI 描述为结合 CCD 成像与自动化的光学显微检测，并支持明场和暗场模式，而不是纯电学参数测试。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 45-46 页。

questions.text: Which image appearance is characteristic of dark-field microscopy as described in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，暗场显微镜图像通常具有哪种外观特征？

options.text: The sample and background have identical intensity.
options.text_zh: 样品与背景亮度完全相同。

options.text: Scattering features appear bright against a dark background, emphasizing edges and boundaries.
options.text_zh: 散射特征在暗背景上呈亮色，突出边缘和边界。

options.text: Only x-ray absorption contrast is visible.
options.text_zh: 只能看到 X 射线吸收衬度。

options.text: A dark sample on a bright background due to transmitted-light attenuation.
options.text_zh: 由于透射光衰减，样品呈暗色、背景明亮。

questions.explanation: Dark-field microscopy makes scattering features appear bright on a dark background, enhancing edges and boundaries. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.47.
questions.explanation_zh: 暗场显微镜使散射特征在暗背景上呈亮色，从而增强边缘和边界。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 47 页。

questions.text: A wafer map shows a repeated spatial cluster of many correlated defects across wafers. What is the most useful interpretation from the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 晶圆图上反复出现由许多相互关联缺陷组成的空间簇。根据课件，最有用的解释是什么？

options.text: The pattern should be treated as purely random and ignored in root-cause analysis.
options.text_zh: 该图形应视为纯随机现象，不应纳入根因分析。

options.text: The cluster directly represents stored logic states in SRAM cells.
options.text_zh: 该缺陷簇直接表示 SRAM 单元的存储逻辑状态。

options.text: The correlated cluster may indicate a systematic manufacturing source and can be used for root-cause analysis.
options.text_zh: 相关缺陷簇可能指向系统性制造来源，可用于根因分析。

options.text: The map primarily indicates package pin count.
options.text_zh: 该晶圆图主要表示封装引脚数量。

questions.explanation: Correlated spatial clusters may indicate a systematic manufacturing source and are useful for root-cause analysis. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.48-50.
questions.explanation_zh: 相关空间缺陷簇可能指向系统性制造来源，因此可用于根因分析。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 48-50 页。

questions.section: Defect Root Cause Analysis, Corrective Action and Preventive Action
questions.text: Which sequence best represents the lecture's RCA-to-action logic?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪种顺序最符合课件从 RCA 到行动闭环的逻辑？

options.text: Classify the defect → apply preventive action first → identify the root cause afterward → omit corrective-action verification.
options.text_zh: 缺陷分类 → 先实施预防措施 → 之后再寻找根因 → 省略纠正措施验证。

options.text: Detect the symptom → monitor for recurrence → close the case without root-cause analysis or corrective action.
options.text_zh: 检测症状 → 观察是否复发 → 不进行根因分析或纠正措施就关闭问题。

options.text: Detect the problem → implement a process change immediately → perform root-cause analysis only if the change fails → skip preventive follow-up.
options.text_zh: 检测问题 → 立即实施工艺变更 → 仅在变更失败后再做根因分析 → 不进行预防性跟进。

options.text: Detect/classify the problem → identify the root cause (for example with 5 Whys) → implement corrective action → verify effectiveness and prevent recurrence.
options.text_zh: 检测/分类问题 → 识别根因（例如 5 Whys）→ 实施纠正措施 → 验证有效性并防止再次发生。

questions.explanation: RCA identifies underlying causes, corrective action addresses them, and follow-up/preventive action reduces recurrence. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.51-54.
questions.explanation_zh: RCA 用于识别根本原因，纠正措施处理根因，后续监控与预防措施用于降低复发风险。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 51-54 页。

questions.text: Which description best matches the typical yield-ramp behavior after a new process, product, or tool is introduced?
questions.text_zh: 在引入新工艺、新产品或新设备后，以下哪项最符合课件所述的典型良率爬坡行为？

options.text: Yield is initially dominated by random particle effects, while systematic process factors become important mainly after extended production.
options.text_zh: 初始良率主要受随机颗粒影响，而系统性工艺因素主要在较长时间生产后才变得重要。

options.text: Yield normally declines with each production cycle because every additional cycle introduces new systematic defects.
options.text_zh: 良率通常会随每个生产循环持续下降，因为每个循环都会引入新的系统性缺陷。

options.text: Yield often starts lower; production cycles expose and remove systematic factors, after which yield stabilizes with more random limitations.
options.text_zh: 良率通常从较低水平开始；生产循环逐步暴露并消除系统性因素，之后良率稳定并更多受随机因素限制。

options.text: Yield starts near its final stable value because systematic factors are already absent in a new flow.
options.text_zh: 良率一开始就接近最终稳定值，因为新流程中已经不存在系统性因素。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that new technologies, products, or tools normally begin with lower overall yield; systematic factors are then identified and eliminated over production cycles until yield improves and stabilizes, increasingly limited by random factors. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.6-7.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，新技术、新产品或新设备导入初期整体良率通常不高；经过若干生产循环后，系统性因素被识别并消除，良率持续改善并稳定，随后更多受随机因素限制。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 6-7 页。

questions.text: Why does dividing a system into many smaller ICs not automatically minimize total manufacturing cost even though smaller dies may have higher yield?
questions.text_zh: 尽管较小芯片可能具有更高良率，为什么将系统拆分成许多小 IC 并不一定能使总制造成本最低？

options.text: Packaging and board assembly for many separate chips can outweigh the yield benefit of using smaller dies.
options.text_zh: 大量独立芯片的封装与板级装配成本可能超过采用较小芯片所带来的良率收益。

options.text: Smaller dies tend to have lower yield because each wafer contains more die boundaries and therefore more defect opportunities.
options.text_zh: 较小芯片往往良率更低，因为每片晶圆包含更多芯片边界，从而增加缺陷机会。

options.text: Smaller dies require additional wafer-processing steps, so fabrication cost can offset the yield benefit before packaging is considered.
options.text_zh: 较小芯片需要额外的晶圆工艺步骤，因此在考虑封装前，制造成本就可能抵消良率收益。

options.text: Smaller dies require a lower killer-defect density than larger dies to reach the same die yield.
options.text_zh: 较小芯片要达到相同芯片良率，需要比大芯片更低的致命缺陷密度。

questions.explanation: The lecture notes that smaller ICs can achieve higher yield, but the added cost of packaging many chips and assembling them on a board can exceed the cost of using fewer larger circuits with lower yield. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.9.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，较小 IC 的良率可能更高，但大量芯片的封装与板级装配成本可能超过使用数量更少、良率较低的大型电路的总成本。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 9 页。

questions.section: Effects of Particle Contamination on Process
questions.text: Why can a particle on a photomask or reticle create a particularly serious yield problem across production wafers?
questions.text_zh: 为什么光掩模或光罩上的颗粒可能在生产晶圆中造成特别严重的良率问题？

options.text: A reticle particle is mainly a one-wafer problem because alignment changes move its printed image to unrelated locations on later wafers.
options.text_zh: 光罩颗粒主要只影响单片晶圆，因为后续晶圆的对准变化会把其成像位置移到无关区域。

options.text: The same mask or reticle is reused for many wafers, so a particle image can be repeatedly transferred through lithography and subsequent etching.
options.text_zh: 同一掩模或光罩会重复用于许多晶圆，因此颗粒图像可通过光刻及后续刻蚀反复转移。

options.text: The principal risk is local photoresist contamination on the current wafer; reuse of the reticle does not significantly repeat the same defect.
options.text_zh: 主要风险是当前晶圆上的局部光刻胶污染；重复使用光罩不会显著重复同一缺陷。

options.text: The mask particle mainly changes exposure dose, while subsequent etching tends to average out the resulting resist variation.
options.text_zh: 掩模颗粒主要改变曝光剂量，而后续刻蚀通常会平均掉由此产生的光刻胶差异。

questions.explanation: The lecture emphasizes that masks/reticles are reused many times. A particle can print a resist defect that is then transferred during etch, allowing the same contamination source to affect many wafers. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.14.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件强调掩模/光罩会被重复使用多次。颗粒可形成光刻胶缺陷，并在刻蚀时进一步转移，因此同一污染源可能影响大量晶圆。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 14 页。

questions.text: A contamination audit finds resist drips, particles from dried developer, and particles generated by spinners. Which process area is the most likely source according to the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 污染审查发现光刻胶滴落物、干燥显影液颗粒以及旋涂设备产生的颗粒。根据课件，最可能的污染来源是哪一工艺区域？

options.text: Plasma etching, where process-generated particles and gas-source particles are the characteristic sources.
options.text_zh: 等离子体刻蚀，其典型来源是工艺生成颗粒与气源颗粒。

options.text: Lithography, where drips, airborne dust, solids in resist, dried developer, and spinner particles are listed sources.
options.text_zh: 光刻，其中课件列出的污染源包括滴落物、空气尘埃、光刻胶固体、干燥显影液和旋涂设备颗粒。

options.text: Ion implantation, where mechanical movement is identified as the characteristic particle source.
options.text_zh: 离子注入，其中机械运动被列为典型颗粒来源。

options.text: RCA cleaning and wet etching, where liquid and bath-surface particles are the characteristic sources.
options.text_zh: RCA 清洗与湿法刻蚀，其典型来源是液体中的颗粒和槽体表面颗粒。

questions.explanation: The Week 4 contamination-source slide specifically lists drips, airborne dust, solids in resist, particles from dried developer, and spinner particles under lithography. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.24.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 的污染源课件明确将滴落物、空气尘埃、光刻胶中的固体、干燥显影液颗粒和旋涂设备颗粒列在光刻工艺下。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 24 页。

questions.text: Why should large objects and poor equipment placement be avoided in a laminar-flow cleanroom work zone?
questions.text_zh: 为什么在层流洁净室工作区中应避免大型物体和不合理的设备摆放？

options.text: They increase HEPA filtration efficiency by forcing more air directly through each filter element.
options.text_zh: 它们通过迫使更多空气直接通过每个 HEPA 滤芯来提高过滤效率。

options.text: They can disturb the normal laminar airflow, create turbulence, and dislodge or carry small particles into critical areas.
options.text_zh: 它们会扰乱正常层流、产生湍流，并使小颗粒脱落或被携带到关键区域。

options.text: They mainly affect electrostatic charging, while airflow disturbance has little influence on particle transport.
options.text_zh: 它们主要影响静电积累，而气流扰动对颗粒输运影响很小。

options.text: They increase deionized-water purity by reducing the number of particles entering the water system.
options.text_zh: 它们通过减少进入水系统的颗粒来提高去离子水纯度。

questions.explanation: The laminar-air-flow diagram shows that objects can interfere with normal laminar flow and create turbulence that may dislodge and carry small particles. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.34.
questions.explanation_zh: 层流课件图示指出，物体会干扰正常层流并产生湍流，从而可能使小颗粒脱落并被气流携带。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 34 页。

questions.section: Particles Control for Yield Engineering / Deionized (DI) Water System
questions.text: After a wet process, which water-control practice best matches the contamination-control strategy described in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 湿法工艺完成后，以下哪种用水控制方式最符合课件所述的污染控制策略？

options.text: Use filtered conventional water for the final rinse, because deionization is not needed after wet processing.
options.text_zh: 最终冲洗使用经过过滤的普通水，因为湿法工艺后不需要去离子处理。

options.text: Reuse the process bath as the final rinse so that the wafer sees no change in solution chemistry.
options.text_zh: 将工艺槽液直接作为最终冲洗液，以避免晶圆经历溶液化学变化。

options.text: Replace liquid rinsing with cleanroom airflow because water management is unrelated to particle control.
options.text_zh: 用洁净室气流替代液体冲洗，因为水管理与颗粒控制无关。

options.text: Use high-purity deionized water for rinsing, supported by deionization, filtration, and bacterial control.
options.text_zh: 使用高纯去离子（DI）水进行冲洗，并配合去离子、过滤和细菌控制。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that large amounts of high-purity DI water are used for wafer rinsing after wet processes and includes deionization, filtration, and bacterial control in the water-management strategy. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.28, 38.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，湿法工艺后晶圆冲洗需要大量高纯 DI 水，并将去离子、过滤和细菌控制列为水管理策略的一部分。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 28、38 页。

questions.text: Which sequence best matches the defect-segmentation workflow shown in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪一项最符合课件展示的缺陷分割（Defect Segmentation）流程？

options.text: Scan the wafer row by row, collect neighboring-die images, compare and filter for anomalies, then report and store the results.
options.text_zh: 逐行扫描晶圆，采集相邻芯片图像，比较并过滤异常，最后报告并存储结果。

options.text: Generate a preliminary defect report, scan selected die, then use later etch results to decide whether image comparison is needed.
options.text_zh: 先生成初步缺陷报告，扫描选定芯片，再根据后续刻蚀结果决定是否需要图像比较。

options.text: Cluster defects by root cause before collecting die images, then use the clusters to decide whether scanning is necessary.
options.text_zh: 在采集芯片图像前先按根因聚类，再根据聚类结果决定是否需要扫描。

options.text: Build an electrical test map first and use it in place of neighboring-die image comparison and optical anomaly filtering.
options.text_zh: 先建立电测试图，并用其替代相邻芯片图像比较和光学异常过滤。

questions.explanation: The defect-segmentation slide shows the sequence: row-by-row wafer scanning, neighboring-die image collection, comparison/filtering to find anomalies, and reporting/data storage. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.48.
questions.explanation_zh: 缺陷分割课件展示的顺序为：逐行扫描晶圆、采集相邻芯片图像、比较与过滤以发现异常，最后进行报告和数据存储。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 48 页。

questions.text: After an inspection tool detects an abnormality, why does the lecture emphasize classifying the defect by attributes such as type, size, location, and severity?
questions.text_zh: 检测设备发现异常后，为什么课件强调按照缺陷类型、尺寸、位置和严重程度等属性进行分类？

options.text: Classification is used mainly to increase the measured defect size so optical inspection becomes more sensitive.
options.text_zh: 缺陷分类主要用于增大测得的缺陷尺寸，从而提高光学检测灵敏度。

options.text: Classification helps understand the nature of the defects and prioritize corrective actions for process and yield improvement.
options.text_zh: 缺陷分类有助于理解缺陷性质，并为工艺与良率改善确定纠正措施的优先级。

options.text: Classification is mainly a reporting step and does not materially affect how corrective actions are prioritized.
options.text_zh: 缺陷分类主要是报告步骤，并不会实质影响纠正措施的优先级。

options.text: Classification itself proves the root cause, so no further investigation or corrective action is needed.
options.text_zh: 缺陷分类本身即可证明根因，因此无需进一步调查或纠正措施。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that classification by type, size, location, and severity helps manufacturers understand defect nature and prioritize corrective actions to improve processes and yield. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.45.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，按照类型、尺寸、位置和严重程度进行缺陷分类，有助于理解缺陷性质，并确定纠正措施的优先级，以改善工艺和良率。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 45 页。

questions.text: What is the intended purpose of the 5 Whys analysis in defect root cause analysis?
questions.text_zh: 在缺陷根因分析（RCA）中，“5 Whys”分析的主要目的是什么？

options.text: To classify the observed defect by type, size, location, and severity before deciding which action has priority.
options.text_zh: 先按类型、尺寸、位置和严重程度对观察到的缺陷进行分类，再决定行动优先级。

options.text: To compare neighboring-die images and filter optical anomalies before a defect is entered into the RCA process.
options.text_zh: 在缺陷进入 RCA 流程前，比较相邻芯片图像并过滤光学异常。

options.text: To implement a selected process or equipment change after the root cause and solution have already been identified.
options.text_zh: 在根因和解决方案已经确定后，实施选定的工艺或设备变更。

options.text: To keep asking why until the underlying cause is found rather than stopping at the immediate symptom.
options.text_zh: 持续追问“为什么”，直到找到底层根因，而不是停留在直接症状。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines 5 Whys as repeatedly asking 'why' to move from the observed problem toward the underlying root cause. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.52.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将“5 Whys”定义为反复追问“为什么”，使分析从表面问题逐步深入到底层根因。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 52 页。

questions.text: Which distinction between Corrective Action (CA) and Preventive Action (PA) is most consistent with the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 以下关于纠正措施（CA）与预防措施（PA）的区别，哪项最符合课件？

options.text: CA implements identified solutions such as process, procedure, equipment, or training changes; PA monitors effectiveness, prevents recurrence, and incorporates lessons learned.
options.text_zh: CA 实施已确定的解决方案，例如工艺、程序、设备或培训变更；PA 则监控效果、防止问题复发并将经验纳入后续流程。

options.text: CA records the root cause without changing operations, while PA reworks the already affected wafers.
options.text_zh: CA 只记录根因而不改变运行方式，PA 则返工已经受影响的晶圆。

options.text: CA mainly monitors long-term effectiveness, while PA is the initial implementation of process or equipment changes.
options.text_zh: CA 主要负责长期效果监控，而 PA 负责最初实施工艺或设备变更。

options.text: CA is limited to employee training, while PA is limited to replacing fabrication equipment.
options.text_zh: CA 仅限于员工培训，而 PA 仅限于更换制造设备。

questions.explanation: The lecture describes CA as implementing solutions after RCA, while PA includes monitoring corrective-action effectiveness, follow-up to prevent recurrence, and incorporating lessons learned into future processes. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.53-54.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将 CA 描述为在 RCA 后实施解决方案；PA 则包括监控纠正措施的有效性、通过后续跟踪防止问题复发，并将经验教训纳入未来流程。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 53-54 页。

questions.text: A fab improves the number of functional, defect-free devices obtained per unit wafer area. Which engineering objective is being pursued most directly?
questions.text_zh: 某晶圆厂提高了单位晶圆面积上获得的功能正常、无缺陷器件数量。该措施最直接对应哪一项工程目标？

options.text: End-market product segmentation.
options.text_zh: 终端市场产品细分。

options.text: Long-term device lifetime characterization.
options.text_zh: 器件长期寿命表征。

options.text: Package-level environmental qualification.
options.text_zh: 封装级环境可靠性认证。

options.text: Semiconductor yield optimization.
options.text_zh: 半导体良率优化。

questions.explanation: Week 1 defines yield engineering as optimizing manufacturing yield to increase functional, defect-free devices produced per unit wafer area. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.21.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 将良率工程定义为优化制造良率，以提高单位晶圆面积上功能正常、无缺陷器件的产出。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 21 页。

questions.text: A recurring defect is traced to a process condition, the condition is adjusted, and subsequent lots are monitored for recovery. Which set of yield-engineering activities does this scenario combine?
questions.text_zh: 某重复性缺陷被追溯到一个工艺条件，随后调整该条件并监控后续批次是否恢复。该场景结合了哪些良率工程活动？

options.text: Design for manufacturability only, without process feedback.
options.text_zh: 仅进行可制造性设计，不包含工艺反馈。

options.text: Reliability qualification and lifetime prediction only.
options.text_zh: 仅进行可靠性认证与寿命预测。

options.text: Package selection, board assembly, and final shipment control.
options.text_zh: 封装选择、板级组装与最终出货控制。

options.text: Root cause analysis, process optimization, and yield monitoring/control.
options.text_zh: 根因分析、工艺优化以及良率监控与控制。

questions.explanation: The lecture lists defect reduction, process optimization, root cause analysis, yield monitoring/control, DFM, and yield-enhancement techniques as yield-engineering activities. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.22.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将缺陷降低、工艺优化、根因分析、良率监控与控制、可制造性设计（DFM）及良率提升技术列为良率工程活动。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 22 页。

questions.text: During photolithography, which step must occur after mask-to-wafer alignment but before development to create the latent resist pattern?
questions.text_zh: 在光刻过程中，为形成光刻胶潜像，哪一步必须发生在掩模与晶圆对准之后、显影之前？

options.text: Stripping the resist before pattern transfer.
options.text_zh: 在图形转移前去除光刻胶。

options.text: Spin-coating a fresh resist layer after alignment.
options.text_zh: 在对准后重新旋涂一层光刻胶。

options.text: Hard baking the developed resist before exposure.
options.text_zh: 在曝光前对已显影光刻胶进行硬烘。

options.text: Exposure of the resist through the aligned pattern.
options.text_zh: 通过已对准图形对光刻胶进行曝光。

questions.explanation: The Week 1 sequence places alignment before exposure and development after exposure. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.24.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 的光刻流程中，对准之后是曝光，曝光之后才进行显影。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 24 页。

questions.text: A process must uniformly thin an exposed film across the wafer without transferring a photoresist pattern. Which etch mode best matches this requirement?
questions.text_zh: 某工艺需要在整片晶圆上均匀减薄暴露薄膜，而不转移光刻胶图形。哪种刻蚀模式最符合该要求？

options.text: Blanket etch, which removes all or part of the exposed film.
options.text_zh: 全面刻蚀（blanket etch），去除全部或部分暴露薄膜。

options.text: Pattern etch, which selectively transfers a resist or hard-mask pattern.
options.text_zh: 图形刻蚀（pattern etch），选择性转移光刻胶或硬掩模图形。

options.text: Ion implantation, which introduces dopants into selected regions.
options.text_zh: 离子注入，将掺杂剂引入选定区域。

options.text: CMP, which planarizes by slurry-assisted mechanical polishing.
options.text_zh: CMP，通过浆料辅助机械抛光实现平坦化。

questions.explanation: Week 1 distinguishes blanket etch from pattern etch: blanket etch removes all or part of a surface film without pattern transfer. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.26.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 区分了全面刻蚀与图形刻蚀：全面刻蚀用于去除表面全部或部分薄膜，不承担图形转移。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 26 页。

questions.text: Which observation most strongly indicates that a thin-film process is CVD rather than PVD?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪一项观察结果最能表明某薄膜工艺属于 CVD 而不是 PVD？

options.text: A solid source is physically vaporized and condensed on the wafer without a surface chemical reaction being essential.
options.text_zh: 固体源经物理汽化后在晶圆上凝结，关键过程不依赖表面化学反应。

options.text: Metal ions in a liquid electrolyte are electrochemically reduced onto a seed layer.
options.text_zh: 液体电解质中的金属离子在种子层上发生电化学还原。

options.text: Gaseous precursors react near or on the substrate surface to form a solid film.
options.text_zh: 气态前驱体在衬底附近或表面发生化学反应并形成固体薄膜。

options.text: A chemical slurry and mechanical abrasion remove topography from the wafer.
options.text_zh: 利用化学浆料与机械磨蚀去除晶圆表面起伏。

questions.explanation: CVD is defined by chemical reaction of gaseous precursors near or on the substrate to form the deposited solid. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.30.
questions.explanation_zh: CVD 的关键特征是气态前驱体在衬底附近或表面发生化学反应，生成沉积固体。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 30 页。

questions.text: A deposition engineer selects sputtering for a metal film. According to the Week 1 classification, which mechanism category does this belong to?
questions.text_zh: 沉积工程师选择溅射来形成金属薄膜。根据 Week 1 的分类，该方法属于哪一种机制类别？

options.text: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), based on gaseous precursor reaction.
options.text_zh: 化学气相沉积（CVD），基于气态前驱体反应。

options.text: Electrochemical Plating (ECP), based on electrochemical metal deposition.
options.text_zh: 电化学镀（ECP），基于金属的电化学沉积。

options.text: Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP), based on material removal and planarization.
options.text_zh: 化学机械抛光（CMP），基于材料去除和平坦化。

options.text: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD), based on physical transfer of source material.
options.text_zh: 物理气相沉积（PVD），基于源材料的物理转移。

questions.explanation: The Week 1 PVD slide lists sputtering, electron-beam deposition, and thermal deposition as PVD methods. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.33.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 的 PVD 课件将溅射、电子束沉积和热蒸发列为 PVD 方法。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 33 页。

questions.text: Why is the low processing temperature of ECP particularly useful for advanced interconnect integration?
questions.text_zh: 为什么 ECP 的低处理温度对先进互连集成尤其有利？

options.text: It directly forms n-type and p-type regions without implantation.
options.text_zh: 它可在无需离子注入的情况下直接形成 n 型和 p 型区域。

options.text: It improves compatibility with temperature-sensitive low-k polymeric dielectrics.
options.text_zh: 它提高了与温度敏感的低-k 聚合物介电材料的兼容性。

options.text: It removes the need for lithography in all interconnect patterning.
options.text_zh: 它使所有互连图形化都不再需要光刻。

options.text: It accelerates thermal SiO2 growth on silicon.
options.text_zh: 它可加速硅上的热氧化 SiO2 生长。

questions.explanation: Week 1 notes that ECP is a low-temperature process and therefore compatible with low-k polymeric dielectrics used in interconnects. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.35.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 指出 ECP 属于低温工艺，因此与互连中可能采用的低-k 聚合物介电材料具有良好兼容性。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 35 页。

questions.text: A lithography module loses focus margin because the wafer surface has accumulated significant topography. Which benefit of CMP addresses this issue?
questions.text_zh: 由于晶圆表面累积了明显起伏，光刻模块的焦深裕量下降。CMP 的哪项作用可直接解决这一问题？

options.text: Increasing implanted dopant dose to compensate for topography.
options.text_zh: 提高离子注入剂量以补偿表面起伏。

options.text: Growing a thicker thermal oxide to hide the topography.
options.text_zh: 生长更厚的热氧化层以掩盖表面起伏。

options.text: Replacing the photomask with a wire-bonding stencil.
options.text_zh: 用引线键合模板替代光掩模。

options.text: Planarizing the surface so high-resolution lithography can be performed more reliably.
options.text_zh: 将表面平坦化，使高分辨率光刻能够更可靠地进行。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that CMP produces a planarized wafer surface, which supports high-resolution photolithography. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.38.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，CMP 可获得平坦化晶圆表面，从而支持高分辨率光刻。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 38 页。

questions.text: Why can CMP improve interconnect reliability when metal PVD is used over multilayer topography?
questions.text_zh: 在多层起伏表面上采用金属 PVD 时，为什么 CMP 有助于提高互连可靠性？

options.text: It intentionally increases surface roughness to anchor the metal mechanically.
options.text_zh: 它有意增加表面粗糙度以机械固定金属。

options.text: It replaces all diffusion barriers by converting Cu into a dielectric.
options.text_zh: 它通过把 Cu 转变为介电材料来替代所有扩散阻挡层。

options.text: Planarization reduces poor step coverage and sidewall thinning that can raise line resistance and electromigration risk.
options.text_zh: 平坦化可减少差的台阶覆盖与侧壁变薄，从而降低线电阻升高和电迁移风险。

options.text: It reduces semiconductor carrier density so metal current is lower.
options.text_zh: 它降低半导体载流子浓度，从而减小金属电流。

questions.explanation: Week 1 links non-planar surfaces to poor PVD step coverage, sidewall thinning, higher resistance, and electromigration; CMP removes the topography that drives this problem. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.38.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 将非平坦表面与 PVD 台阶覆盖不良、金属侧壁变薄、线电阻上升及电迁移风险联系起来；CMP 通过消除起伏来缓解该问题。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 38 页。

questions.text: A transistor process needs selected silicon regions to acquire different electrical properties so that n-type and p-type regions can be formed. Which unit process directly performs this function?
questions.text_zh: 晶体管工艺需要使选定硅区域获得不同电学性质，以形成 n 型和 p 型区域。哪一种单元工艺直接实现这一功能？

options.text: Ion implantation / doping — introduce selected impurities to create regions with the required electrical properties.
options.text_zh: 离子注入 / 掺杂——引入选定杂质，形成具有所需电学性质的区域。

options.text: Pattern etch — remove selected film regions according to a resist or hard-mask pattern.
options.text_zh: 图形刻蚀——依据光刻胶或硬掩膜图形去除选定薄膜区域。

options.text: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) — form a thin film from reacting gaseous precursors.
options.text_zh: 化学气相沉积（CVD）——通过气态前驱体反应形成薄膜。

options.text: Thermal oxidation — consume surface silicon to grow an insulating SiO₂ layer.
options.text_zh: 热氧化——消耗表面硅并生长绝缘 SiO₂ 层。

questions.explanation: Week 1 states that ion implantation intentionally introduces dopants to alter semiconductor electrical properties and create n-type and p-type regions. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.28.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 指出，离子注入通过有意引入掺杂剂改变半导体电学性质，并形成 n 型和 p 型区域。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 28 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about core semiconductor unit processes:
I. Etch is fundamentally a material-removal process.
II. CVD and PVD are thin-film deposition processes.
III. Ion implantation / doping changes semiconductor electrical properties by introducing dopants.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于核心半导体单元工艺，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 刻蚀本质上属于材料去除工艺。
II. CVD 与 PVD 属于薄膜沉积工艺。
III. 离子注入 / 掺杂通过引入掺杂剂改变半导体的电学性质。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

questions.explanation: The Week 1 process overview separates material removal (etch), deposition (CVD/PVD), and doping (ion implantation) as different unit-process functions. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.20.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 工艺概览将材料去除（刻蚀）、薄膜沉积（CVD/PVD）和掺杂（离子注入）区分为不同的单元工艺功能。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 20 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about a later-use comparison of two products with the same manufacturing yield:
I. Equal manufacturing yield does not imply that the two products must have equal reliability.
II. The ability to maintain intended function over operating time is a reliability property.
III. Manufacturing yield is defined primarily by how long a device continues to operate after shipment.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于两个制造良率相同产品的后续使用比较，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 制造良率相同并不意味着两个产品的可靠性必然相同。
II. 在工作时间内持续维持预期功能的能力属于可靠性属性。
III. 制造良率主要由器件出货后能够持续工作的时间来定义。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

questions.explanation: Yield measures the fraction of functional devices produced, whereas later time-dependent functional performance is captured by reliability. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.23.
questions.explanation_zh: 良率衡量制造得到的功能器件比例，而出货后的时间相关功能保持能力由可靠性表征。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 23 页。

questions.text: A company owns chip designs but outsources wafer fabrication and then uses a separate provider for assembly and test. Which supply-chain pairing best describes the two external partners?
questions.text_zh: 某公司拥有芯片设计，但将晶圆制造外包，并再由另一家供应商完成封装与测试。哪一组供应链角色最准确描述这两个外部合作方？

options.text: An EDA vendor for wafer fabrication and an IDM for board assembly.
options.text_zh: 由 EDA 供应商负责晶圆制造，由 IDM 负责板级组装。

options.text: A foundry for wafer fabrication and an OSAT provider for assembly and test.
options.text_zh: 由晶圆代工厂（foundry）负责晶圆制造，由 OSAT 负责封装与测试。

options.text: An OSAT provider for wafer fabrication and a foundry for final package test.
options.text_zh: 由 OSAT 负责晶圆制造，由晶圆代工厂负责最终封装测试。

options.text: A substrate supplier for wafer fabrication and an EDA vendor for package assembly.
options.text_zh: 由封装基板供应商负责晶圆制造，由 EDA 供应商负责封装组装。

questions.explanation: The ecosystem slides distinguish foundries as wafer-fabrication providers and OSAT companies as outsourced assembly-and-test providers. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.15-16.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件中的产业生态将晶圆代工厂定位为晶圆制造服务商，将 OSAT 定位为外包半导体封装与测试服务商。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 15-16 页。

questions.text: Which yield-engineering activity is most preventive because it seeks to make a design robust to manufacturing before volume production starts?
questions.text_zh: 哪一项良率工程活动最具预防性，因为它在量产开始前就力求使设计对制造波动更稳健？

options.text: Final package test after assembly.
options.text_zh: 封装完成后的最终测试。

options.text: Screening of returned field failures.
options.text_zh: 现场退回失效品筛选。

options.text: Post-failure root cause analysis.
options.text_zh: 失效后的根因分析。

options.text: Design for manufacturability (DFM).
options.text_zh: 可制造性设计（DFM）。

questions.explanation: DFM is explicitly listed as a yield-engineering activity and is applied before manufacturing to improve manufacturability and yield robustness. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.22.
questions.explanation_zh: DFM 被课件明确列为良率工程活动，并在制造前用于提高设计的可制造性与良率稳健性。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 22 页。

questions.text: Why is Reactive Ion Etching (RIE) described as intermediate between pure chemical and pure physical etching?
questions.text_zh: 为什么反应离子刻蚀（RIE）被描述为介于纯化学刻蚀与纯物理刻蚀之间？

options.text: It uses only liquid chemicals but at reduced temperature.
options.text_zh: 它只使用液体化学品，但在较低温度下进行。

options.text: It removes material only by mechanical slurry abrasion.
options.text_zh: 它仅通过浆料机械磨蚀去除材料。

options.text: It removes material only through photon absorption without ions or chemistry.
options.text_zh: 它仅通过光子吸收去除材料，不涉及离子或化学反应。

options.text: It combines chemically reactive species with ion-driven physical effects.
options.text_zh: 它结合了化学活性物种与离子驱动的物理作用。

questions.explanation: Week 1 places RIE between pure chemical and pure physical etch, reflecting its combined chemical and ion-assisted physical mechanisms. Source: EEK5106 week 1 Rev1, p.26.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 1 将 RIE 置于纯化学刻蚀与纯物理刻蚀之间，体现其同时利用化学反应和离子辅助物理作用。 来源：EEK5106 week 1 Rev1，第 26 页。

questions.text: Which two classification axes are used in the lecture to organize semiconductor memories?
questions.text_zh: 课件使用哪两个分类维度来组织半导体存储器？

options.text: Package type and technology node.
options.text_zh: 封装类型与技术节点。

options.text: Read speed and die area only.
options.text_zh: 仅按读取速度与芯片面积。

options.text: Interconnect metal and dielectric constant.
options.text_zh: 互连金属与介电常数。

options.text: Storage mechanism (charge vs resistance change) and volatility (volatile vs nonvolatile).
options.text_zh: 存储机制（电荷存储 vs 电阻变化）与易失性（易失 vs 非易失）。

questions.explanation: Week 2 categorizes memories by charge-storage versus resistance-change behavior and by volatile versus nonvolatile data retention. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.12.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 2 按电荷存储与电阻变化两类机制，以及易失与非易失的数据保持特性来分类存储器。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 12 页。

questions.text: A memory must retain information after system power is removed. Which property is required?
questions.text_zh: 某存储器必须在系统断电后仍保留信息。它需要具备哪种属性？

options.text: Volatile memory behavior.
options.text_zh: 易失性存储特性。

options.text: Refresh-dependent volatile retention.
options.text_zh: 依赖刷新的易失性保持。

options.text: Sense-amplifier operation without persistent storage.
options.text_zh: 无持久存储的感测放大器工作方式。

options.text: Nonvolatile memory behavior.
options.text_zh: 非易失性存储特性。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines nonvolatile memory as retaining stored information even after power is removed. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.13.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将非易失性存储器定义为在电源移除后仍能保留已存信息。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 13 页。

questions.text: During the hold state of the SRAM cell described in the lecture, what happens to the word line and access transistors?
questions.text_zh: 在课件所述 SRAM 单元的保持（hold）状态下，字线和访问晶体管处于什么状态？

options.text: The word line is 1 and the access transistors are ON while new data overwrite the latch.
options.text_zh: 字线为 1，访问晶体管导通，新数据覆盖锁存器。

options.text: The word line is 1 and the access transistors are ON while the sense amplifier reads the bit lines.
options.text_zh: 字线为 1，访问晶体管导通，感测放大器读取位线。

options.text: The word line is 0 and the access transistors are OFF, isolating the latch.
options.text_zh: 字线为 0，访问晶体管关断，使锁存器与位线隔离。

options.text: The word line is 0 but the access transistors remain ON to refresh the latch.
options.text_zh: 字线为 0，但访问晶体管保持导通以刷新锁存器。

questions.explanation: For SRAM hold, Week 2 states word line = 0, access transistors OFF, and data held in the latch. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.18.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 2 指出 SRAM 保持状态下字线为 0、访问晶体管关断，数据由锁存器保持。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 18 页。

questions.text: In the SRAM read operation, the sense amplifier sees bit > bit_bar. What output does the lecture assign?
questions.text_zh: 在 SRAM 读取过程中，若感测放大器检测到 bit > bit_bar，课件给出的输出是什么？

options.text: No valid logic level.
options.text_zh: 无有效逻辑电平。

options.text: A refresh request.
options.text_zh: 刷新请求。

options.text: Logic 0.
options.text_zh: 逻辑 0。

options.text: Logic 1.
options.text_zh: 逻辑 1。

questions.explanation: The SRAM operation slide states that the sense amplifier outputs 1 when bit > bit_bar and 0 when bit < bit_bar. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.18.
questions.explanation_zh: SRAM 工作原理课件指出，当 bit > bit_bar 时感测放大器输出 1；当 bit < bit_bar 时输出 0。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 18 页。

questions.text: An interconnect engineer is optimizing signal paths on an IC. Which combination belongs to the lecture's interconnect considerations?
questions.text_zh: 互连工程师正在优化 IC 上的信号通路。以下哪组内容属于课件列出的互连设计与工艺考量？

options.text: Dielectric materials, interconnect design, bond-wire loop shape, and mold curing.
options.text_zh: 介电材料、互连设计、键合线弧形与模塑固化。

options.text: Conductor materials, vias, molding compound, and wafer dicing.
options.text_zh: 导体材料、通孔、模塑料与晶圆切割。

options.text: Interconnect layers, electromigration, crystal pulling, and implant dose.
options.text_zh: 互连层、电迁移、晶体拉制与注入剂量。

options.text: Conductor materials, vias, dielectric materials, and planarization.
options.text_zh: 导体材料、通孔（vias）、介电材料与平坦化。

questions.explanation: Week 2 lists materials, layers, metallization/patterning, electromigration, dielectric materials, vias, planarization, and design as interconnect considerations. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.23.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 2 将材料、层次、金属化与图形化、电迁移、介电材料、通孔、平坦化和设计列为互连考量。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 23 页。

questions.text: As line dimensions shrink and current density rises, which aluminum-interconnect limitation becomes more serious according to the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 随着互连尺寸缩小、电流密度上升，根据课件，铝互连的哪项局限会更加突出？

options.text: Only a lower optical refractive index, with no electrical reliability impact.
options.text_zh: 只有较低的光学折射率，不影响电学可靠性。

options.text: Higher resistance and susceptibility to electromigration.
options.text_zh: 较高电阻以及对电迁移的敏感性。

options.text: Only excessive gate capacitance inside the transistor channel.
options.text_zh: 只有晶体管沟道内部过大的栅电容。

options.text: Only moisture penetration through the package mold compound.
options.text_zh: 只有水汽穿透封装模塑料的问题。

questions.explanation: The Al challenge slide emphasizes resistance and electromigration, both of which become more limiting as dimensions shrink and current density increases. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.28.
questions.explanation_zh: 铝互连挑战课件强调电阻与电迁移问题；随着尺寸缩小、电流密度提高，这些限制会更加显著。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 28 页。

questions.text: For a scaled interconnect where both signal resistance and electromigration margin are concerns, why does the lecture favor Cu over Al?
questions.text_zh: 在缩放互连中，如果同时关注信号电阻与电迁移裕量，课件为什么更倾向采用 Cu 而不是 Al？

options.text: Cu provides higher resistance but is accepted because it has worse electromigration resistance.
options.text_zh: Cu 电阻更高，且抗电迁移更差，但仍被采用。

options.text: Cu provides lower electrical resistance and better electromigration resistance.
options.text_zh: Cu 具有更低的电阻和更好的抗电迁移能力。

options.text: Cu and Al are electrically equivalent; the choice is mainly based on film color.
options.text_zh: Cu 与 Al 电学性能等同，选择主要取决于薄膜颜色。

options.text: Cu is favored because it acts as the low-k dielectric between metal lines.
options.text_zh: Cu 被采用是因为它充当金属线之间的低-k 介电层。

questions.explanation: Week 2 states that Cu has higher conductivity/lower resistance and better electromigration resistance than Al. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.31.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 2 指出，与 Al 相比，Cu 导电性更高、电阻更低，并具有更好的抗电迁移能力。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 31 页。

questions.text: Which package function directly addresses both electrical system integration and thermal management?
questions.text_zh: 封装的哪两项功能分别直接对应电气系统集成与热管理？

options.text: Providing electrical interconnection to the circuit board and transferring heat.
options.text_zh: 提供与电路板的电气互连并传递热量。

options.text: Providing signal transfer and defining source/drain dopant profiles.
options.text_zh: 提供信号传输并定义源/漏掺杂分布。

options.text: Protecting the bare die and aligning photolithography masks.
options.text_zh: 保护裸芯片并完成光刻掩模对准。

options.text: Blocking moisture and controlling silicon crystal growth orientation.
options.text_zh: 阻挡水汽并控制硅晶体生长取向。

questions.explanation: The packaging slide lists electrical interconnection with the circuit board, signal transfer, heat transfer, and die protection as package purposes. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.37.
questions.explanation_zh: 封装课件将与电路板的电气互连、信号传输、热传输以及裸芯片保护列为主要功能。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 37 页。

questions.section: Effects of Cu/Low-k on Wafer Dicing
questions.text: Why do crackstop structures and moisture/oxidation barriers become important when dicing Cu/low-k wafers?
questions.text_zh: 为什么在切割 Cu/low-k 晶圆时，crackstop 结构以及防潮/抗氧化屏障会变得重要？

options.text: They directly reduce transistor gate length during FEOL patterning.
options.text_zh: 它们在 FEOL 图形化过程中直接缩短晶体管栅长。

options.text: They help contain dicing-induced cracking and protect vulnerable Cu/low-k structures from environmental ingress.
options.text_zh: 它们有助于限制切割诱发裂纹，并保护脆弱的 Cu/low-k 结构免受环境介质侵入。

options.text: They increase DRAM refresh frequency after packaging.
options.text_zh: 它们提高封装后的 DRAM 刷新频率。

options.text: They replace solder bumps as the electrical connection in flip-chip packages.
options.text_zh: 它们在倒装芯片封装中替代焊凸点作为电连接。

questions.explanation: Week 2 identifies dicing damage as an early indicator of chip-package problems and notes that crackstop and moisture/oxidation barriers are essential for Cu/low-k integration. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.39.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 2 指出切割损伤是潜在芯片-封装问题的早期征兆，并强调 Cu/low-k 集成需要 crackstop 以及防潮/抗氧化屏障。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 39 页。

questions.section: Effects of Structural Design under Pad on Wire Bond Package
questions.text: A wire-pull test tears the top metal beneath a bond pad. Which layout condition in the lecture is associated with high tensile stress and this failure risk?
questions.text_zh: 引线拉力测试导致键合焊盘下方顶层金属撕裂。课件指出，哪种版图条件会产生较高拉伸应力并增加这种失效风险？

options.text: Keeping the region beneath the pad free of top metal and vias.
options.text_zh: 使焊盘下方区域不布置顶层金属和通孔。

options.text: Placing top metal and vias directly beneath the bond pad.
options.text_zh: 将顶层金属和通孔直接布置在键合焊盘下方。

options.text: Increasing die size without changing the pad stack.
options.text_zh: 仅增大芯片尺寸而不改变焊盘堆叠。

options.text: Reducing package humidity during electrical test.
options.text_zh: 在电测试期间降低封装湿度。

questions.explanation: The lecture reports that top metal and vias placed directly under the bond pad experience high tensile stress and can tear during wire pull. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.43.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，直接位于键合焊盘下方的顶层金属和通孔会承受较高拉伸应力，并可能在引线拉力测试中发生撕裂。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 43 页。

questions.text: Which dimensional criterion best matches the lecture definition of a Chip Scale Package (CSP)?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪一尺寸判据最符合课件对芯片级封装（CSP）的定义？

options.text: The package must be at least twice the die perimeter.
options.text_zh: 封装周边尺寸必须至少是芯片的两倍。

options.text: The package must have the same dimensions as the entire circuit board.
options.text_zh: 封装必须与整块电路板尺寸相同。

options.text: CSP is defined only by pin count and has no package-to-die size criterion.
options.text_zh: CSP 仅由引脚数定义，与封装相对芯片的尺寸无关。

options.text: The package perimeter is no more than about 20% larger than the IC.
options.text_zh: 封装周边尺寸相对 IC 不超过约 20%。

questions.explanation: Week 2 defines CSP as a package not more than 20% larger in perimeter than the IC. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.51.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 2 将 CSP 定义为封装周边尺寸相对 IC 不超过 20% 的封装。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 51 页。

questions.text: A non-hermetic package must be evaluated for moisture penetration using a deliberately more severe temperature-humidity-bias condition than conventional THB. Which test best matches this intent?
questions.text_zh: 需要评估非气密封装的水汽侵入，并采用比常规 THB 更严苛的温度-湿度-偏压条件。哪一种测试最符合该目的？

options.text: TC.
options.text_zh: TC。

options.text: HAST.
options.text_zh: HAST。

options.text: THB.
options.text_zh: THB。

options.text: HTB.
options.text_zh: HTB。
