questions.explanation: The lecture describes HAST as a severe temperature, humidity, and bias test that accelerates moisture penetration in non-hermetic packages. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.65.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将 HAST 描述为采用严苛温度、湿度和偏压条件，加速非气密封装中的水汽侵入。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 65 页。

questions.text: Which ESD qualification model is intended to simulate an ungrounded person touching a device lead?
questions.text_zh: 哪一种 ESD 认证模型用于模拟未接地人员触碰器件引脚的情况？

options.text: Charged Device Model (CDM).
options.text_zh: 带电器件模型（CDM）。

options.text: Latch-up (LU) test.
options.text_zh: 闩锁（LU）测试。

options.text: Machine Model (MM).
options.text_zh: 机器模型（MM）。

options.text: Human Body Model (HBM).
options.text_zh: 人体模型（HBM）。

questions.explanation: Week 2 states that HBM simulates the effect of a person touching a device lead while not grounded. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.66.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 2 指出，HBM 模拟未接地人员触碰器件引脚时产生的 ESD 作用。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 66 页。

questions.text: A device enters a low-impedance overcurrent state after an overstress, and the state persists even after the triggering condition is removed. Which test/failure phenomenon is being described?
questions.text_zh: 器件受过应力后进入低阻过电流状态，而且在触发条件移除后该状态仍持续。这里描述的是哪种测试/失效现象？

options.text: Soft error (SER event).
options.text_zh: 软错误（SER 事件）。

options.text: Latch-up (LU).
options.text_zh: 闩锁效应（LU）。

options.text: Electromigration (EM).
options.text_zh: 电迁移（EM）。

options.text: Time-Dependent Dielectric Breakdown (TDDB).
options.text_zh: 经时介质击穿（TDDB）。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines latch-up as a low-impedance path triggered by overstress that persists after the triggering condition ceases. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.66.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将闩锁定义为由过应力触发的低阻通路，并且在触发条件消失后仍可持续存在。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 66 页。

questions.text: An ionizing particle flips a stored logic state, but the circuit can recover after reset or the next refresh. Which reliability phenomenon best matches the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 电离粒子使存储逻辑状态翻转，但电路可在复位或下一次刷新后恢复。哪一种可靠性现象最符合课件描述？

options.text: A soft error; its occurrence rate is described by the Soft Error Rate (SER).
options.text_zh: 软错误；其发生频率用软错误率（SER）描述。

options.text: Permanent dielectric breakdown of the gate insulator.
options.text_zh: 栅介质的永久性介电击穿。

options.text: Progressive metal-atom transport causing an interconnect open or short.
options.text_zh: 金属原子逐渐迁移导致互连开路或短路。

options.text: Thermomechanical solder-joint fatigue at package level.
options.text_zh: 封装级热机械焊点疲劳。

questions.explanation: Week 2 describes soft errors as temporary logic inversions caused by ionizing radiation; the circuit generally recovers after reset or refresh, and the rate is SER. Source: EEK5106 week 2 Rev3, p.66.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 2 将软错误描述为电离辐射导致的暂时性逻辑翻转；电路通常可在复位或刷新后恢复，其发生率称为 SER。 来源：EEK5106 week 2 Rev3，第 66 页。

questions.text: A lithography process produces small features but suffers frequent overlay errors and random printing defects. Which pair of optical-lithography requirements is not being met?
questions.text_zh: 某光刻工艺能够形成小尺寸图形，但经常出现套刻误差和随机打印缺陷。它未满足哪两项光学光刻要求？

options.text: High resolution and high sensitivity only.
options.text_zh: 仅高分辨率与高感光度。

options.text: High etch rate and high etch selectivity.
options.text_zh: 高刻蚀速率与高刻蚀选择比。

options.text: High conductivity and electromigration resistance.
options.text_zh: 高导电性与抗电迁移能力。

options.text: Precise alignment and low defect density.
options.text_zh: 精确对准与低缺陷密度。

questions.explanation: The optical-lithography requirements listed in Week 3 are high resolution, high sensitivity, precise alignment, and low defect density. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.19.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 3 列出的光学光刻要求包括高分辨率、高感光度、精确对准以及低缺陷密度。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 19 页。

questions.text: Which lithography methods in the lecture can directly write a resist pattern without requiring a mask?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，哪类光刻方法可以不使用掩模而直接写入光刻胶图形？

options.text: X-ray lithography only.
options.text_zh: 仅 X 射线光刻。

options.text: Electron-beam and ion-beam lithography.
options.text_zh: 电子束光刻与离子束光刻。

options.text: Optical and X-ray lithography.
options.text_zh: 光学光刻与 X 射线光刻。

options.text: Optical lithography only.
options.text_zh: 仅光学光刻。

questions.explanation: Week 3 states that masks are required for optical and X-ray lithography, whereas e-beam and ion-beam lithography can use direct writing. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.20.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 3 指出光学光刻和 X 射线光刻需要掩模，而电子束和离子束光刻可直接写入。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 20 页。

questions.text: In the mask-generation flow shown in the lecture, what is the role of the developed photoresist on the chromium-coated fused-silica plate?
questions.text_zh: 在课件所示掩模制作流程中，熔融石英板铬层上的已显影光刻胶起什么作用？

options.text: It becomes the final opaque chromium absorber after exposure and development.
options.text_zh: 曝光显影后它本身成为最终不透明铬吸收层。

options.text: It serves as an etch mask for patterning the chromium layer.
options.text_zh: 它作为刻蚀掩模，用于图形化铬层。

options.text: It prevents developer from contacting chromium, so no chromium etch is required.
options.text_zh: 它阻止显影液接触铬层，因此无需进行铬刻蚀。

options.text: It becomes the permanent anti-reflection coating on top of the finished mask.
options.text_zh: 它成为最终掩模表面的永久减反射层。

questions.explanation: The mask-generation slide shows resist exposure and development followed by using the resist as the etch mask for the chromium layer. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.22.
questions.explanation_zh: 掩模制作课件显示：光刻胶曝光、显影后作为刻蚀掩模，对铬层进行刻蚀。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 22 页。

questions.text: Why does a stepper/step-and-scan exposure system support local die alignment and easier mask repair compared with full-wafer exposure?
questions.text_zh: 与整片晶圆一次曝光相比，为什么步进式/步进扫描曝光系统更利于局部芯片对准和掩模修复？

options.text: It keeps the mask in physical contact with the entire wafer during all exposures.
options.text_zh: 它在全部曝光过程中使掩模与整片晶圆保持物理接触。

options.text: It eliminates imaging optics and uses only wet chemical pattern transfer.
options.text_zh: 它取消成像光学系统，仅用湿法化学图形转移。

options.text: It exposes a limited wafer field at a time and typically uses a reduced mask image.
options.text_zh: 它每次只曝光晶圆上的有限区域，并通常采用缩小倍率的掩模成像。

options.text: It writes the entire wafer in one maskless electron-beam shot.
options.text_zh: 它用一次无掩模电子束曝光写完整片晶圆。

questions.explanation: The lecture notes that a stepper exposes a limited wafer area at a time, allows local die alignment, and uses 4X or 5X image reduction. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.29.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，步进机每次仅曝光晶圆上的有限区域，可进行局部芯片对准，并采用 4X 或 5X 缩小成像。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 29 页。

questions.text: Which property of ion-beam lithography is linked in the lecture to very high patterning resolution?
questions.text_zh: 课件将离子束光刻的哪项特性与很高的图形分辨率联系起来？

options.text: Heavy ions have high momentum, giving a very small wavelength and reduced scattering/diffraction.
options.text_zh: 重离子具有较高动量，因此波长很小，并可减少散射与衍射。

options.text: Heavy ions have a longer wavelength than UV light, increasing diffraction.
options.text_zh: 重离子波长比紫外光更长，因此增加衍射。

options.text: Resolution comes only from using a very thick resist layer.
options.text_zh: 高分辨率仅来自使用很厚的光刻胶。

options.text: Resolution requires hard physical contact between mask and wafer.
options.text_zh: 高分辨率要求掩模与晶圆硬接触。

questions.explanation: Week 3 attributes ion-beam resolution to the high momentum of ions, which gives a smaller wavelength and reduces scattering and diffraction. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.33.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 3 将离子束的高分辨率归因于离子的高动量，使其波长更小并减少散射与衍射。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 33 页。

questions.text: A pattern-transfer etch removes the target film faster at the wafer center than at the edge and also changes linewidth from the mask value. Which two etch considerations are implicated?
questions.text_zh: 图形转移刻蚀中，目标薄膜在晶圆中心的去除速度高于边缘，同时刻蚀后线宽偏离掩模值。涉及哪两项刻蚀关键指标？

options.text: Etch selectivity and sidewall profile.
options.text_zh: 刻蚀选择比与侧壁轮廓。

options.text: Etch rate and loading effect.
options.text_zh: 刻蚀速率与负载效应。

options.text: Etch selectivity and loading effect.
options.text_zh: 刻蚀选择比与负载效应。

options.text: Etch uniformity and etch bias.
options.text_zh: 刻蚀均匀性与刻蚀偏差（etch bias）。

questions.explanation: Week 3 lists etch rate, uniformity, selectivity, profile, etch bias, and loading effects as key etch considerations. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.39.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 3 将刻蚀速率、均匀性、选择比、轮廓、刻蚀偏差及负载效应列为刻蚀的重要考量。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 39 页。

questions.text: Why is wet etching generally assigned to noncritical feature sizes in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 为什么课件通常将湿法刻蚀用于非关键尺寸图形？

options.text: It is excessively anisotropic and cannot laterally remove any material.
options.text_zh: 它过度各向异性，完全无法横向去除材料。

options.text: It has limited anisotropy, poorer process control, and can introduce particulate contamination.
options.text_zh: 其各向异性能力有限、工艺控制较差，并可能引入颗粒污染。

options.text: It cannot chemically dissolve wafer materials.
options.text_zh: 它不能通过化学方式溶解晶圆材料。

options.text: It requires high vacuum and RF plasma for all reactions.
options.text_zh: 它的所有反应都需要高真空和 RF 等离子体。

questions.explanation: The lecture lists lack of anisotropy, poor process control, and excessive particulate contamination as wet-etch drawbacks, and therefore associates wet etch with noncritical feature sizes. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.47.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件列出湿法刻蚀的缺点包括各向异性不足、工艺控制较差和颗粒污染，并因此将其主要用于非关键尺寸图形。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 47 页。

questions.text: In plasma dry etching, how can ion bombardment accelerate material removal in addition to the action of reactive radicals?
questions.text_zh: 在等离子体干法刻蚀中，除活性自由基的化学作用外，离子轰击还可如何加速材料去除？

options.text: By only cooling the wafer without affecting bonds or material removal.
options.text_zh: 仅通过冷却晶圆，不影响化学键或材料去除。

options.text: By depositing a permanent metal film over the surface.
options.text_zh: 通过在表面沉积永久金属薄膜。

options.text: By physically removing surface material and/or breaking surface bonds to accelerate chemical reaction.
options.text_zh: 通过物理去除表面材料和/或打断表面化学键，从而加速化学反应。

options.text: By electrically neutralizing implanted dopants in the substrate.
options.text_zh: 通过电中和衬底中的已注入掺杂剂。

questions.explanation: Week 3 explains that ion bombardment can physically remove material or break surface bonds, thereby accelerating the etch reaction. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.48.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 3 说明离子轰击可直接物理去除材料，或打断表面化学键，从而加快刻蚀反应。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 48 页。

questions.text: Why can plasma-induced particle contamination (PIC) cause a sudden defect problem when a dry-etch plasma is shut down?
questions.text_zh: 为什么在干法刻蚀等离子体关闭时，等离子体诱导颗粒污染（PIC）可能突然造成缺陷问题？

options.text: Implanted dopants immediately evaporate from the wafer when RF power is removed.
options.text_zh: RF 功率移除后，已注入掺杂剂立即从晶圆蒸发。

options.text: Negatively charged particles suspended near the plasma/sheath interface can fall onto the wafer when the plasma disappears.
options.text_zh: 悬浮在等离子体/鞘层界面附近的带负电颗粒会在等离子体消失后落到晶圆上。

options.text: A thick thermal oxide instantly grows when the chamber pressure falls.
options.text_zh: 腔体压力下降时立即生长厚热氧化层。

options.text: Package solder joints melt during plasma shut-down.
options.text_zh: 等离子体关闭时封装焊点熔化。

questions.explanation: Week 3 notes that charged particles can remain suspended at the plasma/sheath interface and then fall onto the wafer when the plasma is turned off. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.49.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 3 指出，带电颗粒可悬浮在等离子体/鞘层界面；当等离子体关闭后，这些颗粒可能落到晶圆上并造成器件失效。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 49 页。

questions.text: What distinguishes stealth dicing from conventional mechanical sawing in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，隐形切割（stealth dicing）与常规机械锯切的主要区别是什么？

options.text: A focused laser creates a subsurface damage layer that enables precise die separation with reduced direct surface damage.
options.text_zh: 聚焦激光在晶圆内部形成亚表面损伤层，从而实现精确分离并减少直接表面损伤。

options.text: A rotating diamond saw mechanically cuts completely through the wafer along the streets.
options.text_zh: 旋转金刚石锯沿划片道机械切穿整片晶圆。

options.text: A laser removes material only by ablating an open trench from the wafer surface downward.
options.text_zh: 激光仅通过从晶圆表面向下烧蚀形成开放切槽来分离芯片。

options.text: A plasma etch removes the full wafer thickness along the dicing streets without a subsurface modified layer.
options.text_zh: 等离子刻蚀沿划片道去除整个晶圆厚度，不形成亚表面改性层。

questions.explanation: Week 3 describes stealth dicing as using a focused laser to form a subsurface damage layer for precise, clean separation. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.65.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 3 将隐形切割描述为利用聚焦激光在晶圆内部形成亚表面损伤层，实现精确、洁净的芯片分离。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 65 页。

questions.text: Which package function is most directly related to preventing moisture and chemical impurities from reaching the die?
questions.text_zh: 封装的哪项功能最直接用于防止水汽和化学杂质到达裸芯片？

options.text: Providing a sturdy lead system for electrical connection to external circuits.
options.text_zh: 提供坚固引线系统以连接外部电路。

options.text: Providing a path to dissipate heat generated during chip operation.
options.text_zh: 提供芯片工作时产生热量的散热通路。

options.text: Providing a protective barrier against chemical impurities and moisture.
options.text_zh: 提供阻挡化学杂质和水汽的保护屏障。

options.text: Providing mechanical protection against handling and external damage.
options.text_zh: 提供抵抗搬运和外部损伤的机械保护。

questions.explanation: The packaging slide lists a barrier against chemical impurities and moisture as one of the four main reasons for chip packaging. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.66.
questions.explanation_zh: 封装课件将“阻挡化学杂质和水汽”列为芯片封装的四个主要目的之一。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 66 页。

questions.text: A board design prioritizes high mounting density and design flexibility over the strongest through-board solder joints. Which assembly technology best matches the lecture comparison?
questions.text_zh: 某电路板设计优先追求高安装密度与设计灵活性，而不是最强的穿孔焊点。根据课件比较，应优先选择哪种组装技术？

options.text: Surface Mount Technology (SMT), which supports higher mounting density and design flexibility.
options.text_zh: 表面贴装技术（SMT），可支持更高的安装密度与设计灵活性。

options.text: Wire bonding, which forms die-to-package interconnections rather than mounting board-level components.
options.text_zh: 引线键合，用于形成芯片到封装体的互连，而非安装板级元件。

options.text: Stealth dicing, which separates dies at wafer level rather than assembling components onto a PCB.
options.text_zh: 隐形切割，用于晶圆级芯片分离，而非将元件组装到 PCB。

options.text: Thru-hole Technology (THT), which emphasizes strong through-board solder joints but lower mounting density.
options.text_zh: 通孔插装技术（THT），强调较强的穿孔焊点，但安装密度较低。

questions.explanation: Week 3 notes that THT gives easier placement and stronger solder joints but sacrifices design flexibility and mounting density; SMT mounts components on the surface and dominates modern applications. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.68.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 3 指出，THT 更易焊接且焊点更强，但会牺牲设计灵活性和安装密度；SMT 将元件贴装于表面，并广泛用于现代应用。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 68 页。

questions.text: Which feature of flip-chip assembly enables a smaller package compared with perimeter wire-bond connections?
questions.text_zh: 与周边引线键合相比，倒装芯片组装的哪项特征有助于减小封装尺寸？

options.text: Bump connections can be distributed over the die area instead of being limited to perimeter wire-bond pads.
options.text_zh: 凸点连接可分布在芯片面积范围内，而不受周边引线键合焊盘的限制。

options.text: It requires a larger lead frame around the full die perimeter for each connection.
options.text_zh: 它要求沿整个芯片周边为每个连接配置更大的引线框架。

options.text: It replaces bumps with longer bond wires that route across the package cavity.
options.text_zh: 它用跨越封装腔体的更长键合线替代凸点。

options.text: It confines all I/O connections to a single die edge to simplify routing.
options.text_zh: 它将所有 I/O 连接限制在芯片单侧边缘以简化布线。

questions.explanation: The lecture notes that flip-chip interconnections allow connections over the chip area rather than relying on perimeter wire bonds, which can significantly reduce package size. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.72.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，倒装芯片可在芯片面积范围内布置互连，而不依赖周边引线键合，因此能够显著减小封装尺寸。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 72 页。

questions.text: During transfer molding, why is pressure applied by the plunger after the compound becomes molten?
questions.text_zh: 在转移模塑过程中，模塑料熔融后为什么要由柱塞施加压力？

options.text: Drive liquid underfill beneath a flip-chip die purely by capillary action between solder bumps.
options.text_zh: 仅依靠毛细作用将液态 underfill 引入倒装芯片焊点之间。

options.text: Extrude solder through the UBM stack to create flip-chip bumps after wafer dicing.
options.text_zh: 晶圆切割后通过 UBM 堆栈挤出焊料以形成倒装芯片凸点。

options.text: Force molten molding compound through runners into the package cavities and expel trapped air through vents.
options.text_zh: 将熔融塑封料经流道压入封装型腔，并通过排气口排出滞留空气。

options.text: Compress bonding wires against pads to form the Au-Al metallurgical interface during wire bonding.
options.text_zh: 在引线键合时把键合线压向焊盘，以形成 Au-Al 冶金界面。

questions.explanation: Week 3 describes the plunger as forcing molten molding compound through runners into each cavity and applying pressure to fully fill the cavity and push air out of vents. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.76.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 3 描述柱塞将熔融模塑料经流道压入各模腔，并施压使模腔完全充填，同时从排气孔排出空气。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 76 页。

questions.text: Why does integrating a high-performance bipolar process with a baseline CMOS flow increase process complexity?
questions.text_zh: 为什么将高性能双极型工艺与基准 CMOS 流程集成会增加工艺复杂度？

options.text: BiCMOS eliminates the need for lithography masks used in CMOS.
options.text_zh: BiCMOS 可消除 CMOS 中对光刻掩模的需求。

options.text: The added complexity occurs only after wafer fabrication during board assembly.
options.text_zh: 新增复杂度只发生在晶圆制造后的板级组装阶段。

options.text: Additional mask levels and process steps must be added and coordinated with the existing CMOS sequence.
options.text_zh: 需要增加额外掩模层级和工艺步骤，并与现有 CMOS 流程协调集成。

options.text: The bipolar device is formed in one step that is independent of the CMOS process.
options.text_zh: 双极器件由一个与 CMOS 工艺无关的单一步骤形成。

questions.explanation: Week 3 emphasizes that advanced IC manufacturing requires tightly integrated steps and states that merging high-performance bipolar with baseline CMOS requires four additional mask levels. Source: EEK5106_week 3, p.78, 83.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 3 强调先进 IC 制造需要各工艺步骤紧密集成，并指出将高性能双极工艺与基准 CMOS 合并需要额外四层掩模。 来源：EEK5106_week 3，第 78、83 页。

questions.text: According to the lecture, why is particle control a first-order yield concern in wafer fabrication?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，为什么颗粒控制是晶圆制造中首要的良率问题之一？

options.text: Only very large particles above about 10 μm materially affect wafer-fab yield; submicron particles are generally harmless.
options.text_zh: 只有约 10 μm 以上的大颗粒会显著影响晶圆厂良率，亚微米颗粒通常无害。

options.text: Particle counts are used mainly as an equipment-utilization metric and are not linked to pattern or device yield loss.
options.text_zh: 颗粒计数主要用于设备利用率评价，与图形或器件良率损失没有直接关系。

options.text: Particle contamination mainly affects packaged devices after assembly and is not a major wafer-fabrication yield mechanism.
options.text_zh: 颗粒污染主要影响封装后的器件，并不是晶圆制造阶段的重要良率机制。

options.text: Particle contamination accounts for a major share of wafer-fab yield loss, with roughly 0.1–0.3 μm particles identified as key contributors.
options.text_zh: 颗粒污染占晶圆厂良率损失的重要比例，其中约 0.1–0.3 μm 颗粒被指出是主要贡献者。

questions.explanation: Week 4 states that particle contamination accounts for a large fraction of wafer-fab yield loss and highlights 0.1-0.3 µm particles as important contributors. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.11.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 指出颗粒污染占晶圆厂良率损失的很大比例，并特别强调 0.1-0.3 µm 颗粒是重要贡献者。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 11 页。

questions.section: Particles versus Chip Area versus Yield versus Defect Densities
questions.text: A product team wants high yield on a relatively large die. What implication follows from the Week 4 defect-density discussion?
questions.text_zh: 某产品团队希望在较大芯片面积下仍获得高良率。根据 Week 4 对缺陷密度的讨论，应得出什么结论？

options.text: Only packaging yield matters; wafer defect density no longer affects die yield.
options.text_zh: 只需关注封装良率，晶圆缺陷密度不再影响芯片良率。

options.text: A larger die permits a higher killer-defect density without yield impact.
options.text_zh: 芯片越大，允许的致命缺陷密度越高且不影响良率。

options.text: The allowable defect density must be driven to a very low level.
options.text_zh: 必须将可接受的缺陷密度降到很低。

options.text: Particle density can be ignored once the die area increases.
options.text_zh: 芯片面积增大后可忽略颗粒密度。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that defect densities must be extremely small to achieve high, profitable yields, with die size strongly influencing exposure to defects. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.12.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，要获得高且具有盈利性的良率，缺陷密度必须极低；芯片面积越大，暴露于缺陷的机会也越多。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 12 页。

questions.text: Which description matches the lecture definition of a particle in the contamination context?
questions.text_zh: 在污染控制语境下，以下哪一描述符合课件对“颗粒（particle）”的定义？

options.text: A free electron generated only during plasma processing.
options.text_zh: 仅在等离子体工艺中产生的自由电子。

options.text: An intentionally implanted dopant atom inside the silicon lattice.
options.text_zh: 硅晶格内有意注入的单个掺杂原子。

options.text: A stable, non-volatile conglomeration of molecules spanning nanometer-to-millimeter scale.
options.text_zh: 由分子形成的稳定、非挥发性聚集体，尺寸可从纳米级延伸到毫米级。

options.text: A purely volatile gas molecule that cannot persist on a surface.
options.text_zh: 只能是不会在表面持续存在的挥发性气体分子。

questions.explanation: Week 4 defines a particle as a stable, non-volatile conglomeration of molecules, with a stated size range of roughly 2 nm to 2 mm. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.13.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 将颗粒定义为由分子组成的稳定、非挥发性聚集体，并给出约 2 nm 到 2 mm 的尺寸范围。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 13 页。

questions.text: Why can a single foreign particle become a “killer defect” in an interconnect pattern?
questions.text_zh: 为什么一个外来颗粒可能在互连图形中成为“致命缺陷（killer defect）”？

options.text: It can improve linewidth control by acting as a local hard mask.
options.text_zh: 它可充当局部硬掩模，从而改善线宽控制。

options.text: It generally lowers interconnect resistance by adding conductive material.
options.text_zh: 它通常通过增加导电材料来降低互连电阻。

options.text: It can disrupt pattern formation enough to create an electrical open, short, or other fatal circuit defect.
options.text_zh: 它可能严重破坏图形形成，导致电气开路、短路或其他致命电路缺陷。

options.text: It increases surface planarity and improves photolithography focus.
options.text_zh: 它可提高表面平坦度并改善光刻对焦。

questions.explanation: The killer-defect slide illustrates how foreign particles can interfere with interconnect patterns and create fatal electrical defects. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.16.
questions.explanation_zh: 致命缺陷课件展示了外来颗粒如何干扰互连图形并造成足以使电路失效的电气缺陷。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 16 页。

questions.text: Particles are detected after plasma etch and are suspected to originate within the etch module rather than from operators. Which source is consistent with the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 等离子刻蚀后检测到颗粒，怀疑来源于刻蚀模块内部而非操作人员。根据课件，哪一来源最符合该情况？

options.text: Particles formed by the plasma process or introduced from the process gas source.
options.text_zh: 由等离子体工艺形成的颗粒，或来自工艺气源的颗粒。

options.text: Particles suspended in RCA-clean liquid or residing on the surface of a wet-process bath.
options.text_zh: 悬浮于 RCA 清洗液中的颗粒，或附着在湿法槽体表面的颗粒。

options.text: Particles generated by mechanical movement in a diffusion furnace.
options.text_zh: 扩散炉机械运动产生的颗粒。

options.text: Particles from dried developer or spinner-generated residue in photolithography.
options.text_zh: 光刻中由干燥显影液或旋涂设备产生的残留颗粒。

questions.explanation: Week 4 lists plasma-etch particle sources as particles formed by the process and particles from the gas source. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.23.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 将等离子刻蚀中的颗粒来源列为工艺自身形成的颗粒以及来自气源的颗粒。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 23 页。

questions.text: A fab-wide particle excursion coincides with loss of room positive pressure and abnormal recirculation flow. Which source category best matches the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 全厂颗粒异常同时伴随洁净室正压丧失和循环气流异常。根据课件，这最符合哪一类污染来源？

options.text: LPCVD flakes from previous depositions or particles formed by the deposition process.
options.text_zh: LPCVD 以往沉积产生的剥落物或沉积过程形成的颗粒。

options.text: Facilities problems in the cleanroom/air-handling system.
options.text_zh: 洁净室/空气处理系统的设施问题。

options.text: Ion-implantation contamination generated by mechanical movement inside the tool.
options.text_zh: 离子注入设备内部机械运动产生的污染。

options.text: RCA-clean or wet-etch contamination from particles in liquids or on bath surfaces.
options.text_zh: RCA 清洗或湿法刻蚀中来自液体或槽体表面的颗粒污染。

questions.explanation: Week 4 lists loss of positive pressure, HEPA failure, air-flow problems, dirty equipment/areas, and people under facilities-related contamination problems. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.25.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 将正压丧失、HEPA 失效、气流问题、设备/区域污染和人员等列入设施相关污染问题。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 25 页。

questions.text: Why are strict gowning rules and limits on personnel effective contamination controls in a semiconductor cleanroom?
questions.text_zh: 为什么严格的洁净服规范和限制人员数量能有效控制半导体洁净室污染？

options.text: Cleanroom garments are used mainly to increase laminar-airflow velocity.
options.text_zh: 洁净服的主要用途是提高层流风速。

options.text: Sodium contamination comes primarily from HEPA filter media, not people.
options.text_zh: 钠污染主要来自 HEPA 滤材，而不是人员。

options.text: People emit large numbers of particles and are a major source of sodium/mobile-ion contamination.
options.text_zh: 人员会释放大量颗粒，并且是钠/可移动离子污染的重要来源。

options.text: People naturally absorb airborne particles and therefore reduce cleanroom counts.
options.text_zh: 人员会自然吸收空气颗粒，因此可降低洁净室颗粒数。

questions.explanation: Week 4 states that humans emit many particles and are a major source of sodium; cleanroom garments and personnel control reduce these contamination inputs. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.33.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 指出人员会释放大量颗粒，也是钠污染的重要来源；洁净服和人员数量控制可降低这些污染输入。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 33 页。

questions.text: Why is neutralizing static charge relevant to yield and reliability control in a fab?
questions.text_zh: 为什么中和静电荷与晶圆厂的良率和可靠性控制有关？

options.text: It reduces the risk of ESD events that can cause localized heating, junction breakdown, and gate-oxide damage.
options.text_zh: 它可降低 ESD 风险，避免局部过热、结击穿和栅氧化层损伤。

options.text: It primarily removes submicron airborne particles by HEPA filtration.
options.text_zh: 它主要通过 HEPA 过滤去除亚微米空气颗粒。

options.text: It primarily removes ionic contamination from process water by deionization.
options.text_zh: 它主要通过去离子去除工艺水中的离子污染。

options.text: It primarily prevents dirty outside air from entering by maintaining room positive pressure.
options.text_zh: 它主要通过维持洁净室正压来阻止外部脏空气进入。

questions.explanation: The static-charge slide links ESD to localized overheating, silicon-junction breakdown, gate-oxide damage, and other electrical damage. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.37.
questions.explanation_zh: 静电控制课件将 ESD 与局部过热、硅结击穿、栅氧化层损伤及其他电气损伤联系起来。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 37 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about membrane and electrostatic filtration:
I. Membrane filtration separates particles from liquid solutions or gas mixtures through a membrane-based separation process.
II. Electrostatic filtration uses electrical charge to capture dust, pollen, and other airborne particles.
III. Both methods are described in the lecture as copper-removal steps performed by CMP slurry abrasion.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于膜过滤与静电过滤，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 膜过滤通过膜分离过程从液体溶液或气体混合物中分离颗粒。
II. 静电过滤利用电荷捕获灰尘、花粉及其他空气颗粒。
III. 课件将两者都描述为通过 CMP 浆料磨蚀去除铜的步骤。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: The lecture distinguishes membrane separation for fluids/gas mixtures from electrostatic capture of airborne particles; neither is a CMP copper-removal mechanism. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.39-40.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将用于液体/气体混合物颗粒分离的膜过滤与利用静电捕获空气颗粒的静电过滤区分开来；二者都不是 CMP 去铜机制。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 39-40 页。

questions.text: Sampling electrical tests on scribe-line test structures show that most transistors and circuits fail specification. What response is most consistent with the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 划片道测试结构的抽样电测试显示，大多数晶体管和电路不符合规格。根据课件，最合理的响应是什么？

options.text: Widen the electrical specification limits for the test structures so the current wafer batch can remain in production.
options.text_zh: 放宽测试结构的电学规格限，使当前晶圆批次可以继续生产。

options.text: Complete packaging first and use final test as the only basis for deciding whether the wafer process was abnormal.
options.text_zh: 先完成封装，只依据最终测试判断晶圆工艺是否异常。

options.text: Hold or stop the affected wafers, scrap the batch when appropriate, and perform rapid physical failure analysis to identify the mechanism/root cause.
options.text_zh: 暂停或停止受影响晶圆，必要时报废该批次，并快速开展物理失效分析以识别失效机制/根因。

options.text: Continue normal processing because scribe-line test structures are physically separated from product dies and therefore cannot indicate a process problem.
options.text_zh: 继续正常加工，因为划片道测试结构与产品芯片物理分离，因此不能反映工艺问题。

questions.explanation: Week 4 states that widespread test-structure failure indicates real devices are unlikely to meet requirements; processing is stopped, the batch is usually scrapped, and physical FA is performed quickly. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.44.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 指出，测试结构大面积失效意味着真实器件也很可能不达标；应停止加工，通常报废受影响批次，并快速进行物理失效分析。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 44 页。

questions.text: Which combination best characterizes the AOI system described in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 以下哪组特征最符合课件中的自动光学检测（AOI）系统？

options.text: A transmission electron microscope used only for atomic-resolution cross sections.
options.text_zh: 仅用于原子分辨率截面的透射电子显微镜。

options.text: An optical microscope combined with CCD imaging and automation for wafer-defect inspection.
options.text_zh: 光学显微镜结合 CCD 成像与自动化，用于晶圆缺陷检测。

options.text: An electrical wafer prober with no optical imaging capability.
options.text_zh: 不具备光学成像能力的电学晶圆探针台。

options.text: An X-ray diffraction system used primarily for crystal-orientation measurement.
options.text_zh: 主要用于晶体取向测量的 X 射线衍射系统。

questions.explanation: Week 4 describes AOI as an optical microscope coupled with CCDs and automation capability, with bright-field and dark-field modes. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.46.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 将 AOI 描述为光学显微镜与 CCD 和自动化能力的结合，并具有明场与暗场模式。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 46 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about bright-field and dark-field microscopy:
I. Dark-field illumination makes outlines, edges, boundaries, and refractive-index gradients appear bright against a dark background.
II. Bright-field microscopy typically produces a darker sample on a bright background because contrast comes from attenuation of transmitted white light.
III. Dark-field microscopy is described as the simplest transmitted-white-light mode in which dense sample regions appear dark on a bright background.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于明场与暗场显微成像，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 暗场照明使轮廓、边缘、边界和折射率梯度在暗背景上呈亮像。
II. 明场显微镜通常表现为亮背景上的较暗样品，其对比度来自透射白光在样品致密区域的衰减。
III. 课件将暗场显微镜描述为最简单的透射白光模式，其中致密样品区域在亮背景上呈暗像。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: The third statement describes bright-field behavior, not dark-field. The first two statements match the Week 4 comparison. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.47.
questions.explanation_zh: 第三项描述的是明场行为，而不是暗场；前两项与 Week 4 的明场/暗场比较一致。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 47 页。

questions.text: Why is a repeated spatial cluster across wafer maps more actionable than an isolated random point defect?
questions.text_zh: 为什么在多张晶圆图上重复出现的空间聚类，比孤立随机点缺陷更具工程可行动性？

options.text: Spatial clustering is useful only for wafer-map appearance and not for RCA.
options.text_zh: 空间聚类只影响晶圆图外观，对 RCA 没有价值。

options.text: Any cluster proves the circuit design is correct and excludes process causes.
options.text_zh: 任何聚类都能证明电路设计正确并排除工艺原因。

options.text: A cluster is, by definition, less correlated with manufacturing than a random point defect.
options.text_zh: 按照定义，聚类与制造过程的相关性低于随机点缺陷。

options.text: The correlated pattern can point to a systematic manufacturing source shared by many defects.
options.text_zh: 相关空间图形可指向许多缺陷共同的系统性制造来源。

questions.explanation: Week 4 describes systematic clusters as many individual defects correlated to each other based on a manufacturing source. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.49.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 将系统性聚类描述为由制造来源关联起来的多个单独缺陷，因此可为根因定位提供重要线索。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 49 页。

questions.text: A wafer-map signature is being used during root-cause analysis. Which set of causes is explicitly within the scope of defect-map interpretation in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 在根因分析中使用晶圆缺陷图特征。根据课件，缺陷图可用于分析哪一组原因？

options.text: Only whether the product uses SRAM or DRAM.
options.text_zh: 仅产品采用 SRAM 还是 DRAM。

options.text: Yield loss causes, parametric process problems, circuit-design problems, and random point defects.
options.text_zh: 良率损失原因、参数性工艺问题、电路设计问题以及随机点缺陷。

options.text: Only package color and product labeling differences.
options.text_zh: 仅封装颜色和产品标签差异。

options.text: Only market-demand changes and shipment volume.
options.text_zh: 仅市场需求变化和出货量。

questions.explanation: Week 4 states that defect maps are used for RCA of less-than-perfect yield, parametric processing problems, circuit-design problems, and random point defects. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.50.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 指出，缺陷图可用于分析良率不完美的原因、参数性工艺问题、电路设计问题以及随机点缺陷。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 50 页。

questions.text: After an RCA team implements a process change, which follow-up best represents the preventive-action logic emphasized in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: RCA 团队实施工艺变更后，哪种后续措施最符合课件强调的预防措施（PA）逻辑？

options.text: Close the issue immediately after the change with no effectiveness check.
options.text_zh: 变更完成后立即结案，不再检查措施有效性。

options.text: Replace all fab equipment regardless of the identified root cause.
options.text_zh: 无论根因是什么，都更换全部晶圆厂设备。

options.text: Monitor effectiveness with relevant indicators, investigate recurrence, and incorporate lessons learned into future procedures.
options.text_zh: 用相关指标监控措施有效性，调查是否复发，并将经验教训纳入未来流程。

options.text: Perform defect classification only and avoid any process or procedure updates.
options.text_zh: 只进行缺陷分类，不更新任何工艺或流程。

questions.explanation: Week 4 describes preventive follow-up as monitoring corrective-action effectiveness, conducting follow-up investigation to prevent recurrence, and embedding lessons learned in future processes/procedures. Source: EEK5106 week 4 Rev1, p.53-54.
questions.explanation_zh: Week 4 将预防性后续工作描述为监控纠正措施的有效性、进行后续调查以避免复发，并将经验教训纳入未来工艺和流程。 来源：EEK5106 week 4 Rev1，第 53-54 页。

questions.text: A process remains close to target on average, but its lot-to-lot spread is becoming less repeatable. Which SPC objective from the lecture most directly addresses this situation?
questions.text_zh: 某工艺的平均值仍接近目标值，但批次间波动越来越不稳定、重复性变差。根据课件，哪项 SPC 目标最直接针对这一情况？

options.text: Treat the larger spread as evidence that process control is unnecessary as long as the mean is stable.
options.text_zh: 只要均值稳定，就把波动增大视为无需过程控制的证据。

options.text: Widen product specification limits so that the existing variation appears acceptable.
options.text_zh: 放宽产品规格限，使现有变差看起来可以接受。

options.text: Use SPC problem-solving tools to restore process stability and reduce variability.
options.text_zh: 使用 SPC 问题解决工具恢复过程稳定性并降低变差。

options.text: Replace process monitoring with final inspection because the process average is still near target.
options.text_zh: 因为过程平均值仍接近目标值，所以用最终检验取代过程监控。

questions.explanation: SPC is presented as a collection of problem-solving tools for achieving process stability and reducing variability; a less repeatable spread is therefore a direct SPC concern. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.3-4.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将 SPC 定义为用于实现过程稳定并降低变差的一组问题解决工具，因此重复性变差的波动扩大正是 SPC 要直接处理的问题。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 3-4 页。

questions.text: A sample point plots above the Upper Control Limit (UCL), but the product specification status has not yet been checked. What conclusion is supported directly by the control chart?
questions.text_zh: 某样本点落在上控制限（UCL）之外，但尚未检查该产品是否超出规格。仅依据控制图，可以直接得出什么结论？

options.text: The product is certainly outside its specification limits and must be scrapped.
options.text_zh: 该产品必然超出规格限，必须报废。

options.text: The process remains in control because a single point cannot indicate a process shift.
options.text_zh: 过程仍处于受控状态，因为单个点不能反映过程偏移。

options.text: The UCL should be moved upward immediately so that the point falls inside the chart.
options.text_zh: 应立即上移 UCL，使该点重新落入控制图范围内。

options.text: The point is evidence that the process is statistically out of control and should be investigated.
options.text_zh: 该点表明过程存在统计失控证据，应启动调查。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that a point outside the control limits is interpreted as evidence that the process is out of control; this does not by itself establish product-specification failure. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.5.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，控制点落在控制限之外应解释为过程失控的证据；但仅凭这一点并不能直接判定产品已超出规格限。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 5 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about individual versus mean control-chart plotting:
I. Plotting individual measurements retains all measured information, although a large data set can be difficult to analyze.
II. Plotting subgroup means reduces the data set and makes it easier to manage, but it no longer provides a clear view of every individual measurement.
III. Using subgroup means always preserves more information than plotting the individual measurements.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于单值控制图与均值控制图的取舍，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 绘制单个测量值可保留全部测量信息，但数据量很大时分析可能较困难。
II. 绘制子组均值可缩小数据集、便于管理，但无法清楚呈现每个单独测量值。
III. 使用子组均值总能比绘制单个测量值保留更多信息。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

questions.explanation: The lecture presents individual plotting as information-rich but data-heavy, while mean plotting is easier to manage at the cost of losing a clear view of all individual information. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.7.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，单值绘图保留信息更完整但数据量大；均值绘图更易管理，但会失去对全部单个测量信息的清晰呈现。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 7 页。

questions.text: For an in-control process, the Type I error probability is α = 0.005. Using the lecture definition ARL = 1/α, what is the in-control Average Run Length (ARL)?
questions.text_zh: 对于处于统计受控状态的过程，第一类错误概率 α = 0.005。根据课件中的 ARL = 1/α，受控状态下的平均运行长度（ARL）是多少？

options.text: 500 samples
options.text_zh: 500 个样本

options.text: 20 samples
options.text_zh: 20 个样本

options.text: 200 samples
options.text_zh: 200 个样本

options.text: 100 samples
options.text_zh: 100 个样本

questions.explanation: For an in-control process, ARL = 1/α. Therefore 1/0.005 = 200 samples on average before a false out-of-control signal. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.9.
questions.explanation_zh: 受控过程的 ARL = 1/α，因此 1/0.005 = 200，即平均约 200 个样本后出现一次误报失控信号。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 9 页。

questions.text: For an out-of-control process, β = 0.95 is the Type II error probability. Using ARL = 1/(1 − β), what is the Average Run Length?
questions.text_zh: 对于已失控的过程，第二类错误概率 β = 0.95。根据 ARL = 1/(1 − β)，平均运行长度是多少？

options.text: 20 samples
options.text_zh: 20 个样本

options.text: 95 samples
options.text_zh: 95 个样本

options.text: 5 samples
options.text_zh: 5 个样本

options.text: 10 samples
options.text_zh: 10 个样本

questions.explanation: For an out-of-control process the lecture gives ARL = 1/(1 − β). With β = 0.95, ARL = 1/0.05 = 20. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.9.
questions.explanation_zh: 对于失控过程，课件给出 ARL = 1/(1 − β)。当 β = 0.95 时，ARL = 1/0.05 = 20。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 9 页。

questions.section: Western Electric Statistical Quality Control: R1-3
questions.text: Among three consecutive control-chart points, two plot beyond the 2σ warning limits while no point exceeds the 3σ control limits. Which Western Electric rule from the lecture is triggered?
questions.text_zh: 连续三个控制图点中，有两个落在 2σ 警戒限之外，但没有任何点超过 3σ 控制限。根据课件，触发的是哪条 Western Electric 判异规则？

options.text: One point beyond the 3σ control limits.
options.text_zh: 单点超出 3σ 控制限。

options.text: Four out of five consecutive points beyond 1σ.
options.text_zh: 连续五个点中有四个超过 1σ。

options.text: Six consecutive points increasing or decreasing.
options.text_zh: 连续六个点单调上升或下降。

options.text: Two out of three consecutive points beyond the 2σ warning limits.
options.text_zh: 连续三个点中有两个超过 2σ 警戒限。

questions.explanation: The R1–R3 slide identifies two of three consecutive points beyond the 2σ warning limits as the rule for detecting a medium process shift. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.12.
questions.explanation_zh: R1–R3 课件页将“连续三个点中有两个超过 2σ 警戒限”列为用于检测中等过程偏移的判异规则。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 12 页。

questions.section: Western Electric Statistical Quality Control: R4-6
questions.text: A control chart shows 14 consecutive points alternating up and down. What interpretation best matches the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 某控制图出现连续 14 个点交替上升和下降。以下哪种解释最符合课件？

options.text: The pattern is expected random behavior and should not be treated as a non-random signal.
options.text_zh: 该模式属于预期的随机行为，不应视为非随机信号。

options.text: The pattern is equivalent to a single point beyond 3σ and therefore indicates only one isolated large shift.
options.text_zh: 该模式等同于单点超过 3σ，因此只表示一次孤立的大偏移。

options.text: The pattern suggests systematic rather than random variation, possibly from alternating measurement errors, cyclic influences, or periodic procedural changes.
options.text_zh: 该模式提示系统性而非随机变差，可能来自交替测量误差、周期影响或周期性操作变化。

options.text: The pattern specifically indicates 15 consecutive points confined to Zone C and therefore only stratification.
options.text_zh: 该模式特指连续 15 个点都位于 C 区，因此只表示分层。

questions.explanation: The lecture states that 14 consecutive alternating points suggest systematic variation and gives alternating measurement error, cyclic influence, and periodic procedural changes as possible causes. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.13.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，连续 14 个点上下交替提示系统性变差，并列举交替测量误差、周期影响及周期性操作变化等可能原因。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 13 页。

questions.section: Western Electric Statistical Quality Control: R7
questions.text: Fifteen consecutive points remain close to the centerline in Zone C on either side, with unusually little natural spread. What does the lecture say this pattern may indicate?
questions.text_zh: 连续 15 个点都位于中心线两侧的 C 区，且自然散布异常偏小。根据课件，这种模式可能说明什么？

options.text: A single large special-cause shift that necessarily places one point beyond 3σ.
options.text_zh: 单次大的特殊原因偏移，且必然有一个点超过 3σ。

options.text: Artificial constraint or stratification, possibly due to data grouping, insufficient measurement sensitivity, or tight external control.
options.text_zh: 过程受到人为约束或存在分层，可能与数据分组、测量灵敏度不足或外部控制过紧有关。

options.text: A six-point monotonic trend caused only by process drift.
options.text_zh: 仅由过程漂移造成的连续六点单调趋势。

options.text: Definitive proof that the process is capable relative to all product specifications.
options.text_zh: 过程相对于所有产品规格均具备能力的确定性证明。

questions.explanation: Western Electric rule R7 associates 15 consecutive Zone-C points with artificial constraint or stratification and notes data grouping, measurement sensitivity, or tight external control as possible causes. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.14.
questions.explanation_zh: Western Electric R7 将连续 15 个 C 区点与人为约束或分层联系起来，并指出数据分组、测量灵敏度不足或外部控制过紧等可能原因。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 14 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about Western Electric control-chart signals:
I. A single point beyond the 3σ control limits is used to detect a large shift or unusual occurrence.
II. Six consecutive points increasing or decreasing are used to detect a trend or systematic shift.
III. Fourteen consecutive points alternating up and down are treated as normal random variation that requires no attention.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于Western Electric 控制图判异信号，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 单个点超过 3σ 控制限用于检测大的过程偏移或异常事件。
II. 连续六个点上升或下降用于检测趋势或系统性偏移。
III. 连续 14 个点上下交替被视为无需关注的正常随机变差。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

questions.explanation: The first two statements match the Western Electric rules. Fourteen alternating points are specifically presented as a non-random systematic pattern, so statement III is false. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.12-13.
questions.explanation_zh: 前两项与 Western Electric 判异规则一致；连续 14 个点上下交替被明确视为非随机的系统性模式，因此第三项错误。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 12-13 页。

questions.text: Why should specification limits not be treated as the same thing as control limits when evaluating a semiconductor process?
questions.text_zh: 在评价半导体工艺时，为什么不能把规格限与控制限视为同一概念？

options.text: Specification limits come from natural process variability, whereas control limits are imposed by customers.
options.text_zh: 规格限来自过程自然变差，而控制限由客户外部设定。

options.text: Specification limits are externally imposed requirements, whereas control limits are derived from the process's natural variability.
options.text_zh: 规格限是外部施加的要求，而控制限由过程自身的自然变差推导得到。

options.text: Both limits are customer requirements and therefore do not depend on process data.
options.text_zh: 两类限值都是客户要求，因此都与过程数据无关。

options.text: Both limits are always set exactly at the process mean ±3σ.
options.text_zh: 两类限值都固定设置为过程均值 ±3σ。

questions.explanation: The lecture distinguishes externally imposed specification limits from control limits derived from the inherent natural variability of an in-control process. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.15.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件明确区分了外部施加的规格限与由受控过程内在自然变差推导出的控制限。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 15 页。

questions.text: A stable process has USL = 110, LSL = 90, and σ = 2. Using Cp = (USL − LSL)/(6σ), what is Cp?
questions.text_zh: 某稳定过程的 USL = 110、LSL = 90、σ = 2。根据 Cp = (USL − LSL)/(6σ)，Cp 为多少？
questions.explanation: Cp = (110 − 90)/(6×2) = 20/12 ≈ 1.67, so the natural 6σ spread is narrower than the specification band. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.15.
questions.explanation_zh: Cp = (110 − 90)/(6×2) = 20/12 ≈ 1.67，因此过程的自然 6σ 散布小于规格带宽。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 15 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about interpretation of Cp:
I. When Cp > 1, the process uses less than the full tolerance band and relatively few nonconforming products are expected.
II. When Cp = 1, the natural process spread uses the full tolerance band.
III. When Cp < 1, the natural process spread exceeds the tolerance band and many nonconforming products can result.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于Cp 的含义，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 当 Cp > 1 时，过程自然散布占用的规格带小于 100%，通常只产生较少不合格品。
II. 当 Cp = 1 时，过程自然散布刚好占满整个规格带。
III. 当 Cp < 1 时，过程自然散布超过规格带，可能产生大量不合格品。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

questions.explanation: The Cp interpretation slide explicitly presents these three cases for Cp > 1, Cp = 1, and Cp < 1. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.16.
questions.explanation_zh: Cp 解释课件页明确给出了 Cp > 1、Cp = 1 和 Cp < 1 三种情况的上述含义。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 16 页。

questions.text: A process has USL = 110, LSL = 90, mean μ = 106, and σ = 2. Using Cpk = min[(USL − μ)/(3σ), (μ − LSL)/(3σ)], what is Cpk?
questions.text_zh: 某过程 USL = 110、LSL = 90、均值 μ = 106、σ = 2。根据 Cpk = min[(USL − μ)/(3σ), (μ − LSL)/(3σ)]，Cpk 为多少？
questions.explanation: The upper-side capability is (110 − 106)/6 = 0.67 and the lower-side capability is (106 − 90)/6 = 2.67; Cpk is the smaller value, 0.67. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.17.

questions.text: Two processes have the same specification limits and the same σ. Process A is centered in the specification range, while Process B has shifted toward the USL. Which comparison is most appropriate?
questions.text_zh: 两个过程具有相同的规格限与相同的 σ。过程 A 位于规格中心，而过程 B 的均值向 USL 偏移。以下比较哪项最合适？

options.text: Their Cp values are the same, but Process B has a lower Cpk because it is less centered.
options.text_zh: 两者 Cp 相同，但过程 B 因偏心而具有更低的 Cpk。

options.text: Process B has a lower Cp, while both processes must have the same Cpk.
options.text_zh: 过程 B 的 Cp 更低，而两者 Cpk 必须相同。

options.text: Both Cp and Cpk are higher for Process B because its mean is closer to the USL.
options.text_zh: 过程 B 的均值更接近 USL，因此 Cp 与 Cpk 都更高。

options.text: Both Cp and Cpk are unchanged by a shift in process centering.
options.text_zh: 过程均值偏移不会改变 Cp 或 Cpk。

questions.explanation: Cp depends on specification width relative to 6σ and is unchanged when only the mean shifts; Cpk accounts for centering, so movement toward one specification limit lowers Cpk. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.15, 17.
questions.explanation_zh: Cp 取决于规格带宽与 6σ 的相对关系，仅均值偏移时 Cp 不变；Cpk 考虑过程中心位置，因此均值向某一规格限偏移会降低 Cpk。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 15、17 页。

questions.text: According to the lecture, in which situation is Cpk particularly useful compared with Cp?
questions.text_zh: 根据课件，与 Cp 相比，Cpk 在哪种情况下尤其有用？

options.text: When process centering relative to the specification limits matters.
options.text_zh: 当过程相对于规格限的居中性很重要时。

options.text: Only for attribute data such as defect counts.
options.text_zh: 仅用于缺陷数等属性数据。

options.text: Only when the process is statistically out of control.
options.text_zh: 仅在过程处于统计失控时。

options.text: When no specification limits have been defined.
options.text_zh: 当尚未定义任何规格限时。

questions.explanation: Cpk uses the smaller distance from the process mean to the two specification limits and therefore captures loss of capability when the process is off-center. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.17.
questions.explanation_zh: Cpk 使用过程均值到上下规格限距离中的较小值，因此能够反映过程偏心时的能力损失。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 17 页。

questions.section: Z as a Measure of Process Centering
questions.text: The lecture defines the centering value as Z = (X̄ − T)/s. If X̄ = 102, target T = 100, and s = 1.6, what is Z?
questions.text_zh: 课件将过程居中指标定义为 Z = (X̄ − T)/s。若 X̄ = 102、目标值 T = 100、s = 1.6，则 Z 为多少？
questions.explanation: Z = (102 − 100)/1.6 = 1.25, matching the lecture definition of normalized process-average shift from target. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.18.
questions.explanation_zh: Z = (102 − 100)/1.6 = 1.25，对应课件中“过程均值相对目标值的标准化偏移”定义。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 18 页。

questions.text: A process has ZUSL = 1.5 and ZLSL = 3.0. Based on the lecture definitions, which statement is most accurate?
questions.text_zh: 某过程的 ZUSL = 1.5、ZLSL = 3.0。根据课件定义，以下哪项最准确？

options.text: The USL is closer to the process mean in σ units.
options.text_zh: 以 σ 为单位，USL 更靠近过程均值。

options.text: The two specification limits are equally distant from the mean.
options.text_zh: 两个规格限到过程均值的距离相同。

options.text: The relative distances cannot be inferred from ZUSL and ZLSL.
options.text_zh: 无法由 ZUSL 与 ZLSL 判断相对距离。

options.text: The LSL is closer to the process mean in σ units.
options.text_zh: 以 σ 为单位，LSL 更靠近过程均值。

questions.explanation: ZUSL and ZLSL are the number of σ from the mean to the upper and lower specification limits. The smaller ZUSL therefore identifies the USL as the closer, more limiting side. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.19.
questions.explanation_zh: ZUSL 与 ZLSL 分别表示过程均值到上、下规格限的 σ 距离，因此较小的 ZUSL 表明 USL 更接近过程均值、限制更强。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 19 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about process capability and process centering:
I. Specification limits are externally imposed requirements, while control limits reflect natural process variability.
II. Cpk incorporates the distance from the process mean to the nearer specification limit and therefore reflects centering.
III. A high Cp by itself guarantees that the process is well centered between the specification limits.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于过程能力与过程居中性，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 规格限是外部施加的要求，而控制限反映过程的自然变差。
II. Cpk 考虑过程均值到较近规格限的距离，因此能够反映过程居中性。
III. Cp 较高本身就能保证过程均值位于上下规格限之间的中心。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: Statements I and II match the lecture. Cp reflects specification width relative to process spread but does not include the process mean, so it does not by itself guarantee centering. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.15, 17.
questions.explanation_zh: 陈述 I、II 与课件一致。Cp 反映规格带宽相对于过程散布的大小，但不包含过程均值位置，因此不能单独保证过程居中。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 15、17 页。

questions.text: After an OCAP adjustment is made for an out-of-control signal, which control-system element should determine whether the corrective action was effective?
questions.text_zh: 针对失控信号完成 OCAP 调整后，应由控制系统中的哪一环节确认纠正措施是否有效？

options.text: Validate: use the next sample to confirm that the action was effective.
options.text_zh: 验证（Validate）：使用后续样本确认措施是否有效。

options.text: Sensor: collect the original measurement and establish current process performance.
options.text_zh: 传感器（Sensor）：采集原始测量并建立当前过程表现。

options.text: Alarm: define the control limit or run rule that requires attention.
options.text_zh: 报警（Alarm）：定义需要关注的控制限或运行规则。

options.text: Control logic: specify the investigation or adjustment to perform.
options.text_zh: 控制逻辑（Control logic）：规定需要执行的调查或调整。

questions.explanation: The control-system slide defines Validate as checking the next sample to assure that the corrective action or adjustment was effective. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.21.
questions.explanation_zh: 控制系统课件页将 Validate 定义为通过后续样本确认纠正措施或调整是否有效。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 21 页。

questions.text: A measured quantity is a product parameter rather than a process parameter, and the unit is found to be out of specification. Which action path matches the lecture flowchart?
questions.text_zh: 某测量量属于产品参数而不是过程参数，并发现该产品超出规格。根据课件流程图，应采用哪条处置路径？

options.text: Continue processing because product specifications do not affect unit disposition.
options.text_zh: 继续加工，因为产品规格不影响产品处置。

options.text: Change the SPC control limits until the unit is classified as in control.
options.text_zh: 修改 SPC 控制限，直到该产品被判为受控。

options.text: Use product control to rework or scrap the unit, then determine root cause and improve.
options.text_zh: 按产品控制流程对该产品返工或报废，并进一步确定根因、实施改善。

options.text: Initiate process adjustment without checking product specification compliance.
options.text_zh: 不检查产品规格符合性，直接启动过程调整。

questions.explanation: The product-control branch checks whether the unit is in specification; an out-of-specification unit follows the rework/scrap path and triggers root-cause improvement. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.22.
questions.explanation_zh: 产品控制分支首先判断产品是否符合规格；超规格产品进入返工/报废路径，并进一步开展根因分析与改善。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 22 页。

questions.text: A film-thickness output Y drifts above target. Which closed-loop response best follows the lecture principle “measure the Ys and adjust the Xs”?
questions.text_zh: 某薄膜厚度输出 Y 漂移到目标值以上。以下哪种闭环响应最符合课件“测量 Y、调整 X”的原则？

options.text: Change the product specification limit so the measured thickness no longer appears abnormal.
options.text_zh: 修改产品规格限，使测得厚度不再显得异常。

options.text: Use the measured thickness deviation to adjust a relevant process input X such as time, power, temperature, pressure, or recipe setting.
options.text_zh: 根据厚度偏差调整相关过程输入 X，例如时间、功率、温度、压力或配方参数。

options.text: Ignore the Y measurement and wait for final-test yield to decide whether the process needs control.
options.text_zh: 忽略 Y 测量，等到最终测试良率出来后再判断是否需要过程控制。

options.text: Adjust another product output Y while leaving all process inputs unchanged.
options.text_zh: 保持所有过程输入不变，仅调整另一个产品输出 Y。

questions.explanation: The lecture describes process control as measuring output responses (Ys) and adjusting relevant process inputs (Xs) such as time, power, temperature, pressure, alignment, or recipe parameters. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.23.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将过程控制描述为测量输出响应 Y，并调整相关过程输入 X，例如时间、功率、温度、压力、对准或配方参数。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 23 页。

questions.text: An out-of-control condition is detected, and the primary adjustment variable is already known and can be adjusted within approved limits. Which process-control approach best matches the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 检测到失控状态，且主要调整变量已经明确，并可在批准范围内调整。根据课件，应采用哪种过程控制方式？

options.text: Go Process Control using an adjustment-based OCAP, with the product checked, adjustments logged, and results verified.
options.text_zh: 采用 Go Process Control（基于调整型 OCAP），检查产品、记录调整并验证调整结果。

options.text: Stop Process Control is mandatory because a known adjustment variable must never be changed by an OCAP.
options.text_zh: 必须采用 Stop Process Control，因为 OCAP 不允许调整已知变量。

options.text: Continue processing with no OCAP because knowing the adjustment variable proves the process is in control.
options.text_zh: 无需 OCAP 直接继续加工，因为知道调整变量就证明过程受控。

options.text: Change the product specification instead of adjusting the process variable.
options.text_zh: 不调整过程变量，而是修改产品规格。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines Go Process Control for an OOC condition when the primary adjustment variable is known and adjustable within limits; adjustments are logged and their results verified. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.24.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将 Go Process Control 用于“失控但主要调整变量已知且可在限值内调整”的情况，并要求记录调整、验证结果。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 24 页。

questions.section: Special Cause Variation / Common Cause Variation
questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about special-cause and common-cause variation:
I. Special-cause variation indicates operation outside the normal performance of the process and calls for action to restore normal behavior.
II. Out-of-control special causes are assigned to operators and engineers/process owners for action.
III. Common-cause variation reflects normal process behavior and long-term reduction of that variation is a management responsibility after special causes are eliminated.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于特殊原因变差与普通原因变差，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 特殊原因变差表示过程运行超出正常表现范围，需要采取措施恢复正常过程行为。
II. 课件将失控的特殊原因处置责任归于操作员、工程师/过程负责人。
III. 普通原因变差反映过程的正常运行状态；消除特殊原因后，进一步降低此类变差主要是管理层的责任。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

questions.explanation: The special- and common-cause slides support all three statements and explicitly distinguish the corresponding ownership for corrective versus systemic improvement. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.25-26.
questions.explanation_zh: 特殊原因与普通原因课件页支持三项陈述，并明确区分了失控纠正与系统性改善的责任归属。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 25-26 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about benefits of effective SPC implementation:
I. Yield improvement and rework reduction are listed benefits.
II. More predictable outcomes and reduced cycle time are listed benefits.
III. Higher yields, lower defect rates, and reduced line-support cost are listed benefits.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于有效实施 SPC 的收益，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 良率提升与返工减少被列为 SPC 的收益。
II. 结果更可预测以及周期时间缩短被列为 SPC 的收益。
III. 更高良率、更低缺陷率以及更低的产线支持成本被列为 SPC 的收益。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

questions.explanation: All three groups are explicitly included in the Week 5 list of SPC/process-control benefits. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.27.
questions.explanation_zh: 三组内容都明确出现在 Week 5 对 SPC/过程控制收益的列举中。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 27 页。

questions.section: Ten Requirements for Designing Effective Process Controls
questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about requirements for designing effective process controls:
I. Clear product specifications, effective metrology, and process characterization are required.
II. A sampling plan, control chart, alarms, and an Out-of-Control Action Plan (OCAP) are required.
III. Process documentation, operator/engineering training, a database, and routine line audits are required.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于有效过程控制的设计要求，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 需要清晰的产品规格、有效的计量以及过程表征。
II. 需要抽样计划、控制图、报警以及失控行动计划（OCAP）。
III. 需要过程文件、操作员/工程师培训、数据库以及常规产线审核。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

questions.explanation: The lecture lists all of these items among the ten requirements for effective process controls. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.28.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将上述各项全部列入有效过程控制的十项设计要求。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 28 页。

questions.text: A process is statistically in control and special causes have been eliminated, but its inherent variation is still too large for the desired business performance. Who should primarily drive the next improvement according to the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 某过程处于统计受控状态，特殊原因已被消除，但其固有变差对于期望的业务表现仍然过大。根据课件，下一步改善应主要由谁推动？

options.text: The operator, by adjusting the process after every individual point even when no OOC signal exists.
options.text_zh: 操作员，即使没有失控信号也对每个单点进行调整。

options.text: Management, by improving the design and operation of the process to reduce common-cause variation.
options.text_zh: 管理层，通过改善过程设计和运行方式来降低普通原因变差。

options.text: The customer, by widening the product specification limits instead of improving the process.
options.text_zh: 客户，通过放宽产品规格限而不是改善过程。

options.text: Final inspection, because common-cause variation can only be removed by screening finished product.
options.text_zh: 最终检验，因为普通原因变差只能通过成品筛选消除。

questions.explanation: The lecture assigns improvement of common-cause variation to management through process design and operation once special causes have been eliminated. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.26.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件指出，在特殊原因被消除后，普通原因变差的进一步改善主要由管理层通过过程设计与运行改进来负责。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 26 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about Stop versus Go Process Controls:
I. Stop Process Control stops the process/lot and initiates a troubleshooting OCAP when an OOC condition is detected.
II. Go Process Control is appropriate when the primary adjustment variable is known and adjustable within approved limits.
III. Both approaches eliminate the need to check the affected product for specification compliance once an OOC signal occurs.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于Stop 与 Go 过程控制，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. Stop Process Control 在检测到 OOC 后停止过程/批次，并启动故障排查型 OCAP。
II. 当主要调整变量已知且可在批准范围内调整时，适合采用 Go Process Control。
III. 一旦出现 OOC 信号，两种方式都不再需要检查受影响产品是否符合规格。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statement I only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statement II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II。

questions.explanation: Both Stop and Go flows include a product specification check. Their key difference is whether the process must stop for troubleshooting or can use a known, bounded adjustment variable. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.24.
questions.explanation_zh: Stop 与 Go 两种流程都包含产品规格检查；关键区别在于是否需要停机排查，或是否可以使用已知且受限的调整变量进行调整。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 24 页。

questions.text: A process parameter has been shown to directly affect final product performance and customer satisfaction. How should this parameter be treated according to the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 某过程参数已被证明会直接影响最终产品性能和客户满意度。根据课件，应如何对待该参数？

options.text: Treat it only as a soft specification that operators should not use for disposition.
options.text_zh: 仅将其作为软性规格，不应让操作员据此进行产品处置。

options.text: Treat it as a Critical to Quality (CTQ) sensitivity and establish an appropriate target and tolerance.
options.text_zh: 将其作为关键质量特性（CTQ）敏感参数，并建立适当的目标值与容差。

options.text: Exclude it from production control because only final-test parameters can be CTQ.
options.text_zh: 将其排除在生产控制之外，因为只有最终测试参数才能成为 CTQ。

options.text: Control it only during routine audits, without defining production targets or tolerances.
options.text_zh: 仅在例行审核时检查，不需要定义生产目标或容差。

questions.explanation: CTQ sensitivities are product/process features that directly affect final performance and customer satisfaction; after identification, targets and tolerances are established and communicated to production. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.30.
questions.explanation_zh: CTQ 敏感参数是直接影响最终产品性能和客户满意度的产品/过程特性；识别后应建立目标值和容差，并明确传达给生产人员。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 30 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about hard and soft specifications:
I. Hard specifications have clear criteria and are used by operators to disposition product on the line.
II. Soft specifications have unclear criteria and are not used directly by operators for product disposition.
III. With soft specifications, parts may be placed on hold for engineering disposition and specification violations may be ignored or passed.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于硬性规格与软性规格，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 硬性规格具有清晰判据，并由操作员用于产线产品处置。
II. 软性规格判据不清晰，操作员不会直接据此处置产品。
III. 使用软性规格时，产品可能被暂扣等待工程判定，甚至出现违规仍放行或规格被忽略的情况。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

questions.explanation: All three statements follow the lecture definitions and examples of hard versus soft specifications. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.31.
questions.explanation_zh: 三项陈述均与课件对硬性规格、软性规格及其常见处置方式的定义一致。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 31 页。

questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about metrology requirements for effective process control:
I. For variable measurements, the lecture calls for demonstrated gage capability below 20%.
II. Bias or linearity should not be statistically significant and should be below 5% of tolerance.
III. For attribute data, the inspection process should have effectiveness above 95%.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于有效过程控制中的计量要求，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 对于变量测量，课件要求证明量具能力小于 20%。
II. 偏倚或线性误差不应具有统计显著性，并应低于容差的 5%。
III. 对于属性数据，检验过程的有效性应高于 95%。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

questions.explanation: The metrology slide gives all three numerical expectations: gage capability <20%, bias/linearity <5% of tolerance, and attribute inspection effectiveness >95%. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.32.
questions.explanation_zh: 计量课件页给出了三项数值要求：量具能力 <20%、偏倚/线性误差 < 容差的 5%，属性检验有效性 >95%。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 32 页。

questions.text: Before a measurement tool is used as a sensor in process control, what is the central purpose of a gage capability study?
questions.text_zh: 在测量设备被用于过程控制的传感器之前，量具能力研究的核心目的是什么？

options.text: Verify that the gage can represent the true part condition accurately enough to be fit for process control.
options.text_zh: 验证量具能否足够准确地反映零件真实状态，从而适合用于过程控制。

options.text: Replace control charts once the measurement system has been qualified.
options.text_zh: 测量系统合格后用量具能力研究取代控制图。

options.text: Derive customer specification limits from the observed measurement spread.
options.text_zh: 根据测量散布推导客户规格限。

options.text: Select the process adjustment variable used to correct product drift.
options.text_zh: 选择用于纠正产品漂移的过程调整变量。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines gage capability as the ability to measure the true condition of the part and states that each gage must be profiled to ensure it is fit for use. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.33.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将量具能力定义为测量零件真实状态的能力，并指出每个量具都需要进行能力表征，以确保适用。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 33 页。

questions.section: Measurement Standards / Measurement Control Using SPC & Standards
questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about measurement standards and measurement control:
I. Measurement standards should be traceable to NIST, ISO, or other internationally recognized standards and are used for correlation and measurement control.
II. Most measurement controls are expressed as delta to target, such as X minus the standard value.
III. Calibrating a tester or gage without statistical evidence that calibration is needed can over-control the measurement system and add variation.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于测量标准与测量控制，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 测量标准应可追溯至 NIST、ISO 或其他国际认可标准，并用于内部/外部相关性与测量控制。
II. 大多数测量控制采用相对目标值的差值形式，例如 X 减去标准值。
III. 在没有统计证据表明需要校准时进行校准，可能造成测量系统过度控制并增加变差。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

questions.explanation: The measurement-standard and measurement-control slides support all three statements, including the warning that unnecessary calibration can add variation. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.34-35.
questions.explanation_zh: 测量标准与测量控制课件页支持三项陈述，其中明确警告不必要的校准可能增加变差。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 34-35 页。

questions.text: The same reference part is measured with different operators and fixtures, and the measurement average shifts between these conditions. Which metrology characteristic is being observed?
questions.text_zh: 同一参考样品由不同操作员、不同夹具进行测量，测量平均值随这些条件发生偏移。该现象对应哪项计量特性？

options.text: Repeatability
options.text_zh: 重复性（Repeatability）

options.text: Reproducibility
options.text_zh: 再现性（Reproducibility）

options.text: Bias
options.text_zh: 偏倚（Bias）

options.text: Stability
options.text_zh: 稳定性（Stability）

questions.explanation: The lecture defines reproducibility as a shift in the measurement average caused by different operators, fixtures, or machines. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.36.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将再现性定义为由于不同操作员、夹具或设备导致的测量平均值偏移。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 36 页。

questions.text: An engineer intentionally changes selected process factors, isolates their effects on a measured response, and builds a model of those factor effects. Which characterization method is being used?
questions.text_zh: 工程师有意改变选定的过程因子，隔离这些因子对测量响应的影响，并建立因子效应模型。这属于哪种过程表征方法？

options.text: Regression analysis.
options.text_zh: 回归分析。

options.text: Design of Experiments (DOE).
options.text_zh: 试验设计（DOE）。

options.text: Fishbone diagram.
options.text_zh: 鱼骨图。

options.text: Routine process audit.
options.text_zh: 常规过程审核。

questions.explanation: The lecture defines DOE by intentional factor changes, isolation of factor effects, and construction of a response model, and calls it the most powerful characterization method. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.38.
questions.explanation_zh: 课件将 DOE 定义为有意改变因子、隔离因子效应并建立响应模型，并称其为最有力的过程表征方法。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 38 页。

questions.text: What is the main purpose of the fishbone diagram shown in the lecture?
questions.text_zh: 课件中的鱼骨图主要用于什么目的？

options.text: Brainstorm possible causal X factors—such as People, Machine, Method, Environment, Material, and Measurement—that may influence a measurable Y response.
options.text_zh: 系统梳理可能影响可测量 Y 响应的原因 X，例如人员、设备、方法、环境、材料和测量。

options.text: Set UCL and LCL solely from expert opinion instead of measurements.
options.text_zh: 仅依据专家意见而非测量数据设定 UCL 与 LCL。

options.text: Prove the root cause conclusively so that no data collection or experiment is required.
options.text_zh: 直接证明根因，从而不再需要数据收集或试验。

options.text: Compute Cpk directly from the six fishbone branches without process data.
options.text_zh: 无需过程数据，直接利用六个鱼骨分支计算 Cpk。

questions.explanation: The diagram organizes potential causal X factors into categories and is used to brainstorm which parameters may influence the measurable Y response; it does not by itself prove causation. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.39.
questions.explanation_zh: 鱼骨图按类别组织潜在原因 X，用于系统头脑风暴哪些参数可能影响可测量的 Y 响应；它本身并不能直接证明因果关系。 来源：EEK5106_week 5，第 39 页。

questions.section: Process versus Product Based Controls / The Missing Element for Many Control Systems
questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about X/Y controls and the primary control parameter:
I. Pressure, temperature, time, energy, concentration, and pH are examples of process X controls and are leading indicators.
II. Critical dimension (CD), depth, thickness, and width are examples of Y controls and are lagging indicators of process performance.
III. A primary control parameter is used to correct parametric drift and is typically selected from DOE results.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于X/Y 控制与主要控制参数，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 压力、温度、时间、能量、浓度和 pH 是过程 X 控制的示例，属于领先指标。
II. 关键尺寸（CD）、深度、厚度和宽度是 Y 控制的示例，属于过程表现的滞后指标。
III. 主要控制参数用于纠正参数漂移，通常依据 DOE 结果确定。
哪一项正确表示了成立的陈述？

options.text: Statements I and II only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 II。

options.text: Statements I and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 I 和 III。

options.text: Statements II and III only.
options.text_zh: 仅陈述 II 和 III。

options.text: None of the three statements is correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均不正确。

options.text: All three statements are correct.
options.text_zh: 三项陈述均正确。

questions.explanation: The Week 5 slides classify X controls as leading process indicators and Y controls as lagging output indicators, and describe the primary control parameter as a DOE-derived means of correcting drift. Source: EEK5106_week 5, p.41-42.

questions.section: Forming Subgroup / Independent versus Dependent / Discrete versus Batch Processing
questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about rational subgroup formation:
I. For discrete production in which units are processed one at a time and are independent, subgroups are typically formed from multiple sequential units.
II. For batch production, units within a batch are dependent on the same batch conditions, while separate batches are independent.
III. Subgroup formation should follow the independent component of the process so that the control chart does not mask a need for adjustment.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于合理子组构成，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 对于逐件加工且各单元相互独立的离散生产，子组通常由多个连续加工单元构成。
II. 对于批处理，同一批内单元受共同批次条件影响而相互依赖，而不同批次之间相互独立。
III. 子组构成应遵循过程中的独立成分，否则控制图可能掩盖实际需要的过程调整。

questions.section: Alarms & OCAP / Process Adjust Matrix / Validate / Deployment Controls
questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about closed-loop process-control deployment:
I. An OCAP should be specific to the SPC rule violated, identify adjustment/escalation responsibilities, and maintain a process log of adjustments and observations.
II. A process-adjust matrix may use a half-adjust rule and a no-adjust zone near target to reduce over-correction while respecting machine limits.
III. After adjustments, effectiveness should be validated; sustainable deployment also depends on documentation, training, traceable data access, and routine audits.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于闭环过程控制部署，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. OCAP 应针对所违反的具体 SPC 规则，明确调整/升级责任，并通过过程日志记录所有调整和观察。
II. 过程调整矩阵可采用“1/2 调整”规则，并在目标值附近设置不调整区，以减少过度校正且遵守设备安全/运行限值。
III. 完成调整后应验证其有效性；长期有效部署还依赖文件化、培训、可追溯的数据访问以及常规审核。

questions.section: Roles & Responsibilities (R&R) / Process Control Design Summary
questions.text:
Consider statements I–III about roles and responsibilities in SPC deployment:
I. Management provides the participation mandate and resources, ensures SPC training, and reviews implementation and performance.
II. Process/manufacturing engineers characterize the process and measurement system, select controls/charts, and develop corrective-action and primary-control strategies.
III. Operators collect and enter data in real time, disposition product to specification, follow OOC action plans, and log process adjustments and observations.
Which option correctly identifies the true statement(s)?
questions.text_zh:
关于SPC 部署中的角色与职责，考虑陈述 I–III：
I. 管理层负责推动全员参与、提供资源、确保 SPC 培训，并审查实施进度与过程表现。
II. 工艺/制造工程师负责过程与测量系统表征、选择控制方法/控制图，并制定纠正措施与主要控制策略。
III. 操作员负责实时采集和录入数据、按规格处置产品、执行 OOC 行动计划，并记录过程调整与观察。
